papers.title: Synergistic high negative pressure enables direct lithium crystallization from raw salt-lake brine
papers.abstract_en: Solar-driven separation–crystallization pump achieves direct lithium crystallization from raw salt-lake brine by synergistic evaporation negative pressure and capillary negative pressure.
papers.summary_ko: 태양광 구동 증발-결정화 펌프를 이용해 증발 음압과 모세관 음압을 동시에 활용함으로써 원염호 염수에서 리튬을 직접 결정화하는 공정을 제시했다. 별도의 농축·정제 단계 없이 원염수에서 바로 리튬 결정을 얻을 수 있다는 점이 특징이다. 배터리 전극 재료가 아닌 리튬 원료 추출 공정에 관한 연구다.

papers.title: Oxygen‐Stacking Reconstruction of Spent LiCoO 2 for Fast Li‐Ion Kinetics and High‐Voltage Stability
papers.abstract_en: Recycling spent LiCoO 2 battery cathodes is essential for securing the sustainable supply of lithium and cobalt, yet current recycling methods mainly produce metal salts, precursors, or conventionally regenerated cathodes, making the recovery of high‐value LiCoO 2 with enhanced electrochemical performance remain challenging. To address this challenge, we systematically investigate and compare conventionally regenerated O3‐type LiCoO 2 (O3‐R‐LCO) and O2‐type LiCoO 2 produced through a hydrometallurgy‐assisted ion‐exchange upcycling strategy (O2‐UP‐LCO). The upgraded O2‐UP‐LCO preserves the local CoO 6 framework while exhibiting enlarged Li‐layer spacing and a more open interlayer structure compared with O3‐R‐LCO. Multiscale characterizations further reveal that the distinct oxygen stacking in O2‐UP‐LCO enables fast Li + transport and stable interfacial reaction kinetics, despite reversible phase transitions during cycling. Benefiting from these structural and kinetic advantages, O2‐UP‐LCO delivers 201 mAh g −1 even at 20C in coin cells and achieves an energy density of 486 Wh kg −1 at 1C in a 2 Ah‐level pouch cell. In contrast, O3‐R‐LCO suffers from restricted Li + diffusion and increased interfacial impedance at high voltage, accompanied by aggravated particle cracking after cycling. Overall, this work provides a polymorph‐upgrading strategy for efficient recovery of spent LiCoO 2 material.
papers.summary_ko: 폐 LiCoO2 전극을 수습금속학 기반 이온교환 업사이클링으로 처리해 O2형 LiCoO2(O2-UP-LCO)를 제조하고, 기존 재생법으로 얻은 O3형 LiCoO2(O3-R-LCO)와 구조·전기화학 특성을 비교했다. O2-UP-LCO는 Li층 간격이 넓어진 더 개방적인 층간 구조를 유지해 빠른 Li+ 전달과 안정적인 계면 반응 속도를 보였으며, 코인셀에서 20C에서도 201 mAh g-1을 냈고 1C 2Ah 파우치셀에서 486 Wh kg-1의 에너지 밀도를 달성했다. 반면 O3-R-LCO는 고전압에서 Li+ 확산이 제한되고 계면 임피던스가 커지며 입자 균열이 심화됐다.

papers.title: Octahedral Co 3+ Spin‐State Regulation in W‐Doped Co 3 O 4 for Accelerated Sulfur Redox Kinetics
papers.abstract_en: Lithium–sulfur batteries (LSBs) are promising high‐energy storage systems, but their practical application remains limited by the low electronic conductivity of sulfur, sluggish Li–S redox kinetics, and the lithium polysulfide (LiPS) shuttle effect. These challenges require the rational design of cathode catalysts with well‐regulated electronic structures and active sites. Herein, Cu 2+ and Al 3+ substitution in Co 3 O 4 was first used to identify the catalytic roles of Co sites with different coordination environments, forming CuCo 2 O 4 and CoAl 2 O 4 as model systems. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that octahedral Co 3+ sites play a key role in enhancing LiPS adsorption and Li–S reaction kinetics. Guided by this insight, tungsten species with different oxidation states were used to direct distinct local perturbations of tetrahedral‐ and octahedral‐Co‐site environments in Co 3 O 4, yielding W Td ‐Co 3 O 4 @NC and W Oh ‐Co 3 O 4 @NC, respectively, where NC denotes nitrogen‐doped carbon. Magnetic measurements and DFT calculations demonstrate that W 6+ doping induces a low‐spin to high‐spin transition of Co 3+, generating additional unpaired 3d electrons that strengthen LiPS adsorption and accelerate LiPS conversion. As a result, W Oh ‐Co 3 O 4 @NC/S delivers high capacity, excellent rate capability, and long‐term cycling stability, even under lean‐electrolyte conditions. This work demonstrates spin‐state engineering of octahedral Co 3+ sites as an effective strategy to optimize catalytic activity for LSBs.
papers.summary_ko: Co3O4 내 팔면체 Co3+ 자리가 리튬폴리설파이드(LiPS) 흡착과 Li-S 반응 속도를 좌우함을 Cu2+/Al3+ 치환 모델 시스템과 DFT로 규명하고, W 도핑을 통해 팔면체·사면체 Co 자리를 선택적으로 조절한 WOh-Co3O4@NC와 WTd-Co3O4@NC 촉매를 설계했다. W6+ 도핑이 Co3+의 저스핀→고스핀 전환을 유도해 LiPS 흡착과 전환을 촉진함을 자기 측정과 DFT로 확인했으며, 결과적으로 WOh-Co3O4@NC/S 전극은 린(lean) 전해질 조건에서도 높은 용량과 우수한 율속·장기 사이클 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Molecule Bridging Enables Integrated Design of a Hydrogen-Bond Network and Li+ Coordination Chemistry for Long-Life Solid-State Batteries
papers.abstract_en: PEO-based electrolytes extensively applied in solid-state lithium metal batteries are always confronted with issues of sluggish ion transport and unfavorable interfacial stability. Although various supramolecular strategies, particularly H-bond engineering, have been attempted, their actual efficacy is fundamentally crippled by the structural lability of the H-bond cross-linking network (HBCN) and the chemical/electrochemical instability of conventional hydrogen bond donors (HBDs) at the interface. Herein, ellagic acid (EA) with abundant phenolic hydroxyl and lactone groups is identified as a valuable HBD and “molecule bridge” in the PEO-based electrolyte, together with the integrated design of a stable HBCN and favorable Li+ coordination chemistry. Through intense H-bond (C–C–O···H–O) and ion–dipole interactions (Li+···O═C–O), strong PEO–Li+ chelation is effectively weakened while enriching the Li+ solvation sheath with TFSI– and EA. Notably, the appearance of TFSI–-rich Li+ coordination and Li+–EA complex in situ generates a robust LiF-, Li3N-, and PhOLi-rich SEI, facilitating uniform lithium deposition and improved interfacial stability. Consequently, the Li|LFP batteries can achieve a stable Li stripping/plating cycle over 3500 cycles at 1C with a capacity retention of 83.8% at the 1000th. The stable operation of more than 200 cycles at 0.5C of 50 μm Li|LFP pouch batteries further confirms the practicality of the EA molecule bridge.
papers.summary_ko: PEO 기반 고체 전해질에 수소결합 도너(HBD)로 엘라그산(EA)을 도입해 수소결합 가교망(HBCN)과 Li+ 배위화학을 통합 설계했다. EA의 수소결합 및 이온-다이폴 상호작용이 PEO-Li+ 킬레이션을 약화시켜 TFSI-와 EA가 풍부한 Li+ 솔베이션 셸을 형성하고, 이는 LiF/Li3N/PhOLi가 풍부한 안정적 SEI 형성으로 이어져 균일한 리튬 증착을 돕는다. Li|LFP 셀은 1C에서 3500사이클 이상 안정 작동했고(1000사이클 시 용량유지율 83.8%), 50 μm 리튬을 사용한 파우치셀도 0.5C에서 200사이클 이상 안정적으로 작동했다.

papers.title: Ligand-field reconstruction enables 4.7 V LiCoO 2 with suppressed chemomechanical degradation for high-energy batteries
papers.abstract_en: Ligand-field reconstruction via bulk fluorine incorporation stabilizes the oxygen sublattice of LiCoO 2 , enabling outstanding cycling stability under a 4.7 V high cutoff voltage with suppressed surface reconstruction and chemomechanical degradation.
papers.summary_ko: LiCoO2 벌크에 불소를 도입하여 리간드장을 재구성함으로써 산소 하위격자를 안정화하는 전략을 제시했다. 이를 통해 4.7V의 높은 충전 상한 전압에서도 표면 재구성과 화학역학적 저하가 억제되어 뛰어난 사이클 안정성을 달성했다.

papers.title: Interfacial Electronic‐Structural Coupling Suppresses Jahn‐Teller Instability in NASICON Cathode Casting Long Cycling Life
papers.abstract_en: NASICON‐type Na 4 VMn(PO 4) 3 cathodes possess attractive high‐voltage and structural robustness, yet its application is hindered by the intrinsic instability of Mn 3+ ‐induced Jahn‐Teller distortion. A mosaic‐like Na 4 VMn(PO 4) 3 /NaFePO 4 (NVMP/NFP) heterostructure is constructed to achieve interfacial electronic‐structural synergistic regulation. The nanoscale heterointerfaces induce charge redistribution and modify the local electronic environment, thereby strengthening Mn─O interactions indirectly and interrupting the spatial correlation of local distortions, which successfully suppresses the Jahn‐Teller instability. The suppression of local electronic instability by the NVMP/NFP heterostructure is confirmed by complementary experimental and theoretical analyses, which further reveal reversible V 3+ /V 4+ and Mn 2+ /Mn 3+ redox reactions. Furthermore, the heterointerface reconstructs the Na + transport network by generating more interconnected and multidimensional migration pathways with reduced diffusion barriers, mitigates the accumulation of lattice strain during Na + extraction/insertion and fosters electron transfer, casting fast reversible electrochemical reaction. Benefiting from this interfacial electronic‐structural coupling, the optimized NVMP/NFP cathode delivers excellent wide‐temperature cycling stability, retaining 89.91% capacity after 6000 cycles at 2 A g −1, 91.80% after 2500 cycles at ‐15°C, and 80.23% after 6000 cycles at 45°C. This work provides an interfacial engineering strategy for decoupling electronic instability from structural degradation and offers a general pathway for stabilizing Jahn‐Teller active electrode materials.
papers.summary_ko: NASICON형 Na4VMn(PO4)3(NVMP) 양극재는 고전압·구조 안정성이 장점이지만 Mn3+에 의한 얀-텔러 왜곡이 문제였는데, NVMP와 NaFePO4(NFP)를 모자이크형 이종구조로 결합해 계면에서 전자구조적 상호작용을 규제함으로써 이를 억제했다. 이종계면이 전하 재분배를 유도해 Mn-O 결합을 강화하고 국부 왜곡의 공간적 상관성을 끊어 얀-텔러 불안정성을 완화하며, V3+/V4+ 및 Mn2+/Mn3+의 가역적 레독스와 더 다차원적인 Na+ 이동 경로를 제공한다. 최적화된 NVMP/NFP 양극은 2 A g-1에서 6000사이클 후 89.91%, -15°C에서 2500사이클 후 91.80%, 45°C에서 6000사이클 후 80.23%의 용량유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Differentiable Solvation Shell Model for Rational Electrolyte Design
papers.abstract_en: Tailoring the Li+ solvation shell is a central design principle for many emerging Li metal battery electrolytes but remains largely qualitative. Here, we introduce a mean-field Ising model that predicts the Li+ solvation shell from the donor number (DN), acceptor number, molar ratio, and molecular size. The model is end-to-end differentiable, enabling direct parameterization from molecular dynamics (MD) solvation structures. For localized high-concentration electrolytes, it reproduces MD shell compositions with 10.7% RMSE at much reduced cost and captures solvation trends in other electrolyte classes without re-fitting. Model interaction terms show that DN dominates Li+ solvation energetics, explaining the empirical DN-based design rules. For LiTFSI in tetraglyme absent from training, the model identifies fluorobenzene as a diluent and a concentration window with anion-rich solvation shells and low free solvent. The predicted solvation structure is confirmed by MD, and published experiments on related electrolytes support the design principles.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬금속전지 전해질에서 Li+ 솔베이션 셸 설계를 정량화하기 위해 도너수(DN), 억셉터수, 몰비, 분자 크기로부터 솔베이션 구조를 예측하는 평균장 이징 모델을 제시했다. 이 모델은 end-to-end 미분가능해 분자동역학(MD) 솔베이션 구조로부터 직접 파라미터화되며, 고농도 국소화 전해질에서 MD 결과를 10.7% RMSE로 재현하고 재학습 없이도 다른 전해질 계열의 솔베이션 경향을 포착한다. 학습 데이터에 없던 테트라글라임 내 LiTFSI 조성에 대해 플루오로벤젠 희석제와 음이온이 풍부한 솔베이션 셸을 갖는 농도 구간을 제안했고, 이는 MD와 기존 실험 결과로 검증됐다.

papers.title: CD33-CD45 interaction in Alzheimer’s disease susceptibility
papers.abstract_en: CD 33 is associated with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) susceptibility. The AD-associated rs3865444 C risk variant reduces splicing of the sialic acid-binding domain, increasing the sialic acid-binding isoform seven-fold. Here we identify CD45, a GWAS-associated AD risk gene, as an immune cell-specific sialic acid-dependent cis CD33 binding partner, whose phosphatase activity CD33 inhibits. CD33 loss improved microglial amyloid beta clearance and protected against amyloid beta-induced dendritic spine loss in microglial-neuronal co-cultures, whereas CD45 loss impaired clearance, aligning with detrimental effects of CD33-mediated CD45 inhibition. CD33-CD45 interaction frequency was increased in monocytes from rs3865444 CC individuals versus rs3865444 AA , as well as in AD versus controls, independent of genotype. An interaction between CD33 and PTPRC (CD45) expression in human brain tissue was associated with a pathological AD diagnosis and global burden of AD pathology, consistent with the cellular findings above. Together, our results link CD33-mediated suppression of CD45 with AD genetic susceptibility and systemic myeloid dysfunction.
papers.summary_ko: CD33과 면역세포 특이적 결합 파트너인 CD45의 상호작용이 알츠하이머병 감수성 유전 변이(rs3865444)와 연관됨을 밝힌 생의학 연구로, 배터리·전극 소재와는 무관하다.

papers.title: A spectral-spatial interweaver for hyperdimensional photonic computing
papers.abstract_en: Photonic computing offers high bandwidth, parallelism and energy efficiency for artificial intelligence (AI), yet its scalability remains limited by bulky optical components and immature optoelectronic integration. Here we present HyperON, a thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) hyperdimensional optical network built around a passive spectral-spatial interweaver and broadband wavelength-parallel modulators. The interweaver combines wavelength multiplexing with spatial replication in a log 2 P -stage network, delivering the full wavelength set to every spatial output without beam-combination loss. By interweaving P spectral channels with K spatial units, HyperON forms a unified P × K parallel computing framework, supporting O ( N 2 ) operations with only O ( N ) modulators, improving hardware efficiency and scalability. A 16 × 16 interweaver shows low-loss, broadband and highly uniform operation across 1523.40-1568.85 nm, with 1.30 dB average loss, 0.196 dB output-port variation and 0.414 dB cross-wavelength variation. The integrated wavelength-parallel modulators retain system-level bandwidths of 53-67 GHz after large-scale routing, while standalone devices exhibit bandwidths beyond 67 GHz. Together, these features enable the fabricated HyperON chip to deliver a projected peak throughput of 32.8 TMAC/s, with estimated energy and area efficiencies of 7.04 TMAC/s/W and 0.163 TMAC/s/mm 2 , respectively. Experimental demonstrations in image convolution, handwritten digit recognition, and 64-mode parallel computing confirm its high speed operation, versatility, and scalability for large-scale AI workloads.
papers.summary_ko: 박막 리튬나이오베이트(TFLN) 기반 초차원 광컴퓨팅 칩(HyperON)에 관한 연구로, 파장-공간 다중화를 이용한 광학 연산 아키텍처를 다룬다. 배터리 전극 소재와는 무관한 포토닉 컴퓨팅 분야 논문이다.

papers.title: Ultrasonic Fabrication of Protected Lithium Metal Particles for High‐Performance Thin Anodes
papers.abstract_en: Micron‐scale adhesive lithium metal particles (ALMPs) are fabricated via a cost‐effective and scalable ultrasonication method at 30°C to break down bulky lithium metal. By manipulating the sonication time and formulations of the sonication solution, the chemical composition of the protective shells on ALMPs can be engineered. ALMPs produced in an ethylene carbonate/dimethoxyethane mixed solvent containing LiTFSI form an organic–inorganic balanced shell that contains LiF, Li 3 N, Li 2 SO 3, and Li 2 SO 4. The resulting ALMPs exhibit intrinsic adhesiveness, enabling the fabrication of thin lithium (Li ALMP) electrodes by rolling without the use of binders. The thickness (5–45 µm) and areal capacity of the Li ALMP electrode are tunable by adjusting the ALMP loading amount. The Li ALMP electrode is stable under dry air and exhibits excellent mechanical robustness in bending, coiling, and adhesion tests. Owing to its higher effective surface area and the presence of a unique artificial solid‐electrolyte interphase, the Li ALMP electrode shows reduced polarization, more uniform Li plating/stripping behavior, and enhanced tolerance to high operation current densities compared with a conventional lithium‐foil (Li Conv) electrode. A LiNi 0.6 Mn 0.2 Co 0.2 O 2 //Li ALMP cell demonstrates superior rate capability and cycling stability relative to a LiNi 0.6 Mn 0.2 Co 0.2 O 2 //Li Conv cell. The thin Li ALMP electrode is highly promising for high‐energy‐density battery applications.
papers.summary_ko: 저가·확장 가능한 초음파 처리로 벌크 리튬 금속을 분쇄해 미크론 크기의 접착성 리튬금속입자(ALMP)를 제조하고, 초음파 용액 조성(EC/DME + LiTFSI)을 조절해 LiF, Li3N, Li2SO3, Li2SO4로 구성된 유무기 혼합 보호층을 입자 표면에 형성했다. 이 ALMP는 자체 접착성을 가져 바인더 없이 압연만으로 5-45 μm 두께의 박형 리튬 전극 제작이 가능하며, 건조 공기에서도 안정하고 굽힘·권취에도 우수한 기계적 강건성을 보인다. 넓은 유효 표면적과 독특한 인공 SEI로 인해 기존 리튬 호일 전극보다 분극이 낮고 균일한 플레이팅/스트리핑 거동을 보여, LiNi0.6Mn0.2Co0.2O2 전지에서 더 우수한 율속·사이클 특성을 나타냈다.

papers.title: Steric Asymmetry‐Induced Hyperconjugation Enables Stable Anode‐Free Sodium Pouch Cells
papers.abstract_en: Anode‐free sodium batteries (AFSBs) hold great promise for high‐energy storage; however, their practical application is hindered by poor cycling stability arising from inefficient sodium‐metal electroplating–stripping. Guided by hyperconjugation theory, 1‐ethoxy‐2‐methoxyethane (EEME) is identified as the optimal solvent, as its sterically asymmetric ethyl terminus provides a hyperconjugation‐enabled polarization pathway while maintaining moderate Na + ‐coordination strength. This steric‐induced hyperconjugation amplifies the positive electrostatic potential in EEME, creating a persistent anion‐affinitive site that retains PF 6 − near Na + solvation structures and promotes their correlated transport toward the negatively polarized electrode. The resulting NaF‐rich interphase enables highly reversible and dendrite‐free Na electroplating/stripping. Benefiting from these, at pouch‐cell level, the EEME‐based electrolyte enabled durable anode‐free Al/C||Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4) 2 P 2 O 7 cells, retaining remarkable 85.9% after 1600 cycles at 0.5C with superior rate capability up to 5C. Notably, the EEME‐based electrolyte also enabled excellent low‐temperature performance, with the pouch cell preserving 98.6% of its room‐temperature capacity at −20 °C and retaining 93.5% capacity after 150 cycles. This work establishes the stereoelectronic‐solvation design principle that connects fundamental conformational chemistry with rational electrolyte engineering for practical AFSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극 소듐전지(AFSB)의 불균일한 Na 금속 전기도금/스트리핑 문제를 해결하기 위해 하이퍼컨주게이션 이론에 기반해 1-에톡시-2-메톡시에탄(EEME)을 최적 용매로 선정했다. EEME의 비대칭 에틸 말단이 적절한 Na+ 배위 강도를 유지하면서도 하이퍼컨주게이션 기반 분극 경로를 제공해 PF6- 음이온을 Na+ 솔베이션 구조 근처에 유지시켜 음이온이 풍부한 NaF 계면을 형성, 가역적이고 덴드라이트 없는 Na 플레이팅/스트리핑을 가능케 한다. 이를 적용한 무음극 Al/C||Na4Fe3(PO4)2P2O7 파우치셀은 0.5C에서 1600사이클 후 85.9%의 용량을 유지했고 -20°C에서도 상온 용량의 98.6%를 보였다.

papers.title: Solvation‐Directed Electric Double Layer Formation in Low‐Concentration Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: The electric double layer (EDL) governs interfacial stability in lithium metal batteries, yet its rational design remains constrained by concentrated electrolytes or complex solvent systems. Here we demonstrate that the EDL in low‐concentration electrolytes (LCEs) can be rationally programmed through anion selection based on their solvation behavior, decoupling interfacial stability from the heavy consumption of lithium salts and sophisticated solvent blends. By systematically screening anions with distinct Li + ‐anion coordination strengths and steric profiles, we formulate a mixed‐anion LCE and uncover a fundamental principle: large, weakly coordinatinganions (WCAs) accumulate at the interface to form a persistent charge‐shielding layer, whereas small, strongly coordinating anions (SCAs) are dynamically driven deeper into the Helmholtz region under polarization, where they actively modulate interfacial (de)solvation kinetics. This solvation‐defined division of labor creates a rationally designed, self‐adaptive EDL that couples electrostatic stabilization with interfacial chemistry. Beyond offering a high‐performance LCE formulation, this work establishes a direct and mechanistic linkage between bulk solvation architecture and interfacial EDL organization in dilute electrolytes, revealing that the EDL can itself be programmed through anion‐specific solvation motifs to dictate interfacial stability, introducing a design paradigm for materially efficient electrolyte engineering based on solvation‐directed EDL formation.
papers.summary_ko: 저농도 전해질(LCE)에서 음이온의 용매화 거동을 조절하여 전기이중층(EDL)을 설계하는 전략을 제시했다. 약하게 결합하는 음이온(WCA)과 강하게 결합하는 음이온(SCA)을 혼합해 계면에서 전하 차단층과 탈용매화 조절 기능을 분리함으로써, 적은 리튬염 소모로도 리튬 금속 전지의 계면 안정성을 향상시켰다.

papers.title: Reaction‐Pathway Regulation for Degradation‐Insensitive Direct Regeneration of Spent LiNi 0.5 Co 0.2 Mn 0.3 O 2 Cathode Materials
papers.abstract_en: (NCM523) cathode materials with different degradation states, we show that this limitation originates from competition among relithiation, structural recovery, and thermal decomposition during calcination. As the balance of these competing reactions shifts with degradation state, cathodes evolve along distinct reaction trajectories. Recognizing that these reactions are governed by the reactants, we regulate the regeneration reaction through the lithium-source reactant, causing cathode materials with different degradation states to pass through the same type of low-symmetry, synthesis-derived intermediate structure during calcination. This redirects regeneration toward a reconstruction pathway with favorable thermodynamics and improved ion diffusion, enabling rapid Li replenishment, long-range cation ordering, and structural restoration. Consequently, practical NCM523 black mass is regenerated into cathodes that deliver higher capacity and better capacity retention than those regenerated via the conventional pathway, and a 1.3 Ah pouch cell with the regenerated cathode retains 80.2% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles. This reconstruction pathway also enables direct upcycling of degraded NCM523 toward higher-Ni compositions. Broadly, this work provides a mechanistic framework for reducing degradation-state dependence in direct regeneration of spent cathode materials.
papers.summary_ko: 폐 LiNi0.5Co0.2Mn0.3O2(NCM523) 양극재의 직접 재생에서 열처리 중 재리튬화, 구조 복원, 열분해 경쟁이 성능 저하의 원인임을 규명하고, 리튬원 반응물을 조절해 서로 다른 퇴화 상태의 양극재가 동일한 저대칭 합성유래 중간구조를 거치도록 유도했다. 이를 통해 재생 경로를 재구성 방향으로 유도해 빠른 리튬 보충, 장거리 양이온 정렬, 구조 복원을 달성했으며, 재생된 NCM523은 1.3 Ah 파우치셀에서 1000사이클 후 80.2%의 용량유지율을 보였다. 이 접근은 퇴화 상태에 둔감한 재생 메커니즘을 제공하며 고니켈 조성으로의 직접 업사이클링도 가능케 한다.

papers.title: Prestripping Protocol for Reconciling Lithium Dissolution and Galvanic Corrosion in Anode-Free Batteries
papers.abstract_en: The practical viability of high-energy-density anode-free lithium metal batteries is limited by the poor reversibility of lithium plating and stripping. Low-current stripping suppresses pitting and inactive Li formation but prolongs electrolyte exposure and galvanic corrosion, whereas high-current stripping shortens the corrosion time but promotes localized dissolution and structural disintegration. Here, we introduce a pre-stripping protocol consisting of a brief low-current stripping step followed immediately by higher-current bulk stripping, thereby establishing a uniform initial dissolution front while limiting the duration of Li–Cu galvanic coupling. Measurements across representative electrolyte formulations identify three factors associated with the balance between morphological regulation and corrosion loss: nascent solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) passivation, longer-term corrosion tolerance, and dynamic reaction area evolution. In strongly passivating formulations, the morphological benefit of prestripping outweighs the additional corrosion loss and improves Li reversibility. The protocol was further evaluated in 1 Ah anode-free pouch cells, supporting its applicability to practical cell configurations.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극(anode-free) 리튬 금속 전지에서 리튬 용해와 Li-Cu 갈바닉 부식의 trade-off를 해소하는 프리스트리핑 프로토콜을 제안했다. 짧은 저전류 스트리핑 후 고전류 벌크 스트리핑을 적용해 균일한 용해 전면을 형성하고 부식 노출 시간을 줄여, 1 Ah 파우치셀에서도 리튬 가역성이 개선됨을 확인했다.

papers.title: Internal Stress Effects on Electrode Stability in Coin Cells with Different Assembly Configurations
papers.abstract_en: Laboratory-level evaluation of electrode materials is typically conducted using hand-assembled coin cells (half cells) with a lithium metal counter electrode. However, the lack of standardized protocols for coin cell assembly across global laboratories results in inconsistent experimental outcomes, hindering data comparability and scientific progress in battery research. Herein, through fully automated robotic assembly of cells, we systematically investigated the influence of two different yet widely adopted cell configurations (spring and spacer located on the sides of the positive electrode cap and negative electrode cap are labeled as SS-P and SS-N, respectively) on the electrode materials. Different stress distributions were found on the electrodes due to the internal structural discrepancies, leading to variations in electrochemical performance, electrode structure, and electrode–electrolyte interphase properties. This work emphasizes the critical need to raise awareness about the standardization of battery assembly protocols, enabling researchers to fabricate coin cells with high repeatability and consistency.
papers.summary_ko: 완전 자동화된 로봇 조립을 통해 코인셀의 스프링/스페이서 배치 구성 차이가 전극에 미치는 내부 응력 분포를 체계적으로 분석했다. 조립 구성에 따라 전극 구조와 전극-전해질 계면 특성이 달라짐을 확인하며, 배터리 연구 재현성을 위한 조립 프로토콜 표준화의 필요성을 강조했다.

papers.title: Hierarchical Order‐Disorder Architecture Enables Reversible Mg–N Coordination in Prussian Blue Analogues for Aqueous Mg Ion Storage
papers.abstract_en: Prussian blue analogues (PBAs) are promising cathodes for aqueous magnesium ion batteries (AMIBs), yet their Mg 2+ storage chemistry is commonly limited by weak interaction between divalent Mg 2+ and the rigid cyanide‐bridged framework. Herein, we present a hierarchical order‐disorder engineering strategy to reshape the local coordination chemistry of FeCo‐PBA through Sn/Mn regulation. The resulting FeCoSnMn‐PBA integrates a long‐range ordered Fe─C≡N─M framework with short‐range disordered coordination domains, simultaneously preserving framework stability and electronically activating framework N sites. In situ Raman spectroscopy, charge density difference analysis, in situ XRD, and electronic structure calculations reveal that the activated N sites enable a reversible Mg─N coordination‐mediated storage mechanism, moving beyond conventional interstitial Mg 2+ accommodation in PBA cathodes. This coordination‐regulated chemistry promotes homogeneous Mg 2+ storage, rapid charge and mass transfer, and highly reversible lattice evolution. Consequently, the FeCoSnMn‐PBA//activated carbon (AC) hybrid device delivers 149.4 mAh g −1 at 0.1 A g −1 and retains 72.9 mAh g −1 after 5000 cycles at 1.0 A g −1. A FeCoSnMn‐PBA//perylene‐3,4,9,10‐tetracarboxylic dianhydride (PTCDA) full cell further demonstrates stable Mg 2+ storage. This work establishes local structure regulation as a powerful route to modulate coordination‐mediated multivalent ion storage in PBA frameworks.
papers.summary_ko: FeCo 프러시안블루 유사체(PBA)에 Sn/Mn을 도입해 장거리 질서와 단거리 무질서가 공존하는 계층적 구조를 형성함으로써 수계 마그네슘이온전지용 양극의 Mg-N 배위 기반 저장 메커니즘을 구현한 연구로, 리튬·소듐 계열이 아닌 Mg 이온전지 전극에 관한 것이다.

papers.title: Halide Anions Regulate the Self‐Assembly of HPMC Coating on PP Separator to Synergistically Modulate Weak Solvation Structure and Anode Interface to Enhance Lithium Metal Battery
papers.abstract_en: Modifying the separator is the most straightforward strategy to stabilizing lithium metal batteries (LMBs). This work presents a functional coating separator fabricated through halide anion (Cl −, Br −, and I −)‐regulated self‐assembly of hydroxypropyl methylcellulose (HPMC) on PP separator, achieving the dual modulation of Li + solvation structure and anode interfacial chemistry. Cl − induces a chiral nematic liquid crystal (CLC) structure with an optimal helical pitch, enabling ordered Li + transport and uniform deposition. Br − gives an intermediate pitch with slightly inferior performance, while I − causes an overly large pitch that disrupts transport channels and contribute to inhomogeneous lithium deposition. Halide anions can be incorporated into the Li + solvation sheath, weakening Li + ‐solvent interactions to form an anion‐dominated structure that lowers the desolvation barrier. Moreover, a hybrid solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) layer enriched in LiF with LiCl, LiBr, and LiI forms on the anode, respectively, offering high mechanical robustness and ionic conductivity to suppress dendrites. Consequently, the H‐Cl@PP‐based Li||LiFePO 4 cell delivers 103.8% capacity retention after 400 cycles at 1 C, while the high‐voltage Li||NCM811 cells incorporating H‐Cl@PP and H‐Br@PP retain 66.1% and 66.5% after 300 cycles at 0.5 C. This work provides new insights into separator engineering for synergistic regulation of Li + coordination environment and interfacial chemistry.
papers.summary_ko: PP 분리막에 할라이드 음이온(Cl-, Br-, I-)으로 조절한 하이드록시프로필 메틸셀룰로오스(HPMC) 자기조립 코팅을 적용해 Li+ 솔베이션 구조와 음극 계면화학을 동시에 조절했다. Cl-은 최적의 나선 피치를 가진 키랄 네마틱 액정 구조를 유도해 질서있는 Li+ 전달과 균일한 증착을 이끌며, 할라이드 음이온이 솔베이션 셸에 편입되어 탈솔베이션 장벽을 낮추고 LiF/LiCl/LiBr/LiI가 풍부한 혼합 SEI를 형성해 덴드라이트를 억제한다. H-Cl@PP 적용 Li||LiFePO4 셀은 1C 400사이클 후 103.8%의 용량유지율을, 고전압 Li||NCM811 셀은 0.5C 300사이클 후 각각 66.1%, 66.5%의 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Gating Oxygen Flux in High‐Nickel Layered Cathodes via a Surface‐Bulk Oxygen‐Fixation Framework
papers.abstract_en: High‐Ni layered oxide cathodes suffer from severe high‐voltage degradation driven by oxygen‐vacancy evolution, lattice oxygen release, and interfacial reconstruction. Here, a LaCeNb 6 O 18 ‐modified LiNi 0.867 Co 0.103 Mn 0.003 O 2 cathode is designed to establish an oxygen‐fixation‐gate (OFG) framework for regulating oxygen flux across the surface‐bulk region. The modified cathode establishes a spatial oxygen‐fixation‐gate framework, integrating bulk oxygen locking by Nb, surface oxygen retention by La/Ce, and interfacial oxygen buffering by the oxygen‐vacancy‐rich layer. STEM, depth‐resolved XPS, XAS, DEMS, EPR, in situ XRD, and DFT calculations reveal that this coupled regulation stabilizes both oxygen chemistry and structural evolution. Specifically, the oxygen‐vacancy formation energy at the fully delithiated state increases from 1.13 to 1.31 eV, O 2 evolution during initial high‐voltage charging is nearly eliminated, and oxygen‐defect accumulation during cycling is markedly restrained. Consequently, the optimized 867‐LCNO0.5 cathode delivers 158.15 mAh g −1 at 10 C, retains 87.23% capacity after 200 cycles, and maintains 80.03% retention after 200 cycles at 4.5 V vs. Li/Li +. This work establishes a spatially programmed oxygen‐fixation framework integrating bulk lattice oxygen locking, surface/subsurface oxygen anchoring, and interfacial oxygen‐vacancy buffering.
papers.summary_ko: 고니켈 층상양극(LiNi0.867Co0.103Mn0.003O2)의 고전압 퇴화를 막기 위해 LaCeNb6O18로 표면을 개질해 Nb에 의한 벌크 산소 고정, La/Ce에 의한 표면 산소 유지, 산소공공층에 의한 계면 산소 버퍼링이 결합된 산소고정게이트(OFG) 구조를 설계했다. 이 구조는 완전 탈리튬 상태의 산소공공 형성에너지를 1.13→1.31 eV로 높여 고전압 충전 중 O2 발생을 거의 없애고 산소결함 축적을 억제한다. 최적화된 양극은 10C에서 158.15 mAh g-1을 내고 200사이클 후 87.23%, 4.5V 조건 200사이클 후 80.03%의 용량유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Function‐Decoupled Dual‐Anion Doping via Site‐Preferential Regulation Enables High‐Performance Lithium Argyrodite Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: All‐solid‐state lithium metal batteries adopting argyrodite‐type sulfide solid‐state electrolytes (SSEs) offer enhanced safety and energy density, yet face challenges in balancing ionic conductivity, air stability and interfacial compatibility. Herein, we pioneer a precursor‐directed site‐preferential dual‐anion doping strategy to address these trade‐offs. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal the oxygen precursor dictates the predominant anion occupancy: Li 2 O kinetically favors O at the 4d sites, whereas P 2 O 5 preferentially directs O to the 16e sites. Guided by this principle, Li 6 PS 4.2 O 0.4 Se 0.4 Cl (LPSOSeCl) SSEs is designed, wherein O preferentially enriches 16e sites to enhance air stability and widen the electrochemical window for high‐voltage cathode compatibility, whereas Se preferentially enriches 4d sites to compensate ionic conductivity and promote a Li 2 Se/Li 2 O‐rich interphase for dendrite suppression. Ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations combined with radial distribution functions (RDFs) further reveal that the Se/O co‐doping facilitates the formation of a stable Li/SSE interface, significantly inhibiting LPSOSeCl SSE reduction. The resulting LPSOSeCl SSE achieves high ionic conductivity, excellent moist air stability and remarkable critical current density (CCD) of 2.6 mA cm −2. The Li||Li symmetric cells demonstrate ultralong cycling stability over 4000 h at 0.2 mA cm −2 and LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 full cells rentain 70.7% capacity retention after 500 cycles at 0.3C.
papers.summary_ko: 아지로다이트형 황화물 고체전해질의 이온전도도-대기안정성-계면 호환성 트레이드오프를 해결하기 위해 전구체(Li2O vs P2O5)가 O의 4d/16e 자리 선점을 좌우한다는 DFT 결과를 바탕으로, O는 16e 자리에 Se는 4d 자리에 선택적으로 도핑된 Li6PS4.2O0.4Se0.4Cl(LPSOSeCl)을 설계했다. O 도핑은 대기안정성과 고전압 양극 호환성을 높이고 Se 도핑은 이온전도도를 보완하며 Li2Se/Li2O가 풍부한 계면을 형성해 덴드라이트를 억제, AIMD 시뮬레이션으로 Se/O 공도핑이 Li/SSE 계면에서 전해질 환원을 억제함을 확인했다. 이 SSE는 높은 임계전류밀도(2.6 mA cm-2)와 Li 대칭셀 4000시간 이상의 초장기 안정성을 보였고, LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 전지에서도 우수한 용량유지율을 나타냈다.

papers.title: Foreign‐Element‐Free Lattice Reorganization Constructs Multi‐Scale Heterostructure for Stable Oxygen Redox in Li‐Rich Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Lithium‐rich manganese‐based layered oxide (LRMO) suffers from rapid capacity fading caused by structural degradation induced by irreversible lattice oxygen release, which severely hinders its commercialization. Here, we propose a citric acid‐assisted solution infiltration and in situ lattice reconstruction strategy to simultaneously construct a uniform rock‐salt/layered intergrowth layer on the surface and discrete nano‐rock‐salt domains in the bulk of Li 1.2 Mn 0.54 Ni 0.13 Co 0.13 O 2. Theoretical calculations and experimental characterizations collectively reveal that this multi‐scale heterostructure thermodynamically suppresses irreversible oxygen release by raising the oxygen vacancy formation energy from 1.36 to 2.19 eV, via strong hybridization between low‐valence Ni 2+ and oxygen ions. Meanwhile, the bulk nano‐rock‐salt domains serve as structural anchors, buffering anisotropic lattice strain through a mechanical anchoring effect and inhibiting the nucleation and propagation of microcracks. Furthermore, in situ XRD and EIS analyses demonstrate that this structure effectively alleviates lattice distortion during cycling, enhances interfacial stability, and improves Li + diffusion kinetics. Consequently, the modified cathode exhibits significantly enhanced electrochemical performance, achieving a capacity retention of 82.3% after 300 cycles at 1 C and delivering an excellent discharge capacity of 145.2 mAh·g −1 at 10 C. This study provides a feasible design strategy and theoretical basis for developing high‐stability, long‐life LRMO through heterostructure engineering.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬리치 망간계 층상산화물(Li1.2Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2)의 비가역적 격자산소 방출에 의한 용량저하를 막기 위해 구연산 보조 용액침투와 인시튜 격자재구성을 통해 표면에 균일한 암염/층상 혼성층을, 벌크에는 분산된 나노암염 영역을 동시에 형성했다. 이 다중스케일 이종구조는 저가 Ni2+와 산소의 강한 혼성화를 통해 산소공공 형성에너지를 1.36→2.19 eV로 높여 비가역적 산소 방출을 열역학적으로 억제하며, 벌크의 나노암염 영역은 이방성 격자 변형을 완충해 미세균열 발생·전파를 억제한다. 개질된 양극은 1C 300사이클 후 82.3%의 용량유지율과 10C에서 145.2 mAh g-1의 방전용량을 보였다.

papers.title: Fluorination‑driven σ‑bonding design enables practical aqueous zinc-vanadium‑oxide batteries
papers.abstract_en: Vanadium-based positive electrodes for aqueous batteries offer high-capacity, low-cost energy storage but are limited by vanadium dissolution and sluggish kinetics. Amorphization alleviates kinetic limitations by creating open ion-transport pathways, yet vanadium dissolution remains unresolved. Here, we propose a coordination-engineering strategy that stabilizes amorphous vanadium oxides via fluorine incorporation, thereby suppressing vanadium dissolution without compromising fast ion-transport kinetics. Replacing O 2- with highly electronegative F - converts labile σ + π V-O coordination into robust σ-dominated V-F coordination. The resulting V-F bonding weakens interactions with H 2 O and suppresses water-induced degradation, whereas the comparable ionic radii of F - and O 2- allow substitution without perturbing amorphous framework, preserving fast ion transport. Consequently, aqueous zinc-ion batteries assembled with the fluorinated amorphous vanadium oxide positive electrode exhibit fast kinetics and long-term cycling stability, delivering a high specific capacity of 155.6 mAh g −1 at 200 A g −1 , stable cycling for up to 70,000 cycles at 100 A g −1 , and durable operation at 0.1 A g −1 (20 mg cm −2 ) for over six months. This work shows that fluorine-induced reconstruction of the local coordination environment can resolve the stability-kinetics trade-off in amorphous electrodes, providing a microscopic-to-macroscopic design principle for aqueous batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 아연-바나듐 산화물 전지의 바나듐 용해 문제를 해결하기 위해 불소를 도입한 코디네이션 엔지니어링 전략을 제시했다. O2-를 F-로 치환하여 V-F 결합을 형성함으로써 물과의 상호작용을 약화시키면서도 비정질 구조의 빠른 이온 전달 경로는 유지하여, 고전류에서도 장기 사이클 안정성을 확보했다.

papers.title: Fast‐Discharge‐Induced Non‐Equilibrium Phase Transition in Ni‐Rich Layered Oxide Cathode at High Voltage
papers.abstract_en: The rapid adoption of electric vehicles necessitates lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) that can sustain extreme fast charging (XFC) without rapid degradation. Ni-rich layered cathodes deliver high energy density, yet their poor stability under high-rate operation limits practical deployment and the mechanistic origin of fast capacity decay remains poorly understood. Here, using high time-resolved operando XRD, together with theoretical analyses, we reveal that a rate-dependent non-equilibrium H3→H2 phase transition under rapid discharge (≥4 C) induces huge lattice displacement and nanoscale strain, which significantly lower the migration barrier for Ni, thereby promoting irreversible rock-salt phase formation and structural collapse. Importantly, guided by this mechanistic understanding, we propose a cycling protocol introducing a brief low-rate discharge step at high voltage (4.5 V→4.0 V), which effectively suppresses the detrimental H2+H3 phase separation and generation of internal stress. Compared to that of the cell under constant high cycling rates (6 C), the capacity retention improves 29% for the one with optimized discharge procedure after 1000 cycles. These results clarify the underneath electrochemical-mechanical degradation behavior of Ni-rich layered cathodes at different rates (1/3 C, 1 C, 4 C, and 6 C), providing practical guidance for designing durable batteries with superior fast-charging abilities.
papers.summary_ko: 고시간분해 오퍼랜도 XRD와 이론 분석을 통해 Ni-rich 층상 산화물 양극이 급속 방전(4C 이상) 시 겪는 비평형 H3→H2 상전이 메커니즘을 규명했다. 이 상전이가 격자 변위와 나노스케일 변형을 유발해 Ni 이동 장벽을 낮추고 비가역적 암염상 형성을 촉진함을 밝히고, 고전압에서 짧은 저속 방전 단계를 추가하는 사이클링 프로토콜로 1000회 후 용량 유지율을 29% 개선했다.

papers.title: Engineering Porous Nano‐SiO 2 From Clay Minerals via a Machine Learning Framework for High‐Performance Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Porous nano‐SiO 2 with well‐developed pore structures and unique surface chemistry is highly desirable across multiple fields, yet its synthesis from clay minerals involves intricate multi‐parameter interactions that challenge conventional optimization. Herein, we developed a machine learning (ML)‐based framework that integrates predictive modeling, interpretability analysis, and domain adaptation to accelerate the synthesis of high‐specific‐surface‐area (SSA) porous nano‐SiO 2. Using montmorillonite (Mnt) as the precursor, the optimized Random Forest model guided the synthesis of amorphous, silanol‐rich porous nano‐SiO 2 with an exceptional SSA of 747.1 m 2 g −1, surpassing most previously reported clay‐derived nano‐SiO 2. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) identified key process descriptors, while experimental investigations revealed that the high SSA originates from a balance between pore formation and framework collapse. Through residual learning with only 20 additional samples, the framework was effectively adapted to black talc (BTlc) and palygorskite (Pal). Additionally, the optimized clay‐derived nano‐SiO 2 was employed as a porous buffer layer on the Na anode and a separator modifier, exhibiting improved interfacial stability and Na + regulation capabilities, demonstrating its potential for energy storage applications. This work establishes a data‐driven pathway for ML‐accelerated clay mineral valorization toward functional nanomaterial synthesis.
papers.summary_ko: 점토광물(몬모릴로나이트)로부터 다공성 나노SiO2를 합성하는 복잡한 다변수 공정을 가속화하기 위해 예측모델링·해석·도메인적응을 결합한 머신러닝 프레임워크를 개발했다. 최적화된 랜덤포레스트 모델로 유도한 비정질·실라놀이 풍부한 나노SiO2는 비표면적 747.1 m2 g-1을 달성해 기존 점토유래 나노SiO2를 상회했으며, SHAP 분석으로 핵심 공정 변수를 규명하고 단 20개의 추가 샘플로 블랙탈크·팔리고스카이트 등 다른 점토로 전이학습이 가능함을 보였다. 이 나노SiO2를 소듐 금속 음극의 다공성 버퍼층 및 분리막 개질제로 적용해 계면 안정성과 Na+ 조절 능력이 향상됨을 확인했다.

papers.title: Dilute Configurational Frustration Enables Reversible Jahn–Teller Strain Accommodation in ZnMn 2 O 4 Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Jahn–Teller distortion is a major origin of instability in Mn 3+ ‐containing cathodes, yet most stabilization strategies aim to suppress local MnO 6 distortion. Structural degradation, however, also depends critically on whether the associated lattice strain is reversibly relaxed or accumulates as residual deformation during cycling. Here, we introduce dilute configurational frustration to regulate Jahn–Teller‐associated strain in spinel ZnMn 2 O 4 cathodes for aqueous zinc‐ion batteries. Dilute Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, and Al substitution creates chemically inequivalent local coordination environments while preserving the Mn‐rich spinel framework. This local chemical heterogeneity disrupts the spatial correlation of Jahn–Teller responses to curb persistent strain accumulation, while an elevated Mn valence concurrently reinforces local coordination by mitigating intrinsic distortion susceptibility. As a result, the multication‐regulated cathode exhibits enhanced structural recovery, reduced residual deformation, and better‐preserved Mn─O coordination. Consequently, it retains 112.8 mAh g −1 after 3000 cycles at 2 A g −1 with over 80% capacity retention. These results establish reversible strain accommodation, rather than complete suppression of lattice distortion, as an effective route for stabilizing Jahn–Teller‐active cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: 스피넬 ZnMn2O4 수계 아연이온전지 양극에서 Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Al을 희박 치환해 국소 배위환경을 화학적으로 불균일하게 만들어 얀-텔러 변형이 비가역적으로 축적되는 것을 억제한 연구로, 리튬·소듐 계열이 아닌 아연이온전지 전극에 관한 것이다.

papers.title: Contouring mitigates voiding at the lithium/ceramic electrolyte interface on discharging solid-state batteries
papers.abstract_en: Interfacial void formation during discharge limits the practical performance of lithium metal solid-state batteries. Here we show that introducing an egg-box topography at the Li/Li 6 PS 5 Cl interface increases the discharge current at which voiding commences tenfold, from 0.2 to 2 mA cm −2 at 2 MPa and 30 °C. The contoured interface also sustains pulsed currents up to 3 mA cm −2 at 30 °C and 8 mA cm −2 at 60 °C without cell failure. Under these conditions, it does not completely eliminate void formation but suppresses void growth and associated voltage polarization. Consequently, it sustains discharge profiles derived from the Worldwide Harmonized Light Vehicles Test Procedure, representing realistic electric vehicle driving demands, whereas non-contoured interfaces fail rapidly. A full cell with a thin contoured solid electrolyte retains this advantage over its non-contoured counterpart. Contouring the Li/solid electrolyte interface is therefore an effective strategy for enabling practically relevant discharge rates in solid-state batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속/세라믹 고체전해질(Li6PS5Cl) 계면에서 방전 시 발생하는 공극(void) 형성을 억제하기 위해 egg-box 형태의 윤곽 구조를 도입했다. 이 구조는 공극이 시작되는 방전 전류 밀도를 10배 높이고 펄스 전류에서도 셀 실패 없이 견디며, 실제 전기차 주행 조건을 모사한 방전 프로파일에서도 윤곽 없는 계면 대비 우수한 성능을 유지했다.

papers.title: An Adsorption‐Driven Solvophobic Interface for Stable Lithium‐Rich Manganese‐Based Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Lithium‐rich manganese‐based (LRMO) oxides represent the premier cathode candidates for next‐generation high‐energy‐density batteries due to high specific capacity exceeding 300 mAh g −1. However, the practical deployment of LRMO cathodes under high voltages (>4.8 V) is severely hindered by severe electrolyte oxidation and transition‐metal (TM) dissolution. Herein, perfluorobutanesulfonyl fluoride (NfF) is introduced as a multifunctional additive to construct a robust solvophobic interphase on LRMO cathodes. The ‐SO 2 F group preferentially anchors to exposed TM sites, suppressing metal dissolution, while the perfluorinated chain excludes free solvent molecules from the cathode surface and mitigates oxidative electrolyte decomposition. The resulting inorganic‐rich (LiF/Li x SO y) engineered interface mitigates the irreversible layered‐to‐spinel phase transition and inhibits TM crosstalk to the lithium metal anode, ensuring exceptional structural integrity and rapid ionic transport kinetics. Consequently, Li||LRMO coin cells sustain over 1000 cycles at 3 C. The Li||LRMO full cells based on a 40 µm lithium anode and cathode loading of 8 mg cm −2 retain 173 mAh g −1 after 110 cycles. Moreover, the 1.2 Ah Li||LRMO pouch cells achieve 88% capacity retention after 50 cycles at 4.8 V. This work demonstrates solvophobic interphase engineering as an effective strategy for stabilizing high‐voltage cathodes through coordinated regulation of interfacial chemistry and electrolyte accessibility.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬리치 망간계(LRMO) 양극의 고전압(>4.8V) 구동 시 전해질 산화와 전이금속 용출을 막기 위해 과불화부탄설포닐플루오라이드(NfF) 첨가제로 솔보포빅 계면을 형성했다. -SO2F 기가 노출된 전이금속 자리에 우선 결합해 금속 용출을 억제하고 과불화 사슬이 자유 용매분자를 양극 표면에서 배제해 산화 분해를 줄이며, 생성된 LiF/LixSOy 중심의 무기질 계면이 층상-스피넬 상전이를 억제하고 리튬금속 음극으로의 전이금속 크로스토크도 차단한다. Li||LRMO 코인셀은 3C에서 1000사이클 이상 지속됐고 40 μm 리튬 음극을 적용한 전지는 110사이클 후 173 mAh g-1을, 1.2 Ah 파우치셀은 4.8V·50사이클에서 88%의 용량유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: 4 V‐Class Calcium‐Based Water‐in‐Salt Electrolyte for Aqueous Calcium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: We report the first systematic investigation and demonstration of calcium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide (Ca(TFSI) 2) as a water‐in‐salt electrolyte for aqueous calcium‐ion batteries (CIBs). At its solubility limit (6.2 m), Ca(TFSI) 2 exhibits a surprisingly wide electrochemical stability window (ESW) of 4.19 V, notably with the cathodic limit extending to ‐2.52 V vs Ag/AgCl, significantly surpassing previously reported Ca‐based aqueous electrolytes. Spectroscopic characterization combined with molecular simulations reveals a distinctive solvation structure in which Ca 2+ coordinates oxygen atoms from both H 2 O and TFSI − within the first coordination shell, with an average coordination number of 7. Extensive ion association is also evident through solvent‐shared ion pairs, consistent with suppressed water activity and an expanded ESW. Furthermore, the addition of a small amount of acetonitrile enables the electrolyte to remain liquid at sub‐zero temperatures, while lowering viscosity and enhancing ionic conductivity without substantially disrupting the Ca 2+ solvation structure. Leveraging these electrolyte properties, full cells employing perylene‐3,4,9,10‐tetracarboxylic diimide or Sn anodes and a Prussian blue analogue cathode demonstrate robust electrochemical performance at −20°C, including operation over a 3.2 V window with the Sn‐based cell, with long‐term cycling stability and sub‐zero device operation. These findings establish Ca(TFSI) 2 ‐based water‐in‐salt electrolytes as a versatile platform for wide‐voltage, low‐temperature aqueous CIBs.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 칼슘이온전지용 water-in-salt 전해질로 Ca(TFSI)2를 체계적으로 검증해 용해한계(6.2 m)에서 4.19V의 넓은 전기화학안정성 창을 구현한 연구로, 리튬·소듐 계열이 아닌 칼슘이온전지 전해질에 관한 것이다.

papers.title: Synergistic Interfacial and Subsurface Stabilization of O3‐Type Na‐Ni‐Fe‐Mn‐O Cathodes through Integrated Zr Modification
papers.abstract_en: Surface degradation, electrolyte‐derived hydrogen fluoride (HF) attack, and anisotropic phase evolution limit the stability of O3‐type sodium cathodes. An integrated Zr‐based surface/subsurface strategy is developed for Na[Ni 0.3 Fe 0.3 Mn 0.4 ]O 2 (NFM). Treatment at 800°C converts residual Na 2 CO 3 /NaOH into a Na 2 ZrO 3 ‐rich surface nanolayer, accompanied by limited near‐surface Zr incorporation. In hard‐carbon full cells, NFM‐Zr‐800 delivers ∼150 mAh g −1 with ∼87% initial Coulombic efficiency and retains 61.8% capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C, compared with 26.4% for bare NFM. Operando X‐ray diffraction shows reduced anisotropic lattice variation during the P3‐to‐OP2 transition. X‐ray absorption spectroscopy, Mössbauer spectroscopy, and hybrid‐functional calculations indicate Ni/Fe‐dominated cationic redox, nearly tetravalent Mn, and no major lattice‐oxygen redox contribution. Coulomb–Buckingham calculations suggest that Zr incorporation at Mn sites is energetically favored near the surface within the adopted model. The Na 2 ZrO 3 ‐rich layer mitigates HF‐related interfacial degradation and promotes a Zr–F‐containing protective interface, suppressing transition‐metal dissolution, cathode–electrolyte interphase thickening, particle cracking, and surface reconstruction. These coupled interfacial and structural effects improve the long‐term stability of O3‐type NFM cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: O3형 Na[Ni0.3Fe0.3Mn0.4]O2 소듐 양극재의 표면과 subsurface에 Zr을 통합 도입하여 안정성을 개선한 연구이다. 800°C 열처리로 잔류 Na2CO3/NaOH를 Na2ZrO3가 풍부한 표면 나노층으로 전환시키고 근표면에 Zr을 일부 도핑하였다. 하드카본 완전셀에서 0.5C, 500회 사이클 후 용량 유지율이 61.8%로 미도핑 소재(26.4%) 대비 크게 향상되었으며, Na2ZrO3층이 HF 공격과 전이금속 용출을 억제함을 확인하였다.

papers.title: Electrolyte‐Facing Interfacial Engineering of Organic‐Inorganic Hybrid Cathodes for High‐Capacity and Stable Lithium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: The distinct chemical reactivities of organic and inorganic active materials toward electrolytes are generally considered a major source of interfacial instability, yet this disparity can be leveraged as a powerful design principle for hybrid cathodes. Herein, we exploit this chemical contrast by spatially and interfacially regulating which active material is exposed to the electrolyte. This strategy is demonstrated in a hybrid cathode comprising high‐crystallinity LiFePO 4 nanoparticles (LFP NPs) and iodine‐doped nickel phthalocyanine (I‐NiPc), assembled through well‐defined interfacial interactions without inactive binders. The electrolyte‐facing LFP layer facilitates the formation of a thin, stable cathode–electrolyte interphase (CEI), thereby suppressing dissolution and parasitic reactions of the underlying I‐NiPc while enabling complementary electrochemical functions of the organic and inorganic components. Consequently, the LFP NP/I‐NiPc composite cathode retains 94.6% of its initial capacity after 3000 cycles at 400 mA g −1 . Increasing the fraction of the high‐capacity organic component while preserving the LFP‐terminated interface further boosts the specific capacity to 427 mAh g −1 and the specific energy to 1091 Wh kg −1 on an active‐material basis, while maintaining 93.9% capacity retention over 2000 cycles. These results establish electrolyte‐facing interface control as an effective strategy for stabilizing and maximizing the performance of organic–inorganic hybrid cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: LiFePO4 나노입자와 아이오딘 도핑 니켈 프탈로시아닌(I-NiPc)을 결합한 유기-무기 하이브리드 양극을 설계하였다. 전해질과 접하는 표면에 LFP를 배치해 얇고 안정적인 CEI를 형성시켜 하부 I-NiPc의 용해와 부반응을 억제하였다. 400 mA/g에서 3000회 사이클 후 94.6% 용량을 유지했고, 유기물 비율을 높인 구성에서는 427 mAh/g, 1091 Wh/kg(활물질 기준)의 에너지밀도와 2000회 사이클 후 93.9% 용량 유지율을 달성하였다.

papers.title: Cationic Potential‐Guided Li/K Co‐Doping Enables Fast‐Charging Layered Oxide Cathodes for Sodium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Developing O3‐type layered oxide cathodes combining fast charging, high capacity, and structural stability remains challenging for sodium‐ion batteries. Here, a cationic‐potential‐guided Li + /K + co‐doping strategy is employed to synthesize Na 0.9 Li 0.05 K 0.05 N i0.317 Fe 0.317 Mn 0.317 O 2 (LKNFM) through a precursor‐assisted solid‐state ball‐milling route. Neutron diffraction reveals preferential K + occupation in alkali layers and Li + distribution across alkali and transition‐metal layers, regulating interlayer interactions and local coordination. LKNFM delivers 181.6 mAh g −1 at 0.1C and maintains 82.7 mAh g −1 after 1000 cycles at 20C, corresponding to 89.3% capacity retention. LKNFM/hard carbon full cell retains over 80% capacity after 1000 cycles. Operando XRD reveals a simplified, reversible O3↔P3 transition with reduced lattice strain. Ex situ XANES and WT‐EXAFS indicate predominantly Ni/Fe‐based charge compensation, while Mn mainly stabilizes the framework. DFT suggests cooperative cationic–anionic charge compensation at high voltage, while CI‐NEB calculations show a reduction in the Na + migration barrier from 1.21 to 0.80 eV along the investigated pathway. These findings highlight site‐selective co‐doping as a promising approach to structurally stable, fast‐charging sodium‐ion battery cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: 양이온 전위 기반 Li+/K+ 공동 도핑으로 O3형 층상 소듐 양극재 Na0.9Li0.05K0.05Ni0.317Fe0.317Mn0.317O2(LKNFM)를 합성하였다. 중성자 회절로 K+는 알칼리층에, Li+는 알칼리층과 전이금속층에 분포함을 확인했으며, 0.1C에서 181.6 mAh/g, 20C로 1000회 사이클 후 89.3% 용량 유지율을 달성하였다. DFT 계산 결과 Na+ 이동 장벽이 1.21에서 0.80 eV로 감소하여 고속충전이 가능한 구조적으로 안정한 소듐이온 양극재 설계 전략을 제시하였다.

papers.title: Interacting Cosolvents-Regulated Solvation for Rapid Quasi-Solid–State Sulfur Reactions in Li–S Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Enabling a quasi-solid-state sulfur reaction (QSSSR) using sparingly solvating electrolytes (SSEs) represents a promising venue for lean-electrolyte and high-energy lithium–sulfur (Li–S) batteries. However, impeded charge transfer at the sulfur surface owed to weak solvation results in slow solid–solid conversion kinetics. Here we describe an electrolyte using dipole-interacting binary solvents with distinct solvation capability that decouples electrolyte bulk solvation thermodynamics from the Li-polysulfide solvation at the reaction site─the electrode surface. This is achieved by combining moderately solvating tetrahydrofuran (THF) with weakly solvating cyclopentyl methyl ether (CPME), wherein the outer solvation shell of dipole-interacting CPME-THF preserves weak solvation for Li-polysulfides, and importantly, a fraction of THF participates in the first solvation shell and encourages solvation of the dynamically generated solvated Li-polysulfide intermediates, promoting a rapid solution-mediated reaction at the surface. Our study shows that the altered interfacial reaction kinetics redirects sulfur speciation toward growth of three-dimensional Li2S and textured β-S8 upon discharge/charge. The Li–S cell delivers a capacity of 5.2 mA h cm–2 with an electrolyte/sulfur (E/S) ratio of 3 μL mg–1, and stable cycling of a 2.44 A h prototype pouch cell is demonstrated. These results highlight a molecular cosolvent design strategy that reconciles bulk dissolution and surface reaction kinetics for rapid QSSSR.
papers.summary_ko: 희박 전해질(SSE) 기반 준고체 황 반응(QSSSR)에서 느린 고체-고체 전환 속도를 해결하기 위해, THF와 CPME를 조합한 쌍극자 상호작용 바이너리 공용매 전해질을 설계했다. 외곽 솔베이션 셀은 리튬 폴리설파이드에 대해 약한 솔베이션을 유지하면서 THF 일부가 첫 번째 솔베이션 셀에 참여해 중간체 용해를 촉진, 표면에서 빠른 용액 매개 반응을 가능하게 한다. 이를 통해 E/S 비 3 μL/mg에서 5.2 mAh/cm²의 용량을 구현했고 2.44 Ah 파우치셀에서 안정적인 사이클링을 입증했다.

papers.title: Functionalized Interface Engineering of Cellulose-Based Electrolytes for Safety and Long-Life Li–Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Cellulose-based electrolytes are low-cost, eco-friendly solid-state electrolyte candidates owing to renewability and biodegradability. However, their flammability raises safety concerns, and crystallinity leads to low ion conduction. Herein, a dual-functionalization strategy is proposed, which grafts phytic and sulfate groups onto cellulose via a ternary deep eutectic solvent system. Phytic groups provide flame retardancy, and sulfate groups realize fast Li-ion conduction. The resulting electrolyte delivers a Li-ion conductivity (1.48 × 10–3 S cm–1) and an oxidation potential (5.2 V), and the fabricated electrolyte membrane shows a uniform structure, enhanced mechanical flexibility, and strong tensile stress. It also shows good compatibility with the Li metal, enabling stable cycling and long cycle life for solid-state Li–metal cells, including the LiFePO4 and LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 cells over 542 and 409 cycles, respectively. Moreover, this solid-state electrolyte exhibits self-extinguishing properties, helping solid-state cells work stably under extreme thermal conditions. This research offers an approach for developing safe cellulose-based electrolytes for next-generation Li–metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 셀룰로오스 기반 고체 전해질의 가연성과 낮은 이온전도도 문제를 해결하기 위해, 3성분 공융용매 시스템을 이용해 피틱기와 설페이트기를 셀룰로오스에 동시에 그래프팅하는 이중 기능화 전략을 제시했다. 피틱기는 난연성을 부여하고 설페이트기는 빠른 리튬이온 전도(1.48×10⁻³ S/cm)와 5.2V의 산화 전위를 구현한다. 이 전해질은 리튬 금속과의 우수한 계면 적합성을 보여 LiFePO4 및 고니켈 NCM 셀에서 각각 542회, 409회의 장수명 사이클링과 자기소화 특성을 달성했다.

papers.title: Al/F Co‐Doped Sulfide Electrolyte for Durable All‐Solid‐State Lithium‐Organic Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Carbonyl‐containing organic cathodes offer a sustainable route to high‐energy storage, but their reaction with conventional sulfide electrolytes (SEs) causes interfacial degradation in all‐solid‐state lithium‐metal batteries (ASSLMBs). Here we develop an electrolyte‐first strategy that stabilizes both carbonyl cathodes and lithium metal through dual‐site Al/F substitution of an argyrodite SE, Li 5.7 Al 0.1 P 0.9 S 4.5 Cl 1.2 F 0.3 (LPSC‐AF). Hard‐soft acid‐base theory (HSAB) guided local‐bonding reconstruction increases the basicity and hard‐base character of SE ligands, strengthens P‐S coordination and passivates reactive P‐centered sites. Consequently, the 1,2,5,6‐anthracenetetrone (ATO) adsorption energy decreases from −4.41 to −0.15 eV, suppressing interfacial acid‐base coordination, nucleophilic attack and coupled redox reactions. LPSC‐AF retains an ionic conductivity of 3.8 mS cm −1 and supports stable lithium plating/stripping for over 3000 h. ATO‐based ASSLMBs deliver 358.3 mAh g −1 with 100% initial Coulombic efficiency and retain 81% capacity after 2000 cycles at 5 C and 60°C. The approach is also applicable to C4Q cathodes, establishing HSAB‐guided SEs redesign as a route to stable all‐solid‐state lithium‐organic batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 카르보닐 유기 양극과 기존 황화물 고체전해질 간의 계면 반응으로 인한 전고체 리튬금속전지의 성능 저하를 해결하기 위해, 아기로다이트형 황화물 전해질에 Al/F를 이중 치환한 LPSC-AF를 개발했다. HSAB 이론에 기반한 국부 결합 재구성으로 P-S 결합을 강화하고 반응성 높은 P 중심 자리를 패시베이션해 ATO 흡착 에너지를 -4.41에서 -0.15 eV로 낮추며 산-염기 반응과 친핵성 공격을 억제했다. 이 전해질은 3.8 mS/cm의 이온전도도와 3000시간 이상의 안정적인 리튬 플레이팅/스트리핑을 지원하며, ATO 기반 전고체셀은 358.3 mAh/g의 용량과 100% 초기 쿨롱효율, 2000회 사이클 후 81%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Viscoelasticity of synthetic antigen presenting cells reprograms T cell metabolism for TCR-T cell manufacturing and therapy
papers.abstract_en: Adoptive T cell receptor (TCR)–based immunotherapy offers a powerful strategy to target solid tumors. However, how the physical properties of the antigen-presenting interface regulate T cell metabolic programming remains poorly defined. Here we develop synthetic viscoelastic activating cells (SynVAC), artificial antigen-presenting cells whose stress-relaxation kinetics are chemically tuned independently of stiffness and of peptide–MHC (pMHC) and co-stimulatory ligand density. SynVAC-pMHC provides a defined, scalable platform that outperforms monocyte-derived dendritic cells to enrich antigen-specific CD8 + T cells. Fast-relaxing SynVAC-pMHC amplifies TCR signaling and mTOR activity, drives metabolic changes, and programs antigen-specific T cells toward an energetically favorable state with improved memory-like features after expansion. TCR-T cells expanded using fast-relaxing SynVAC-pMHC exhibit superior persistence and durable antitumor activity in melanoma and ovarian cancer models. These results establish cell-mimetic viscoelasticity as a key biophysical cue governing T cell metabolism and differentiation and offer a fully synthetic strategy for manufacturing potent TCR-T cells.
papers.summary_ko: 연구진은 응력 완화 속도를 독립적으로 조절할 수 있는 합성 점탄성 항원제시세포(SynVAC)를 개발했다. 빠르게 응력이 완화되는 SynVAC-pMHC는 TCR 신호전달과 mTOR 활성을 증대시켜 항원특이적 CD8+ T세포의 대사를 에너지 효율적인 상태로 재프로그래밍한다. 이를 통해 제작된 TCR-T 세포는 흑색종과 난소암 모델에서 우수한 지속성과 항종양 효과를 보였다. 배터리와는 무관한 면역세포치료 연구이다.

papers.title: Tuning Ligand Accessibility via Solvation Entropy for Universal Recovery of Spent Ternary Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Industrial recycling of spent lithium-ion batteries is challenged by increasingly heterogeneous feedstocks with highly variable cathode compositions. Such compositional fluctuations undermine selective metal separation and necessitate complex process regulation and excessive chemical consumption. In this study, we develop a high-entropy deep eutectic solvent (HE-DES) through solvation entropy engineering to regulate ligand accessibility and competitive metal-ligand interactions. This facilitates the dissolution of Li, Co, and Mn while selectively enriching Ni in recovered solids from diverse spent NCM cathodes. For NCM111, the metal-normalized Ni fraction reaches 94.40%, with a Ni-to-impurity enrichment ratio of 16.86, approximately 3.6 times that of the low-entropy counterpart. Molecular simulations reveal diversified local solvation structures and reorganized ligand-solvent associations in HE-DES, accompanied by enhanced ligand mobility and distinct Ni/Co coordination environments. Meanwhile, the multicomponent solvent regulates ligand-associated chemical environments at the solid-liquid interface, facilitating selective nickel oxalate formation during cathode dissolution. This work establishes solvent microenvironment engineering as a complementary design principle to conventional ligand engineering, opening new opportunities for selective metal separation in complex multimetal systems.
papers.summary_ko: 폐 삼원계(NCM) 양극재의 불균일한 조성 문제를 해결하기 위해 용매화 엔트로피를 조절한 고엔트로피 deep eutectic solvent(HE-DES)를 개발했다. 이 용매는 Li, Co, Mn을 선택적으로 용해시키면서 Ni을 고형물에 농축시켜 NCM111 기준 Ni 분율 94.40%, 저엔트로피 대비 약 3.6배 높은 Ni/불순물 농축비를 달성했다. 분자 시뮬레이션을 통해 리간드-용매 재구성과 Ni/Co 배위환경 차이가 선택적 분리의 원인임을 규명했다. 폐배터리 금속 회수(재활용) 연구로 7개 토픽 범주에는 해당하지 않는다.

papers.title: Transition-Metal-Mediated Discharge Intermediates Set Anionic-Redox Potentials and Voltage Hysteresis in Li-Rich Cathodes
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Voltage hysteresis arising from anionic redox reactions remains a central bottleneck for lithium-rich cathodes. While ligand-to-metal charge transfer (LMCT) has been invoked to describe the charging pathway, its proposed reverse counterpart, metal-to-ligand charge transfer (MLCT), remains experimentally unresolved during discharge. Here, using cation-disordered rock-salt Li2Ni0.33Ta0.66O3 (LNTO) as a model system, we combine electrochemical relaxation analysis with synchrotron-based spectroscopy to identify, for the first time, a metastable reduction intermediate characterized by Ni(2-δ)+/(O–O)n− during discharge, thereby providing direct experimental validation for the MLCT framework. The discovery of this metastable intermediate demonstrates that discharge proceeds through a two-step electrochemical–chemical pathway, wherein the spontaneous relaxation evolution of the metastable intermediate drives free-energy dissipation and voltage hysteresis. Guided by this picture, Ru substitution was introduced to modulate the cation–anion electronic structure, enabling Ru 4d–O 2p hybridization to generate persistent low-energy hole states that lower the energy of the metastable discharge intermediate and shift O–O dimer reduction to higher potentials. We further show that the discharge intermediate serves as the energetic link through which transition-metal electronic structure governs the effective anionic-redox potential. This work provides a discharge-side thermodynamic framework for understanding and mitigating voltage hysteresis in Li-rich anionic-redox cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: 무질서 암염형 Li2Ni0.33Ta0.66O3(LNTO)를 모델로 하여 방전 시 Ni(2-δ)+/(O–O)n− 준안정 환원 중간체를 처음으로 실험적으로 규명해 금속-리간드 전하전이(MLCT) 경로를 입증했다. 이 중간체의 자발적 이완이 자유에너지 소모와 전압 히스테리시스를 유발함을 밝히고, Ru 치환을 통해 Ru 4d–O 2p 혼성화로 저에너지 정공 상태를 형성시켜 O–O 다이머 환원 전위를 높이는 전략을 제시했다. 전이금속 전자구조가 방전측 음이온 레독스 전위를 결정하는 열역학적 틀을 제공한다.

papers.title: Taming Metal–Electrolyte Interface via Two-Dimensional Organic Metal Chalcogenide Colloids for Anode-Free Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Anode-free metal batteries are promising candidates for next-generation energy storage technologies, yet their application is severely limited by dendrite growth and rapid capacity decay induced by an unstable metal–electrolyte interface. Herein, we propose a “colloid electrolyte” strategy employing coordination polymer nanosheets as electrolyte additives for constructing anode-free sodium metal batteries (AFSMBs). Unlike conventional molecular additives or inert particle suspensions, these colloidal nanosheets provide spatially organized and continuously available interfacial reaction domains, thereby spatially regulating electrolyte component distribution and interfacial reactions. These nanosheets, composed of AgS layers uniformly decorated with fluorinated groups, undergo in situ decomposition at the metal–electrolyte interface. This process generates gradient distributions of Ag nanoparticles and NaF/Na2S species, which guide the spontaneous formation of a functionally graded solid electrolyte interphase (SEI). This hierarchical SEI enables dendrite-free Na deposition and imparts sustained interfacial protection during cycling. Consequently, high-cathode-loading AFSMBs achieve an ultralong lifespan (>1600 cycles), representing a 10-fold improvement over counterpart cells without the colloidal additive. Notably, 0.5-Ah-level anode-free pouch cells exhibit stable cycling for 500 cycles at 2 C. This work establishes coordination polymer colloids as a new class of electrolyte additives for advanced alkali metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극(anode-free) 소듐금속전지의 덴드라이트와 계면 불안정성을 해결하기 위해 불소화 AgS 배위고분자 나노시트를 전해질 첨가제로 사용하는 '콜로이드 전해질' 전략을 제안했다. 이 나노시트는 계면에서 분해되어 Ag 나노입자와 NaF/Na2S로 구성된 구배형 SEI를 형성, 덴드라이트 없는 Na 증착을 유도한다. 고용량 양극을 적용한 무음극 셀은 기존 대비 10배 향상된 1600회 이상의 수명을 보였으며, 0.5 Ah 파우치셀도 2C에서 500회 안정적으로 구동되었다.

papers.title: Stabilizing High‐Voltage Oxygen Holes via π‐Bonding Mediated Frontier‐Orbital Character Inversion in Intermediate‐Regime Oxide Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Oxygen redox chemistry offers a promising route to higher energy densities in layered oxide cathodes. However, it is commonly plagued by unstable O─O dimerization that leads to voltage hysteresis and capacity loss. While oxygen hole can mitigate these degradation pathways, its lower operating voltage results in reduced energy density. Herein, high‐voltage oxygen‐hole states are stabilized in Li 2 RuO 3 through precisely tailoring the Ru─O π‐bonding interaction. The successful modulation arises from a dynamic evolution of the electronic structure during delithiation, the so‐called frontier‐orbital character inversion, which has been experimentally validated through combined analysis of the elemental contributions to states near the Fermi level. Oxygen oxidation subsequently involves an O 2p‐dominated antibonding state, avoiding the pronounced bond destabilization associated with electron removal from bonding orbitals. Such behavior is attributed to the unique position of ruthenates within the intermediate regime between Mott–Hubbard and charge‐transfer insulators. And this specific electronic state positioning facilitates a dynamic transition toward a stable negative charge‐transfer regime. This boundary‐crossing effect is especially pronounced in high‐valent systems owing to intense covalency modulations upon oxidation. These insights establish a clear electronic‐structure‐based design principle, highlighting the importance of orbital engineering in boundary‐regime systems to achieve stable and high‐voltage anionic redox.
papers.summary_ko: 층상 산화물 양극의 산소 레독스 화학은 높은 에너지밀도를 제공하지만 불안정한 O-O 다이머화로 인한 전압 히스테리시스와 용량 손실 문제가 있다. 이 연구는 Li2RuO3에서 Ru-O π결합 상호작용을 정밀 조절해 고전압 산소 홀 상태를 안정화시키며, 탈리튬화 과정에서 프런티어 오비탈 특성 역전이라는 동적 전자구조 변화를 실험적으로 규명했다. 산소 산화가 O 2p 우세 반결합 상태를 통해 일어나 결합 궤도 전자 제거에 따른 불안정화를 피할 수 있음을 보였고, 이는 Mott-Hubbard와 전하이동 절연체 중간 영역에 위치한 루테네이트의 독특한 전자구조 때문임을 밝혔다.

papers.title: Spatial-Mechanical-Chemical Synergy in Inorganic-Shelled Cavities Enables Stable Li–Mg Alloy Anodes
papers.abstract_en: Lithium metal batteries promise ultrahigh energy density yet are plagued by catastrophic lithium dendrites and severe volume expansion. Conventionally, rational three-dimensional (3D) host architectures have been developed to mitigate dendrite proliferation and mechanical stress. However, the structural collapse of lithium-hosting frameworks under dynamic plating/stripping conditions remains a critical bottleneck. Herein, we overcome this limitation by designing a Li-Mg alloy framework integrated with LiNO3 (LMLN), which yields in situ-formed cavities encapsulated by inorganic shells of high ionic conductivity that kinetically guide inward lithium deposition and promote uniform nucleation via tailored interfacial chemistry. The resulting spatial-mechanical-chemical coupling, realized by a scalable roller-pressing process, delivers a triadic synergy of spatially confined deposition, mechanically robust architecture, and chemically functional interfaces. Consequently, LMLN-based lithium metal batteries paired with commercial lithium-sulfur electrolytes and LiFePO4 (LFP) cathodes achieve 95.6% capacity retention over 300 cycles. Notably, a 1 Ah pouch cell pairing an 80 μm LMLN anode with a 17.5 mg cm–2 LFP cathode achieves 85.6% retention over 400 cycles at 1 C alongside intrinsic thermal safety under nail penetration. This dual achievement of superior 1 C cycle life and thermal robustness in 1 Ah LFP-Li metal pouch cells underscores its potential for moderate-rate, low-voltage storage applications.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-마그네슘 합금 프레임워크에 LiNO3를 결합한 LMLN 구조를 설계하여 무기 쉘로 둘러싸인 공극을 형성, 리튬을 내부로 균일하게 유도 증착시켜 덴드라이트와 부피 팽창 문제를 완화했다. 공간-역학-화학적 시너지를 통해 LMLN 기반 리튬금속전지는 Li-S 전해질과 LFP 양극 조합에서 300회 사이클 후 95.6% 용량 유지율을 달성했다. 1 Ah 파우치셀(80 μm LMLN 음극, LFP 양극)은 1C에서 400회 사이클 후 85.6% 유지율과 못 관통 시험에서도 열적 안전성을 보였다.

papers.title: Rethinking Creep in Solid-State Batteries: From a Chemo-mechanical Liability to a Design Parameter
papers.abstract_en: Creep is an inherent time-dependent mechanical response in alkali-metal-based solid-state batteries (SSBs) subjected to sustained stack pressure. Although creep can significantly influence battery performance, its role has often been interpreted narrowly as either a beneficial mechanism for maintaining interfacial contact or a detrimental contributor to cell degradation. In this perspective, we establish a unified conceptual framework by linking sustained loading in the classical definition of creep to stack pressure in SSBs, thereby explaining why creep is intrinsic to their operation. We further argue that creep should be regarded as a chemo-mechanical phenomenon with inherently dual roles, whose competing effects govern the dynamic evolution of electrode–electrolyte interfaces during electrochemical cycling. Finally, we discuss how timescale-based design principles and time-resolved in situ and operando characterization can deepen understanding and guide the rational optimization of creep under practical battery operating conditions, thereby informing the design of durable next-generation alkali-metal SSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 알칼리금속 기반 전고체전지에서 지속적인 스택 압력에 의해 발생하는 크리프(creep) 현상을 단순한 유해 요인이 아니라 설계 변수로 재해석하는 관점 논문이다. 크리프를 고전적 정의의 지속 하중과 연결하여 전고체전지에 내재적인 현상으로 설명하고, 전극-전해질 계면의 동적 변화를 지배하는 화학-역학적 이중 역할을 논의한다. 시간 분해 in situ/operando 특성분석과 시간축 기반 설계 원칙을 통한 차세대 알칼리금속 전고체전지 최적화 방향을 제시한다.

papers.title: Nonpolar Micro‐Environment‐Induced Solvation Field Engineering Enables 600 Wh Kg −1 High‐Voltage Lithium Metal Pouch Cells
papers.abstract_en: Conventional‐carbonate electrolytes cannot simultaneously stabilize lithium metal interfaces and sustain fast ion transport. Existing designs mitigate interfacial degradation but compromise ion transport, low‐temperature fluidity, or salt dissociation. Herein, we propose a solvation field engineering strategy via a nonpolar micro‐environment‐induced electrolyte (NME) that overcomes this trade‐off at conventional salt concentration. Propyl propionate serves as an amphiphilic inducer: its carbonyl oxygen coordinates Li + , while its propyl chain extends outward to create a Li + ‐centered nonpolar micro‐environment that engineers the local solvation field by attenuating dielectric shielding and strengthening Li + –PF 6 − interactions, thereby driving a contact‐ion‐pair‐dominated solvation structure. Fluoroethylene carbonate and 2,2,2‐trifluoroethyl methyl carbonate ensure sufficient salt dissociation and high‐voltage oxidative stability. The resulting electrolyte combines rapid ion transport with a robust LiF/LiPO 2 F 2 interphase, suppressing electrolyte decomposition and enabling uniform Li plating/stripping. Consequently, a 4.2 Ah Li||LiNi 0.88 Co 0.07 Mn 0.05 O 2 pouch cell (∼425 Wh kg −1 ) retains 87.7% capacity after 200 cycles, and a 23.5 Ah Li||LiNi 0.95 Co 0.02 Mn 0.03 O 2 pouch cell achieves 604 Wh kg −1 . The strategy is further applicable to graphite‐based batteries, enabling a 3.6 Ah Graphite||LiNi 0.5 Co 0.2 Mn 0.3 O 2 pouch cell to deliver 81.5% retention after 100 cycles at −20°C. NME offers a novel principle to regulate solvation and interfacial stability for high‐energy batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 기존 카보네이트 전해질은 리튬금속 계면 안정화와 빠른 이온 수송을 동시에 만족시키기 어려운데, 이 연구는 프로필 프로피오네이트를 비극성 미세환경 유도제로 사용하는 솔베이션 필드 엔지니어링 전해질(NME)을 제안한다. 카르보닐 산소가 Li+와 배위하고 프로필 체인이 바깥쪽으로 확장되어 Li+ 중심의 비극성 미세환경을 형성, 유전차폐를 약화시키고 Li+-PF6- 상호작용을 강화해 접촉이온쌍 중심의 솔베이션 구조를 유도한다. FEC와 TFEMC를 더해 충분한 염 해리와 고전압 안정성을 확보했으며, 4.2Ah Li||NCM88 파우치셀(~425 Wh/kg)은 200사이클 후 87.7%의 용량 유지율을, 23.5Ah Li||NCM95 셀은 604 Wh/kg을 달성했다.

papers.title: Nanofriction strengthened mechanically adaptive electrolytes for safe lithium metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: The expanding application of lithium metal batteries in emerging fields such as unmanned aerial vehicles and humanoid robots exposes them to heightened risks of mechanical abuse, which has become a critical factor contributing to safety failures. To address this predicament, we design a mechanically intelligent responsive multifunctional electrolyte using a “nano-friction-strengthening” strategy to dynamically reinforce its mechanical robustness. The high-polarity carbonate solvents spontaneously infiltrate the hydroxyl-rich poly(hydroxyethyl methacrylate-diethyl allyphosphonate) shell and induce a hydrogen-bond-driven, self-regulated swelling response that enables uniform nanoparticle dispersion. Under impact, the intimate interfacial contact between core-shell nanoparticles instantaneously activates a dense network of dynamic hydrogen bonds within the swollen shell, boosting interparticle friction and adhesion. This molecularly orchestrated nano-friction-strengthening effect endows the electrolyte with impact hardening, driving a 160-fold surge in viscosity and delivering highly effective mechanical protection. Consequently, the electrolyte attenuates impact forces by 73.1%, enabling single Li‖LiFePO 4 pouch cells to endure impact without short-circuiting. Beyond mechanical reinforcement, the phosphate-ester groups in nanoparticles suppress exothermic chain reactions, ensuring safe operation during nail-penetration and ballistic tests in ampere-hour-scale Li‖LiFePO 4 cells.
papers.summary_ko: 무인기, 인간형 로봇 등 기계적 충격 위험이 큰 환경에서 사용되는 리튬금속전지의 안전성을 높이기 위해 '나노마찰 강화' 전략을 적용한 기계적응형 전해질을 설계했다. 고극성 카보네이트 용매가 하이드록실이 풍부한 코어-쉘 나노입자 쉘에 침투해 수소결합 기반 팽윤 반응을 유도하며, 충격 시 입자 간 마찰과 접착력이 급격히 증가해 점도가 160배 상승한다. 이를 통해 충격력을 73.1% 감쇄시켜 Li‖LiFePO4 단위 셀이 단락 없이 충격을 견디고, 암페어시급 셀에서도 못 관통 및 발사 시험에서 안전성을 확보했다.

papers.title: Modulating HOMO location boosting high-voltage stability of fluorine-free ether based low-concentration electrolyte for 4.7 V level lithium metal batteries
papers.summary_ko: 4.7V급 리튬 금속 전지를 위해 불소를 포함하지 않는 에테르 기반 저농도 전해질에서 HOMO 위치를 조절하여 고전압 안정성을 높이는 연구로 추정된다 (제목 기반 추정).

papers.title: Hyperconjugation‐Mediated Design of Dissolution‐Resistant Organic Cathode for Durable Zinc‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Small‐molecule organic carbonyl compounds (SMOCCs) have emerged as promising cathode candidates for aqueous zinc‐ion batteries (AZIBs) by virtue of their high theoretical capacity and tunable redox potential. However, their practical implementation is severely impeded by intrinsically poor electronic conductivity and pronounced dissolution in aqueous electrolytes, leading to unsatisfactory rate capability and cyclic stability. Herein, we report a hyper‐conjugative structural design strategy to construct a TAPT@rGO composite, in which 2,3,5,6‐tetraamino‐1,4‐benzoquinone (TABQ) and 1,10‐phenanthroline‐5，6‐dione (PTD) are covalently integrated with graphene oxide (GO) to yield a nitrogen‐heteroatom‐extended conjugated framework. This architecture not only ensures homogeneous dispersion of nanosized TAPT crystallites on the rGO substrate, but also establishes an N‐heterocycle‐mediated extended conjugation linkage between the organic species and the carbon scaffold, which synergistically enhances electronic transport kinetics and suppresses active material dissolution. As a cathode for AZIBs, the TAPT@rGO composite delivers a high initial capacity of 271 mAh g −1 at 0.1 A g −1 with an average operating voltage of 0.8 V, together with exceptional cycling stability (93.5% capacity retention over 100 cycles at 0.1 A g −1 and 82.5% retention over 10000 cycles at 5 A g −1 ). This work demonstrates that hyperconjugation engineering provides a rational molecular design for developing high‐performance organic cathodes toward durable multivalent ion storage.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 아연이온전지(AZIB)용 소분자 유기 카보닐 화합물의 낮은 전도성과 용해 문제를 해결하기 위해 TABQ와 PTD를 그래핀옥사이드에 공유결합으로 통합한 TAPT@rGO 복합 양극을 제안했다. 질소 헤테로원자 기반의 확장된 공액구조가 전자 전달과 활물질 용해 억제를 동시에 개선하여 0.1 A g−1에서 271 mAh g−1의 초기 용량과 10000회 사이클(5 A g−1)에서 82.5%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다. 리튬/소듐 배터리가 아닌 아연이온전지 연구로 7개 토픽 범주에는 해당하지 않는다.

papers.title: High-loading all-solid-state lithium–sulfur batteries enabled by tailored sulfur–sulfide and sulfur–carbon interfaces
papers.summary_ko: 제목에 기반하면, 황화물 및 황-탄소 계면을 정밀 설계하여 고로딩 전고체 리튬-황 전지의 성능을 향상시키는 연구로 추정된다 (제목 기반 추정).

papers.title: Four-dimensional X-ray nano-holotomography reveals multiscale chemomechanics in composite graphite–silicon battery electrodes
papers.abstract_en: Linking electrode microstructure to electrochemical performance is essential for optimizing Li-ion batteries. However, this requires mechanistic four-dimensional observations at the ultimate spatiotemporal scales, which remain elusive. Here we demonstrate the use of interrupted-operando synchrotron X-ray nano-holotomography combined with digital volume correlation to track chemomechanical dynamics at both particle (local) and electrode (averaged) scales. Quantitative scale-bridging image analysis is applied to composite graphite–silicon electrodes during their electrochemical formation cycle. Our findings reveal that local ionic diffusion properties, graphite particle morphology and position in the electrode, distance to silicon clusters, surface contact with the liquid electrolyte solution, and mechanical deformations all directly affect local electrochemical activity and irreversibility, although these parameters are not equally important. In particular, we identify fast ionic diffusion channels that play a key role and counterbalance intrinsic depth-dependent reaction heterogeneities arising from ionic and electronic diffusion limitations. The various structural factors that determine the electrochemical performance of composite graphite–silicon electrodes in Li-ion batteries beyond ensemble properties are classified using a scale of influence, providing a practical framework for the optimization of materials and electrode manufacturing.
papers.summary_ko: 4차원 방사광 X선 나노홀로토모그래피와 디지털 체적 상관법을 결합해 흑연-실리콘 복합전극의 입자 및 전극 스케일 화학역학 거동을 관찰했다. 이온 확산 경로, 흑연 입자 형상·위치, 실리콘 클러스터와의 거리, 전해질 접촉, 기계적 변형 등이 국부적 전기화학 활성과 비가역성에 미치는 영향을 정량적으로 분석했다. 흑연-실리콘 음극의 구조-성능 관계를 규명하는 특성분석 연구로 7개 토픽 범주에는 해당하지 않는다.
