papers.title: ER-associated biogenesis of PINK1 preprotein for neuronal mitophagy
papers.abstract_en: Given the large size of neurons, local maintenance of mitochondria is crucial to counteract insults to this organelle in axons and dendrites. The Parkinson-related mitochondrial kinase PINK1 plays a central role in mitochondrial quality control, which in neurons requires the transport of Pink1 mRNA by mitochondrial hitch-hiking. However, how and where PINK1 is locally translated and processed has remained unclear. Using live-cell imaging, we trace local PINK1 translation sites and preprotein dynamics, revealing a concerted interplay between mitochondria and the ER, with endolysosomes frequently localized adjacent to the site of translation. Upon metabolically regulated untethering from mitochondria, Pink1 mRNA relocates to ribosomes in proximity to the ER and endolysosomes for translation of the PINK1 preprotein. The ER chaperone DNAJB6 shields the PINK1 preprotein in transit to mitochondria, following the post-translational ER-SURF pathway. Consequently, loss of DNAJB6 leads to persistent ER/endolysosome-associated PINK1 precursor stores and failure of mitophagy upon mitochondrial damage. Our findings reveal that neuronal PINK1 protein translation switches between mitochondrially anchored co-translational and ER-associated post-translational import states, with functional implications for mitochondrial quality control.
papers.summary_ko: 신경세포 내 PINK1 전구체 단백질이 소포체(ER)와 미토콘드리아 사이에서 번역 및 운반되는 과정을 live-cell 이미징으로 추적한 연구이다. ER 샤페론 DNAJB6가 PINK1 전구체를 미토콘드리아로 전달되기까지 보호하며, 이 단백질이 결손되면 미토파지가 실패함을 밝혔다. 배터리와 무관한 신경생물학 연구이다.

papers.title: Concentration‐Dependent Li‐Ion Solvation and Dual‐Interphase Regulation by Cyanuric Chloride in Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Practical lithium‐sulfur (Li‐S) batteries require control of dissolved polysulfides, sulfur‐conversion kinetics, and lithium‐metal anodes under high sulfur loading and limited electrolyte. Dissolved molecular additives can influence all three processes, but their effects depend on concentration. Here, cyanuric chloride (CC) is examined from 0 to 0.10 M as an aprotic chlorotriazine additive with three ring‐nitrogen sites and three carbon‐chlorine centers. Spectroscopy suggests that 0.05 M (Optm‐CC) enhances nitrate (NO 3 − ) and bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide (TFSI − ) anions’ participation in Li‐ion solvation. This concentration reduces polysulfide crossover, enriches the sulfur‐cathode interphase with inorganic and triazine‐associated products, and promotes an inorganic‐rich, Cl‐containing interphase at the lithium‐metal anode. As a result, these changes lower cyclic‐voltammetry peak separation to 0.191 V, raise the apparent Li|Li exchange‐current density to 0.203 mA cm −2 , support Li|Li symmetric‐cell cycling for over 1100 cycles, deliver 560 mAh g Sulfur −1 at 10C, and sustain 3000 Li‐S cycles. Increasing the CC concentration to 0.10 M (Conc‐CC) produces a larger spectroscopic shift, but the apparent Li‐ion transference number and lithium‐electrode polarization deteriorate. Furthermore, a pouch cell operated at 8 mg Sulfur cm −2 and 5 µL mg Sulfur − 1 retains 72.73% of its stabilized capacity after 300 cycles. Among the tested formulations, 0.05 M best balances coordination, interphase chemistry, and electrochemical performance.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황 전지에서 농도에 따라 거동이 달라지는 시아누르산 클로라이드(CC) 첨가제를 0~0.10 M 범위에서 평가했다. 0.05 M 농도(Optm-CC)는 NO3−와 TFSI− 음이온의 Li+ 솔베이션 참여를 늘려 폴리설파이드 셔틀을 줄이고, 황 양극과 리튬 음극 모두에 무기물이 풍부한 계면을 형성시켜 Li|Li 대칭셀 1100회 이상, 10C에서 560 mAh gS−1, 3000회 Li-S 사이클을 달성했다. 반면 0.10 M(Conc-CC)에서는 리튬 전극 분극이 악화되어 8 mg cm−2 파우치셀은 300회 후 72.73% 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Cathode Surface Reconfiguration via Solvent Chemistry for Durable All-Solid-State Lithium Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Electrode surfaces and interfaces critically dominate the performance of all-solid-state lithium batteries. However, established additive-oriented strategies physically isolate the cathode from the electrolyte without improving the restricted Li+ transport pathways of the cathode surface. Here, we propose a solvation-mediated chemical etching mechanism governing cathode surface reconfiguration, driven by competition between solvent coordination and lattice stabilization. The solvent coordination, coupled with electron and proton transfer, weakens transition-metal–oxygen covalency and destabilizes lattice-bound surface species, shifting the interfacial energy landscape toward solvation-favored states. This triggers selective transition-metal dissolution and oxygen modulation, ultimately reorganizing confined surface regions into continuous Li+ transport networks. Using micron-sized single-crystalline Li- and Mn-rich cathodes as a model, we demonstrate the formation of a Mn- and O-deficient interfacial layer equipped with a three-dimensional Li+ diffusion network. This functional layer accelerates Li+ diffusion and anionic redox kinetics while suppressing transition metal migration and oxygen release. Consequently, charge-transfer resistance drops drastically (from 585 to 67 Ω) and Li+ diffusion increases 90-fold at 4.8 V, enabling 80.3% capacity retention after 2800 cycles at 2C. This solvent-driven reconfiguration provides a scalable framework for stabilizing diverse cathodes in next-generation advanced batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬전지에서 첨가제 기반 전략이 양극 표면의 제한된 Li+ 경로를 근본적으로 개선하지 못하는 문제를 해결하기 위해, 용매 배위와 격자 안정화의 경쟁을 이용한 용매화 매개 화학적 식각으로 양극 표면을 재구성하는 메커니즘을 제안했다. 단결정 Li- 및 Mn-rich 양극을 모델로 하여 Mn 및 O가 결핍된 3차원 Li+ 확산망을 가진 계면층을 형성시켜 전하전달저항을 585Ω에서 67Ω으로 낮추고 4.8V에서 Li+ 확산을 90배 향상시켰다. 그 결과 2C에서 2800회 사이클 후 80.3%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Built‐In Electric Field Creates Li + Highways With Accelerating and Dissociating Regions for Solid‐State Polymer Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: Solid‐state polymer electrolytes based on poly (ethylene oxide) (PEO) are promising candidates for next‐generation lithium‐metal batteries, yet their practical application is hindered by low ionic conductivity and limited Li + transference number, originating from insufficient salt dissociation and passive ion transport. Here, we introduce a MoSe 2 /TiF 4 heterojunction into the PEO matrix to construct an ion‐conducting network with integrated accelerating and dissociating functionalities. The built‑in electric field at the heterointerface actively promotes rapid Li + migration, while the Lewis acid‐base interactions facilitate efficient LiTFSI dissociation. Benefiting from this synergistic heterojunction effect, the resulting composite electrolyte achieves a high ionic conductivity of 1.09 × 10 −4 S cm −1 at room temperature, a Li + transference number of 0.55, and enables stable Li||Li symmetric cycling for over 2500 h at 60°C. Both LiFePO 4 || Li and LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 ||Li all‑solid‑state batteries demonstrate excellent cycling stability and rate capability. Combined electrochemical analysis and density functional theory calculations confirm that the heterojunction‑induced built‑in electric field plays a central role in accelerating Li + transport and promoting salt dissociation. This heterojunction engineering strategy provides a viable pathway toward high‑performance polymer electrolytes for practical solid‑state batteries.
papers.summary_ko: PEO 기반 고체 고분자 전해질의 낮은 이온전도도와 리튬 이동수 문제를 해결하기 위해 MoSe2/TiF4 헤테로접합을 도입하여 Li+ 가속 및 해리 기능을 동시에 갖는 이온전도 네트워크를 구축했다. 계면의 내부전기장이 Li+ 이동을 촉진하고 루이스 산-염기 상호작용이 LiTFSI 해리를 도와 상온 이온전도도 1.09×10−4 S cm−1, Li+ 이동수 0.55, 60°C에서 2500시간 이상의 Li‖Li 대칭셀 안정성을 달성했다. LiFePO4와 NCM811 기반 전고체전지 모두에서 우수한 사이클 및 율속 특성을 보였으나 전해질 자체에 관한 연구로 7개 토픽 범주에는 해당하지 않는다.

papers.title: Bidirectional Sulfur Redox Regulation Enabling Ultra‐Stable High‐Sulfur‐Loading All‐Solid‐State Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: All‐solid‐state lithium‐sulfur batteries are promising for high‐energy storage but are limited by sluggish sulfur redox and poor cycling stability. Herein, we design a new amorphous‐crystalline Li 6.05 P 0.95 Nb 0.05 S 5 Cl 0.8 I 0.2 electrolyte that reconstructs interfacial Li + transport and enables bidirectional regulation of sulfur redox. The amorphous structure improves solid‐solid contact and creates additional continuous Li + pathways around sulfur, while the crystal framework maintains fast Li + ion‐conducting channels. During the discharge, we further uncover an Nb reduction mechanism in which Nb 4+ is reduced to Nb 3+ , generating Li‐rich sites that promote Li 2 S nucleation and sulfur reduction. During the charge, I − is oxidized to I 2 , which acts as the redox mediator for Li 2 S oxidation, while I 3 − formation helps stabilize unconsumed I 2 . This bidirectional regulation enables 84.2% sulfur utilization at a high sulfur loading of 6 mg cm − 2 and retains 736 mAh g − 1 with 93.1% capacity retention after 1500 cycles at 0.5 C. These findings provide a mechanistic strategy for high‐sulfur‐loading all‐solid‐state Li‐S batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬-황전지는 느린 황 레독스 반응과 낮은 사이클 안정성이 문제인데, 이 연구는 Nb이 도핑된 비정질-결정질 복합 전해질 Li6.05P0.95Nb0.05S5Cl0.8I0.2를 설계해 황 레독스를 양방향으로 조절했다. 방전시 Nb4+→Nb3+ 환원이 Li2S 핵생성을 촉진하는 리튬풍부 자리를 생성하고, 충전시 I-가 I2로 산화되어 Li2S 산화를 매개하는 레독스 메디에이터로 작용한다. 이를 통해 6 mg/cm² 고황로딩에서 84.2%의 황 활용률을 달성했고 1500사이클, 0.5C에서 93.1%의 용량 유지율과 736 mAh/g을 유지했다.

papers.title: Thermodynamic Activity Regulation Enables Low-Voltage Alloy-Mediated CO2-to-Carbon Conversion
papers.abstract_en: Molten-carbonate electrolysis integrates CO2 capture with conversion to storable solid carbon, yet direct carbonate electroreduction suffers from cathodic polarization, raising cell voltage and energy consumption. Here, the cathodic pathway is redesigned by coupling electrochemical alkali-metal alloying with thermochemical carbonate reduction. Alloying with liquid metals lowers the thermodynamic activity of the alkali-metal mediator and shifts its equilibrium alloying potential to more positive values, while sufficient activity must be retained to drive subsequent thermochemical carbonate reduction. These competing constraints define a thermodynamic reactive window that guides liquid-metal screening, identifying Sb as a host. Stepwise experiments separating alloying from open-circuit thermochemical carbon formation directly support the proposed pathway. Liquid Sb sustains CO2-to-carbon electrolysis for 72 h at 700 °C and 2.0 V with 80.9% Faradaic efficiency and 22.08 kWh kg C–1 electrical energy consumption, 36.9% below a reported solid-electrode benchmark. These results establish thermodynamic activity regulation as a strategy for lower-voltage electrochemical–chemical conversion.
papers.summary_ko: 용융 탄산염 전해 환원에서 알칼리 금속-액체금속 합금화를 열화학적 탄산염 환원과 결합하여 음극 분극을 낮추는 전략을 제시했다. 열역학적 활성도 조절을 통해 Sb를 호스트 금속으로 선정하였으며, 액체 Sb는 700°C, 2.0V에서 72시간 동안 80.9%의 파라데이 효율로 CO2를 탄소로 전환하면서 기존 고체 전극 대비 36.9% 낮은 전력 소비(22.08 kWh/kg C)를 달성했다.

papers.title: Screening of Single-Atom Catalysts for Na2S-Mediated Pre-Sodiation and Interfacial Rejuvenation in Low N/P Ratio Sodium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: The pursuit of higher energy and power densities in sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) is constrained by the trade-off between multielectron faradaic reaction kinetics and interfacial stability. Here, we develop a catalyst-mediated presodiation and interfacial rejuvenation strategy to address the low initial Coulombic efficiency of hard carbon (HC) anodes and transition-metal (TM) dissolution from high-voltage polyanionic and layered oxide cathodes in ampere-hour-scale pouch cells. Moving beyond empirical catalyst selection, we establish a rational screening framework for transition-metal single-atom sites based on electronic coupling and geometric compatibility with Na2S. Atomically dispersed Co (SA-Co) emerges as the preferred catalyst, reducing the Na2S decomposition potential to 3.49 V. An SA-Co/Na2S@C functional layer enables precise sodium-inventory compensation and simultaneous interfacial rejuvenation. Unlike conventional blended additives, sulfur-derived polysulfides suppress TM crossover and support high-voltage operation up to 4.5 V, while replenished sodium compensates irreversible HC losses and stabilizes the solid-electrolyte interphase. Coupling an SA-Co/Na2S@C-coated Na3V2(PO4)3 (NVP) cathode (18 mg cm–2) with an HC anode under lean-sodium and lean-electrolyte conditions (N/P ratio = 0.4; E/C ratio = 1.2 g Ah1–) yields a 1.1 Ah pouch cell retaining 97.2% capacity after 200 cycles, with gravimetric and volumetric energy densities of 317 Wh kg–1 and 485 Wh L–1, respectively, and a maximum power density of 831 W kg–1. Compatible with existing electrode manufacturing, this scalable interfacial approach offers a practical pathway toward high-energy, high-power SIBs.
papers.summary_ko: 저 N/P 비율의 소듐이온 파우치셀에서 하드카본 음극의 낮은 초기 쿨롱 효율과 고전압 양극재의 전이금속 용출 문제를 해결하기 위해 Na2S 기반 사전소듐화 및 계면 재생 전략을 제안했다. 전자 결합 및 기하학적 적합성에 기반한 단원자 촉매 스크리닝을 통해 Co 단원자(SA-Co)가 Na2S 분해 전위를 3.49V로 낮추는 최적 촉매로 확인되었다. SA-Co/Na2S@C로 코팅된 Na3V2(PO4)3(NVP) 양극과 하드카본 음극을 조합한 1.1Ah 파우치셀은 N/P=0.4, 린 전해질 조건에서 200회 사이클 후 97.2%의 용량 유지율과 317 Wh/kg, 485 Wh/L의 에너지 밀도를 달성했다.

papers.title: Molecular Engineering of Redox Mediator for Accelerated Multi‐Electron Transfer Reactions in Lithium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Lithium–sulfur and lithium–oxygen batteries are highly attractive due to their ultrahigh theoretical energy densities, while their performance is severely constrained by sluggish multiphase reaction rates and limited reaction stability at the cathodes. The conventional solid‐phase catalysts suffer from small interfacial contact area and activity loss of active sites, while the mobile redox mediators (RMs) present a new paradigm for accelerating multi‐electron transfer pathways through a solution‐mediated electron transfer pathway. This review first discusses the critical rate‐limiting factors governing reaction rate at the cathode, and then systematically examines the latest advances in the molecular engineering of RMs for cathode catalysis from the viewpoint of redox potential, solubility, molecular size, and chemical stability. Following these points, we comprehensively analyze, from both thermodynamic and kinetic perspectives, how the molecular engineering of RMs affects the redox potential, solubility, stability, and so on. These characteristics strongly dictate the specific capacity and lifespan, elucidating key structure–activity relationships. Finally, we propose systemic strategies expanding beyond isolated liquid‐phase catalysis toward solid–liquid synergistic design and functionalized electrolyte/separator engineering.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황 및 리튬-산소 전지 양극의 느린 다상 반응속도 문제를 해결하기 위한 가용성 레독스 매개체(RM)의 분자설계를 리뷰했다. 레독스 전위, 용해도, 분자크기, 화학적 안정성 관점에서 RM의 구조-물성 관계를 정리하고, 액상 촉매작용을 넘어 고체-액체 시너지 설계와 전해질/분리막 기능화로 확장되는 전략을 제시한다.

papers.title: In Situ Polymerized Main/Side-Chain Bifluorinated Cross-Linked Polyether Electrolytes for High-Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Polyether electrolytes are compelling candidates for lithium metal batteries owing to their high ionic conductivity and conformal interfacial contact. However, their widespread adoption is impeded by inherent vulnerabilities, including limited oxidative stability against high-voltage cathodes, uncontrolled lithium dendrite growth, and persistent interfacial side reactions. To overcome these challenges, we report an in situ polymerized cross-linked polyether electrolyte engineered with a bifluorinated molecular architecture (PTFMO-BEP), incorporating −CF2– segments in the polymer backbone and −CF3 groups on the side chains. This design significantly enhances the intrinsic oxidative stability, extending the electrochemical window beyond 5.5 V. Concurrently, the electron-withdrawing fluorinated motifs weaken the Li+-polymer coordination, steering an anion-derived decomposition pathway to form a homogeneous, inorganic-rich solid electrolyte interphase (SEI). Consequently, the PTFMO-BEP electrolyte enables exceptional cyclability in Li||Li symmetric cells (>800 h) and uniform, dendrite-free lithium deposition. When paired with high-loading LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 (NCM811) cathodes (∼4.4 mAh cm–2) and thin lithium anode (50 μm), the Li||NCM811 full cells achieve outstanding capacity retention of 85.6% after 150 cycles at 4.3 V and 91.5% after 100 cycles at 4.5 V. Remarkably, stable operation is maintained even under an ultrahigh cutoff voltage of 4.7 V with a 20 μm Li anode (88.7% retention over 100 cycles). Furthermore, ampere-hour-scale pouch cells configured with LiNi0.90Co0.05Mn0.05O2 (NCM9055) cathodes deliver a high gravimetric energy density of 510.1 Wh kg–1. This work exemplifies a potent molecular-design strategy to advance polyether electrolytes for practical high-energy-density lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 고전압 리튬 금속 배터리를 위해 주쇄와 측쇄에 불소를 동시 도입한 가교형 폴리에테르 전해질(PTFMO-BEP)을 현장 중합으로 제작했다. −CF2−/−CF3 구조가 산화 안정성을 5.5V 이상으로 확장하고 Li+-고분자 결합을 약화시켜 음이온 유래의 무기물 풍부 SEI 형성을 유도하며, Li||Li 대칭셀에서 800시간 이상의 덴드라이트 없는 안정적 사이클링을 구현했다. NCM811 고용량 양극과의 풀셀은 4.3V에서 150회 사이클 후 85.6%, 4.5V에서 100회 사이클 후 91.5%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Competitive Coordination of Solvent in Electrolyte to Stabilize Li-Rich Mn-Based Batteries
papers.abstract_en: The practical application of lithium metal batteries equipped with lithium-rich manganese-based layered oxide (LRMO) cathodes is severely impeded by aggressive electrolyte decomposition under operational voltage above 4.5 V. Herein, we discover a unique competitive solvent coordination behavior in the electrolyte solvation structure that enables significant stabilization of LRMO-based batteries. This rarely reported mechanism inspires the design of a low-concentration electrolyte (0.5 M lithium hexafluorophosphate, LiPF6), which employs a binary fluorinated solvent system consisting of weakly solvating tris(2,2,2-trifluoroethyl) phosphate (TFP) and ethyl difluoroacetate (EDFA). Benefiting from the optimized solvation structure, the assembled Li||LRMO cells achieve cycling stability, retaining 80.5% of the initial capacity after 450 cycles at 4.8 V and 0.5 C. We further establish a molecular-level interfacial model to elucidate the performance enhancement mechanism. This work provides insights into the unique competitive coordination effect of solvents within solvation structures and offers an innovative strategy for electrolyte design toward LRMO-based battery systems and beyond.
papers.summary_ko: 4.5V 이상의 고전압에서 리튬 리치 망간계(LRMO) 양극을 사용하는 리튬 금속 배터리의 전해질 분해 문제를 해결하기 위해 전해질 내 용매의 경쟁적 코디네이션 거동을 발견했다. 약한 용매화력을 갖는 TFP와 EDFA로 구성된 저농도(0.5M LiPF6) 이원 불소화 전해질을 설계하여 최적화된 솔베이션 구조를 구현하였으며, Li||LRMO 셀은 4.8V, 0.5C에서 450회 사이클 후 80.5%의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Advances and Perspectives of Cobalt‐Free Li‐Rich Mn‐Based Layered Oxide Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Lithium‐rich manganese‐based oxides (LRMOs) are prioritized for next‐generation batteries due to their high theoretical specific capacity and energy density. In particular, the cobalt‐free LRMOs offer additional competitive advantages due to their lowered production cost and reduced resource dependence. However, the cobalt‐free LRMOs still suffer from persistent structural stability challenges, exhibiting low initial Coulombic efficiency, rapid capacity and voltage decay, and inferior rate capability. To advance cobalt‐free LRMO development, massive research efforts focused on effective regulation strategies have emerged recently. It is therefore imperative to timely summarize these recent works to systematically evaluate the attained achievements, recognize the unresolved issues, and formulate the key optimization approaches in the next stage; however, such related reviews for cobalt‐free LRMOs remain limited. Herein, we carefully examine the fundamental advances in cobalt‐free LRMOs and give a comprehensive review work. Initially, the microstructure of cobalt‐free LRMOs is dissected, and the corresponding electrochemical mechanism is elucidated. In addition, the faced challenges are described and analyzed in detail. More importantly, the currently proposed modification strategies are primarily discussed from the microstructure regulation, element doping and surface coating views. Finally, the significant perspectives are highlighted.
papers.summary_ko: 코발트가 없는 리튬리치 망간계 층상산화물(LRMO) 양극의 최근 연구 동향을 정리한 리뷰이다. 낮은 초기 쿨롱효율, 급격한 용량·전압 감쇠, 저조한 율속 특성 등 구조 안정성 문제를 미세구조, 원소 도핑, 표면 코팅 관점에서 분석하고 향후 개선 방향을 제시한다.

papers.title: Stage‐Specific Pressure Programming Decouples Low‐Pressure Sulfur Reduction From High‐Pressure Interfacial Reconstruction in All‐Solid‐State Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The commercialization of all‐solid‐state Li–S batteries (ASSLSBs) remains constrained by the “impossible trinity” between high energy density, long cycle life, and low stack pressure. Here we show that stack pressure is not merely a static mechanical boundary, but a stage‐specific regulator of sulfur conversion and interfacial reconstruction. Using a static pressure‐resistance‐overpotential (P‐R‐η) operational threshold algorithm, low‐stack‐pressure operation is predicted feasible for 50 wt% S cathodes. Further operando electrochemical measurements and multiscale chemical and structural characterizations reveal that 1 MPa discharge promotes Li 2 S 2 ‐rich interfacial intermediates. However, constant low‐pressure cycling induces progressive pore filling that prolongs charge transport pathways, leading to inactive Li X S accumulation and triphase interfacial contact losses. State‐resolved very‐small‐angle neutron scattering (VSANS) further uncovers a ∼5 nm structural feature that persists after low‐stack‐pressure discharge, which specifically diminishes upon high‐pressure charging. Guided by this mechanism, we implement a pressure‐programmed protocol combining 1 MPa discharge with 180 MPa charge. The resulting cell retains 98.8% of capacity after 100 cycles at 30 °C. This work establishes a dynamic pressure modulation strategy towards alleviating the “impossible trinity” by decoupling the asymmetric pressure‐electrochemical behaviors.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬-황 배터리에서 스택 압력이 단순한 기계적 경계가 아니라 황 전환과 계면 재구성을 단계별로 조절하는 요인임을 규명했다. 저압 방전(1 MPa)과 고압 충전(180 MPa)을 결합한 압력 프로그래밍 프로토콜을 통해 저압 조건의 지속적 공극 충전으로 인한 비활성 LixS 축적과 삼상 계면 접촉 손실 문제를 해결했다. 이 전략을 적용한 셀은 30°C, 100회 사이클 후 98.8%의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Probing Phonon Dynamics for Kinetic Stabilization of Single‐Crystal Nickel‐Rich Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Structural degradation and lattice oxygen loss remain major obstacles to the long‐term stability of nickel‐rich layered cathodes, especially under high‐voltage and high‐rate operation. Conventional strategies primarily rely on thermodynamic stabilization via cation doping or surface protection, while the kinetic dimension of oxygen release has received less attention. Herein, we investigate Si─Ti co‐doped single‐crystal LiNi 0.83 Co 0.12 Mn 0.05 O 2 cathode materials, which exhibit reduced Li/Ni mixing, modified surface chemistry, and altered transition metal–oxygen (TM─O) lattice dynamics. Combined Raman spectroscopy and phonon dispersion calculations suggest that Si─Ti co‐doping enhances phonon scattering and modifies TM─O optical phonon modes. Operando and synchrotron‐based characterizations reveal substantially enhanced reversibility of lattice oxygen redox and transition‐metal local coordination. As a result, the optimized cathode exhibits suppressed oxygen release and mitigated irreversible phase transitions, retaining 83.17% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles at 5 C. These improvements are likely associated with the synergistic effects of thermodynamic and kinetic stabilization, with phonon dynamics proposed as one possible contributor among these coupled effects. This work highlights that the kinetic factors relevant to oxygen release warrant greater attention in the design of durable Ni‐rich cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: 니켈리치 층상 양극의 격자 산소 방출을 열역학적 접근이 아닌 운동학적(phonon dynamics) 관점에서 억제하는 전략을 제시했다. Si-Ti 공동 도핑된 단결정 LiNi0.83Co0.12Mn0.05O2에서 포논 산란 강화와 전이금속-산소 광학 포논 모드 변화를 라만 분광 및 포논 분산 계산으로 확인했다. 그 결과 산소 레독스 가역성이 향상되어 5C, 1000사이클 후 83.17%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Oxygen Anchoring Enabled by Ce‐Based Pyrochlore Coating for Robust Lithium‐Ion Battery Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Nickel‐rich layered oxides (≥ 80% Ni) are pivotal cathode materials for next‐generation high‐energy lithium‐ion batteries. However, under high cutoff voltage, the over‐oxidation of active cations and oxygen anions triggers structural instability and the continuous migration of O n− (0 < n < 2) radicals, rapidly leading to oxygen release, transition metal (TM) dissolution, electrolyte decomposition, and consequently severe degradation of electrochemical performance. Herein, a two‐pronged strategy is proposed to enhance the redox reversibility of lattice oxygen and suppress oxygen release from LiNi 0.84 Co 0.08 Mn 0.08 O 2 (NCM) during cycling. Combining a Ce‐based pyrochlore coating that possesses a high oxygen storage capacity with bulk Ce doping that modulates the TM─O bonds, the modified NCM cathode exhibits exceptional cycling stability under harsh operating conditions. The assembled CR2032 cells achieved 72.2% capacity retention after 400 cycles at 1 C under a high cutoff voltage of 4.50 V at 60°C. Moreover, pouch‐type full cells exhibit ultra‐stable cycling performance, retaining 91.0% capacity after 1000 cycles at 1 C within 2.75–4.20 V, and 80.2% after 1000 cycles when the upper cutoff voltage is raised to 4.40 V. This work not only provides a feasible two‐pronged modification strategy for layered oxide cathodes but also promotes the development of ultrahigh‐energy‐density rechargeable batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 고전압에서 니켈리치 층상 산화물(LiNi0.84Co0.08Mn0.08O2) 양극의 산소 방출과 전이금속 용출을 억제하기 위해 세륨 기반 파이로클로어 코팅과 벌크 Ce 도핑을 결합한 전략을 제안했다. 파이로클로어 코팅의 높은 산소 저장 능력과 Ce 도핑에 의한 전이금속-산소 결합 조절로 격자 산소 레독스 가역성을 향상시켰다. 4.50V, 60°C, 1C 조건에서 400사이클 후 72.2%, 파우치셀에서는 1000사이클 후 91.0%(4.20V)와 80.2%(4.40V)의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Moisture‐ and Dendrite‐Resistant Argyrodite Electrolytes Enabled by Lithium‐ and Halogen‐Site Synergistic Substitutions for All‐Solid‐State Lithium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Argyrodite electrolytes are promising for all‐solid‐state lithium batteries, while the high humid sensitivity and unstable interfacial reactions with lithium metal severely hinder practical application. In this work, a series of Li 5.4‐ x Ag x PS 4.4 Cl 1.6‐ x Br x ( x = 0, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, and 0.1) solid electrolytes with simultaneously enhanced ionic conductivity, air stability and lithium metal interfacial compatibility are synthesized via Ag and Br dual‐doping. Among them, Li 5.375 Ag 0.025 PS 4.4 Cl 1.575 Br 0.025 exhibits an increased room‐temperature ionic conductivity of 11.44 mS cm −1 after powder cold‐pressing, surpassing 10.22 mS cm −1 for the pristine Li 5.4 PS 4.4 Cl 1.6 . In addition, due to strong Ag‐S interactions, Li 5.375 Ag 0.025 PS 4.4 Cl 1.575 Br 0.025 releases only 0.752 cm 3 g −1 of H 2 S after air exposure, which is approximately only one third of that generated by the pristine Li 5.4 PS 4.4 Cl 1.6 . Benefiting from the in situ formation of a Li‐Ag alloy at the anode, Li 5.375 Ag 0.025 PS 4.4 Cl 1.575 Br 0.025 exhibits excellent lithium metal compatibility, enabling a critical current density of 1.55 mA cm −2 and stable lithium plating/stripping for 5000 h. Furthermore, the LiCoO 2 |Li 5.375 Ag 0.025 PS 4.4 Cl 1.575 Br 0.025 |Li cell demonstrates significantly improved cycling stability at a rate of 1 C, delivering a capacity retention of 84.5% after 1000 cycles. This work provides an effective strategy to simultaneously improve the chemical/electrochemical stability of argyrodite electrolytes, paving the way for the development of practical all‐solid‐state lithium batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬 배터리용 아지로다이트 고체전해질의 수분 민감성과 리튬 금속과의 불안정한 계면 반응을 해결하기 위해 Ag와 Br 이중 도핑 전략을 제시했다. Li5.375Ag0.025PS4.4Cl1.575Br0.025 조성은 11.44 mS/cm의 향상된 이온전도도와 함께 H2S 발생량을 약 1/3로 감소시켰으며, Ag-Li 합금 형성으로 리튬 금속 계면 안정성도 개선되었다. LiCoO2|SE|Li 셀은 1C, 1000사이클 후 84.5%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Microstructural Orientation Enables Mass‐Efficient Structural Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Multifunctional energy materials are fundamentally constrained by the coupling between ionic transport and mechanical load‐bearing, limiting performance and hindering practical implementation. In structural battery composites, this coupling has restricted energy density, rate capability and durability, keeping the field at a proof‐of‐concept stage despite its promise for system‐level weight savings. Here we establish microstructural orientation as an architectural strategy to alleviate transport limitations while preserving the mechanical functionality of load‐bearing energy materials. By aligning LiFePO 4 within a carbon fiber architecture, anisotropic transport pathways reduce tortuosity while preserving structural integrity. This enables all‐fiber structural batteries with a cell‐based energy density of 73 Wh kg −1 , power density of 78 W kg −1 , and an elastic modulus of 100 GPa. For the first time, multifunctional efficiency exceeds unity, reaching 1.6, enabling ∼37% system‐level weight reduction. Sustained cycling at 5C over 1000 cycles and accelerated kinetic stress testing at 10C demonstrate improved high‐rate performance, while calendar‐life stability over 8760 h confirms long‐term durability under mechanically constrained conditions.
papers.summary_ko: 구조용 배터리 복합재에서 이온 전달과 하중 지지 기능 간의 상충을 완화하기 위해 미세구조 배향을 구조적 전략으로 제시했다. 탄소섬유 구조 내 LiFePO4를 배향시켜 이방성 전달 경로로 굴곡도를 낮추면서 기계적 무결성을 유지하여, 셀 기준 에너지밀도 73 Wh/kg, 탄성계수 100 GPa를 갖는 전섬유 구조 배터리를 구현했다. 다기능 효율이 처음으로 1을 넘는 1.6에 도달하여 시스템 수준에서 약 37%의 무게 절감이 가능함을 보였다.

papers.title: Metallurgical Interface Engineering Constructing In Situ Li 3 N‐Enriched Interphase: A Bulk‐Interface Synergy Strategy Toward Practical Silicon Anodes
papers.abstract_en: Silicon anodes are promising for next‐generation lithium‐ion batteries but suffer from volume expansion, unstable solid electrolyte interphase (SEI), and sluggish Li + diffusion. Herein, we report a vacuum‐suspension‐melted (VSM) bulk multiphase integration and interphase modification strategy to address these challenges. Unlike conventional mechanical mixing, VSM constructs a SiSnM (M = Bi, Ni) composite with metallurgically bonded Si/metal interfaces, forming a conductive network that buffers internal stress via atomic‐scale interfacial stress transfer. Simultaneously, a polydopamine‐derived nitrogen‐doped carbon coating transforms in situ into a Li 3 N‐enriched interphase during cycling, which exhibits high ionic/electronic conductivity, accelerates interfacial charge transfer, and suppresses continuous SEI breakdown. The resulting SiSnM@Li 3 N anode delivers 87.3% capacity retention after 1000 cycles at 1.5 A g −1 and >1000 mAh g −1 at 15 A g −1 , with reliable operation from −30°C to 60°C. Stable cycling at 2.5 mg cm −2 confirms practical relevance. Full cells with Li‐rich Mn‐based cathodes show stable performance, and 5 Ah‐level pouch cells deliver 84.7% capacity retention after 300 cycles at 6 A discharge. This work concurrently tackles ionic, electronic, and mechanical constraints, offering a practical path to high‐energy durable Si‐based batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 실리콘 음극의 부피 팽창, 불안정한 SEI, 느린 Li+ 확산 문제를 해결하기 위해 진공 부유 용융(VSM)으로 SiSnM(M=Bi, Ni) 복합체를 제작하여 금속학적으로 결합된 Si/금속 계면을 형성했다. 폴리도파민 유래 질소 도핑 탄소 코팅이 사이클 중 Li3N 풍부 계면으로 전환되어 이온/전자 전도성을 높이고 SEI 붕괴를 억제하며, SiSnM@Li3N 음극은 1.5 A/g에서 1000회 사이클 후 87.3%의 용량 유지율과 15 A/g에서 1000 mAh/g 이상의 용량을 보였다. 5Ah급 파우치셀은 300회 사이클 후 84.7%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Manipulating Spatial Charge Distribution and Electronic Structure in Se‐Doped Hollow Heterostructures for Enhanced Redox Kinetics in Li‐S Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium‐sulfur (Li‐S) battery represents a promising next‐generation energy storage technology yet suffers from sluggish conversion kinetics and polysulfide shuttling. Conventional heterostructure designs often fall short in concurrently optimizing catalytic activity and adsorption strength. Herein, we report Se‐doped Co 3 O 4 /SnO 2 hollow nanoboxes as a functional separator coating that synergistically combines heterointerface engineering with electronic structure modulation. The Co 3 O 4 /SnO 2 heterointerface promotes interfacial charge redistribution, while Se doping induces an upward shift of the Co d ‐band center, thereby strengthening polysulfide adsorption and accelerating sulfur redox kinetics. The optimized separator exhibits excellent electrochemical performance, delivering long‐term cycling stability with a low capacity decay rate of only ∼0.049% per cycle over 1000 cycles. In situ Raman and XRD analyses reveal accelerated bidirectional sulfur redox kinetics and effective shuttle suppression, and a pouch cell retaining 862 mAh g −1 after 100 cycles demonstrates practical viability. This work provides a paradigm of spatial‐electronic synergy for designing active electrocatalytic interfaces in advanced Li‑S batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황 배터리의 느린 전환 반응속도와 폴리설파이드 셔틀 문제를 해결하기 위해 Se 도핑된 Co3O4/SnO2 중공 나노박스를 분리막 코팅 소재로 적용했다. 헤테로계면에 의한 전하 재분배와 Se 도핑에 의한 Co d-band 중심 상향 이동으로 폴리설파이드 흡착과 산화환원 반응속도를 동시에 향상시켰다. 1000사이클에서 사이클당 약 0.049%의 낮은 용량 감쇠율을 보였으며 파우치셀에서도 100사이클 후 862 mAh/g을 유지했다.

papers.title: Machine learning-driven regulation of the four-electron LiOH pathway in lithium–oxygen batteries with prolonged cycling
papers.abstract_en: Abstract The practical deployment of high-energy-density lithium–oxygen batteries is fundamentally restricted by sluggish oxygen redox kinetics and the instability of discharge intermediates. Here, we report an artificial intelligence-integrated framework leveraging interpretable machine learning and density functional theory to navigate a vast chemical space of thousands of active sites. This approach identifies Ni-Co dual-atom catalysts as a better configuration among the selected elements for orchestrating multi-electron transfer. Theoretical analysis reveals that synergistic electronic coupling between the dual-sites fundamentally reconfigures the d -band center, thereby lowering the thermodynamic barriers for oxygen redox. Moreover, the catalysts enable precise regulation of the reaction pathway, inducing a controllable transition from the conventional two-electron pathway to a four-electron pathway. This shift yields a discharge capacity of ~60,000 mAh g −1 . Beyond its role as a positive electrode catalyst, this architecture functions as a multifunctional interfacial protective layer that stabilizes the lithium metal negative electrode by suppressing dendrite growth. Consequently, the lithium–oxygen system achieves stable lifespan of 2075 cycles under the four-electron pathway with reduced voltage decay. This work establishes a data-guided strategy for the rational design of atomic-scale architecture via artificial intelligence, unlocking the potential of multi-electron oxygen chemistry for lithium–oxygen batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 머신러닝과 밀도함수이론을 결합해 리튬-산소 배터리의 다전자 전달 경로를 최적화하는 Ni-Co 이중원자 촉매를 발굴했다. 두 활성점 간 전자적 결합이 d-band 중심을 재구성하여 산소 레독스의 열역학적 장벽을 낮추고, 기존 2전자 경로에서 4전자 LiOH 경로로의 전환을 유도해 약 60,000 mAh/g의 방전 용량을 달성했다. 이 촉매층은 동시에 리튬 금속 음극의 덴드라이트 성장을 억제하는 보호층 역할도 수행하여 전지 수명을 2075사이클까지 연장했다.

papers.title: Low-temperature operation of Ag—C based anodeless all-solid-state pouch cells
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Anodeless all-solid-state batteries with Ag-C interlayers offer high energy density and long cycle life, yet their operation in cold environments remains limited by poorly understood failure mechanisms. Using operando X-ray absorption spectroscopy, cryogenic-cross-section electron microscopy, and X-ray diffraction, we discover that Li-Ag alloying dynamics are highly temperature-dependent: rapid at 45 °C but kinetically suppressed at 5 °C. At low temperatures, suppressed alloying leads to sluggish lithium transport, internal lithium extrusion, interlayer delamination, and rapid capacity decay. We demonstrate that a brief initial charge at 45 °C permanently activates the interlayer via Li-Ag alloy formation, enabling efficient Li transport even at 5 °C. Full pouch cells following this activation protocol retain 87% of their initial capacity after 250 completed cycles following one formation cycle at 5 °C. After 250 cycles at 5 °C, AAP-treated cells delivered approximately three times the discharge capacity of cells cycled with the fixed-temperature protocol. Such in situ electrochemical alloy activation offers a practical and scalable approach to extend anodeless all-solid-state battery performance to sub-ambient temperatures without material redesign.
papers.summary_ko: Ag-C 계면층을 사용하는 애노드리스 전고체 전지의 저온 작동 실패 메커니즘을 operando 분광 및 저온 전자현미경으로 규명했다. Li-Ag 합금화 반응이 45°C에서는 빠르지만 5°C에서는 속도론적으로 억제되어 리튬 이동 저하, 내부 리튬 압출, 계면 박리를 유발함을 확인했다. 45°C에서의 초기 활성화 충전 프로토콜을 적용하면 5°C에서도 250사이클 후 87%의 용량을 유지할 수 있음을 보였다.

papers.title: Ferroptosis in cancer cells triggers PGE2 production for tumour immune escape
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Ferroptosis, a form of cell death induced by overwhelming membrane lipid peroxidation, is a vulnerability of many cancers, including cancers resistant to current molecular and immune-based therapies 1–7 . Triggering of ferroptosis therefore provides an opportunity to achieve elimination of difficult-to-treat cancers 1–4,8,9 . Studies in mouse cancer models have demonstrated that anticancer immunity, mediated by dendritic cells (DCs) and CD8 + T cells, is essential for effective tumour eradication by ferroptosis-inducing strategies 10–13 . However, ferroptotic cells limit this response 8–10,14 , resulting in immune escape and tumour growth through mechanisms that remain unclear. Here we demonstrate that ferroptotic cancer cells activate a molecular program resulting in aberrant production of prostaglandin E 2 (PGE 2 ), which limits the stimulation of anticancer CD8 + T cell responses by type 1 conventional DCs (cDC1s), thereby promoting immune escape. In ferroptotic cancer cells, lipid peroxidation-mediated membrane permeabilization enables Ca 2+ influx, which activates p38 MAPK signalling and thereby drives PGE 2 production. This signalling axis is uncoupled from cancer cell death and can be targeted to selectively interfere with immune-inhibitory PGE 2 production while preserving ferroptotic cancer cell elimination. In the context of cancer cell ferroptosis, ablation of PGE 2 production or disrupting PGE 2 signalling restores cDC1-mediated anticancer CD8 + T cell responses and leads to effective tumour elimination. Our findings identify a key mechanism that limits antitumour immunity and prevents tumour elimination upon ferroptosis induction in cancer cells, which could be exploited for cancer therapy.
papers.summary_ko: 암세포의 페롭토시스(ferroptosis)가 PGE2 생성을 유발해 종양의 면역 회피를 촉진하는 기전을 규명한 암면역학 연구로, 배터리 소재와는 무관하다.

papers.title: Electric‐Field Responsive Molecular Switch Unlocks Stable 4.5 V‐Class Sodium Layered Oxide Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: High-voltage operation of sodium layered oxide cathodes is essential for unlocking energy density, yet the intensified interfacial electric field destabilizes the cathode/electrolyte interphase (CEI), posing a persistent challenge. Herein, we reveal that interfacial stability is governed not solely by oxidative tolerance but by the coupling of molecular species to the dynamically evolving interfacial field. Guided by this insight, we define an electric field coupling agent (EFCA) that combines strong field responsiveness with appropriate redox propensity to enable threshold-gated reactivity. Acting as a molecular switch, the agent remains chemically inactive below a critical field but becomes activated above it through field-driven migration, reorientation, and selective bond cleavage. A dual-descriptor framework integrating a customized field sensitivity index (FSI) with HOMO energy identifies sodium difluoro(oxalato)borate as an effective switch. Upon activation, the resulting field-insensitive and electrochemically inert fragments assemble into a self-limiting and compositionally gradient interphase with a boron-rich outer layer. Such coupled interfacial chemistry achieves a counterintuitive field-enhanced stability, enabling the manganese-based sodium layered cathode to cycle stably at 4.5 V with 87.9% retention after 1000 cycles and demonstrating practical viability in 1 Ah pouch cells. The mechanism is further validated across analogous layered oxides, establishing a generalizable paradigm for on-demand interfacial protection in high-voltage batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐 층상 산화물 양극의 고전압(4.5V) 작동 시 계면 안정성을 확보하기 위해 전기장에 반응하는 분자 스위치(EFCA) 개념을 제안했다. 임계 전기장 이하에서는 비활성 상태를 유지하다가 임계값 이상에서 선택적으로 분해·재배치되어 붕소가 풍부한 구배형 계면층을 형성하는 소듐 디플루오로(옥살레이토)보레이트를 발굴했다. 이를 적용한 망간 기반 소듐 층상 양극은 4.5V에서 1000사이클 후 87.9%의 용량 유지율을 보였으며 1 Ah 파우치셀에서도 실용성을 입증했다.

papers.title: Beyond Lithium Solvation: Tuning Cation‐Solvent‐Anion Interactions for Stable Lithium‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Electrolyte chemistry in nonaqueous solvents is central to the electrochemical performance of high-energy rechargeable batteries, yet the molecular basis of ion solvation in these systems remains incompletely understood. In conventional dipolar aprotic electrolytes, the high electron-donating ability of the solvent favors cation-dominated ion-dipole interactions, such that anions remain largely free or are only weakly incorporated into cation solvation structures. Here we establish an explicit molecular picture of cation-solvent-anion ternary interactions in nonaqueous electrolytes and show that these interactions critically govern both bulk electrolyte properties and electrode-electrolyte interfaces. We find that fluorinated ether-based solvents, despite being widely regarded as non-solvating diluents, can exhibit selective solvation of high-electron-donating anions, including halides and polysulfides. Coupling these ternary interactions to the redox chemistry of sulfur electrodes suppresses the dissolution and migration of polysulfide intermediates in ether-based electrolytes, thus mitigating the shuttle effect and improving the cycling stability of Li°||S cells. More broadly, our findings revise the prevailing view of solvation in nonaqueous electrolytes and provide a molecular framework for solvent design and electrolyte formulation to advance high-energy lithium- and other monovalent cation-based rechargeable batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 비수계 전해질에서 양이온-용매-음이온 삼원 상호작용이 전해질 물성과 전극-전해질 계면을 좌우한다는 분자적 모델을 제시했다. 비용매화 희석제로 알려진 불소화 에테르 용매가 할라이드 및 폴리설파이드 같은 강한 전자 donor 음이온을 선택적으로 용매화할 수 있음을 발견했다. 이 삼원 상호작용을 활용해 에테르 기반 전해질에서 폴리설파이드 용출을 억제함으로써 Li°||S 셀의 사이클 안정성을 개선했다.

papers.title: Architected Si-Based Anodes for All-Solid-State Lithium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Silicon anodes have emerged as a key enabler for next-generation all-solid-state batteries (ASSBs). In particular, the Li-Si alloy shows a low expansion coefficient and high ionic/electronic conductivity, but remains plagued by poor mechanical integrity and interfacial stability. Here we describe a Mg-doped Si interlayer at the Li metal-Li6PS5Cl interface, which electrochemically transforms into a Li-rich composite anode comprising Li14.39Mg0.61Si4 and Li-Mg alloy during cycling. Mg incorporation promotes the formation of a homogeneous lithiated Si framework, establishing a continuous ion/electron transport network. In addition, the unique porous architecture effectively mitigates stress and achieves favorable mechanical matching with Li6PS5Cl, thereby enhancing structural stability. Paired with a LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 cathode, the cell with an areal loading of 17.9 mg cm–2 delivers stable cycling over 1000 cycles at 3 C with 92.5% capacity retention. This multicomponent anode design offers a new paradigm for structural engineering of Si-based anodes and paves the way for high-energy-density ASSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬 배터리용 실리콘 기반 음극을 위해 Li 금속-Li6PS5Cl 계면에 Mg 도핑된 Si 중간층을 도입하여, 사이클링 중 Li14.39Mg0.61Si4와 Li-Mg 합금으로 구성된 리튬 리치 복합 음극으로 전기화학적으로 전환시켰다. Mg 도입은 균일한 리튬화 Si 골격 형성과 연속적인 이온/전자 전달 네트워크 구축을 촉진하며, 다공성 구조가 응력을 완화하여 Li6PS5Cl과의 기계적 매칭을 향상시켰다. NCM811 양극과 짝을 이룬 셀(17.9 mg/cm²)은 3C에서 1000회 사이클 후 92.5%의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Transforming spinel LiMn2O4 into a Na-layered cathode
papers.abstract_en: Abstract The positive electrode structures of practical sodium-ion batteries are generally confined to polyanionic or layered transition metal oxide frameworks, where the trade-off between specific energy and structural stability limits their application. As a well-established positive electrode structure in lithium-ion batteries, the spinel framework has abundant storage sites for alkali metal ions, but it has received less attention for sodium-ion batteries. Here we show that spinel LiMn 2 O 4 can be transformed into a sodium-ion positive electrode. Electrochemical sodiation drives Mn-ion migration along an octahedral–tetrahedral–octahedral pathway, creating a layered/spinel heterostructure for further sodium storage. Moreover, residual spinel domains inhibit the strain and structural degradation within the layered structure. Consequently, a 26650 cylindrical cell using a LiMn 2 O 4 -derived sodium-ion positive electrode achieves a capacity of 3.85 Ah and retains 95.7% capacity after 900 cycles (1.925 A). This work demonstrates that spinel LiMn 2 O 4 can serve as a viable positive electrode for sodium-ion batteries, and that electrochemical transformation is a feasible approach for creating positive electrode frameworks.
papers.summary_ko: 스피넬 LiMn2O4를 전기화학적으로 소듐화하여 층상/스피넬 이종구조를 갖는 소듐이온 양극재로 변환하는 방법을 제시했다. Mn 이온이 팔면체-사면체-팔면체 경로를 따라 이동해 층상 구조를 형성하며, 잔류 스피넬 영역이 변형과 구조 붕괴를 억제한다. 26650 원통형 셀에서 3.85 Ah의 용량과 900회 충방전 후 95.7%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.abstract_en: Lithium-metal electrodes offer high specific capacities, but their long-term durability is governed by complex morphological and interfacial evolution that is difficult to resolve from cycle-life metrics and discrete characterization alone....
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전극은 높은 비용량을 제공하지만 장기 내구성은 복잡한 형태학적·계면 변화에 의해 좌우되며, 이는 전체 사이클 수명 지표나 개별 분석만으로는 규명하기 어렵다. 이 연구는 단계별(stage-resolved) 분석을 통해 사이클 수명 향상과 저하를 가져오는 근본 원인을 규명한다.

papers.title: Sequential Regulation of Dendrite Initiation and Propagation for High‐Current Hydroborate‐Based Solid‐State Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Hydroborate solid electrolytes (SEs) offer fast Na + transport, low density, and compatibility with Na metal, yet their current tolerance is restricted by dendrite‐induced short circuits in all‐solid‐state Na metal batteries (ASSNBs). Here, a spatially coordinated dual‐interlayer architecture is developed to regulate dendrite initiation and propagation in Na 4 B 10 H 10 B 12 H 12 (NBH)‐based ASSNBs. At the Na|NBH interface, a three‐dimensional Sn/C framework enables Na infiltration into the porous scaffold and homogenizes current distribution, while dynamically formed Na–Sn sites facilitate Na + transport and redistribution, thereby maintaining intimate interfacial contact and suppressing dendrite initiation. Within the NBH SE, a Na 2.9375 PS 3.9375 Cl 0.0625 (NPSC) sulfide interlayer reacts with penetrating Na to suppress dendrite propagation, with crack‐like pathways terminating near the NBH|NPSC interface. This sequential regulation increases the critical current density from 0.5 to 3.3 mA cm −2 . Symmetric cells operate stably for 7000 and 1000 h at 0.5 and 3.0 mA cm −2 , respectively. Full cells with an O3‐type NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 cathode retain 75% capacity after 800 cycles at 2 C, while supporting cathode loadings up to 15 mg cm −2 . This work establishes sequential control of dendrite initiation and propagation as a design principle for high‐current hydroborate‐based ASSNBs.
papers.summary_ko: 하이드로보레이트 고체전해질(Na4B10H10B12H12) 기반 전고체 소듐 금속전지에서 덴드라이트의 개시와 전파를 순차적으로 억제하는 이중 인터레이어 구조를 제안했다. Na/전해질 계면의 3차원 Sn/C 프레임워크가 전류 분포를 균일화해 덴드라이트 개시를 억제하고, 전해질 내부의 황화물계(NPSC) 인터레이어가 덴드라이트 전파를 차단한다. 임계전류밀도가 0.5에서 3.3 mA/cm²로 향상되었고, 대칭셀은 0.5 mA/cm²에서 7000시간, 3.0 mA/cm²에서 1000시간 안정적으로 작동했으며 O3형 NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2 양극 완전셀은 800회 사이클 후 75%의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Interfacial Electronic Reconstruction Activates TiO 2 in MnO 2 /TiO 2 Heterostructures for Accelerated Sulfur Redox Chemistry
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium–sulfur batteries are promising for next‐generation energy storage but are limited by sluggish sulfur redox kinetics originating from insufficient regulation of interfacial electronic structures. Here, we report a MnO 2 /TiO 2 heterostructure with integrated interfacial bonding, in which residual carbon is inherently incorporated into the interfacial region. The characterizations reveal pronounced reconstruction of the local coordination and electronic environment upon heterostructure formation, including Ti─O─Mn bonding, reduced Ti states, and substantial changes in the surface potential and valence‐band structure. DFT calculations suggest that the reconstructed interface involves the coexistence of net intercomponent charge redistribution and localized bond polarization, with residual carbon contributing to interfacial electronic coupling. Consistent with this reconstructed electronic environment, Ti‐derived sites exhibit enhanced electronic response toward polysulfides, while MnO 2 and residual carbon contribute to the coupled interfacial structure. Consequently, MnO 2 /TiO 2 catalyst enables stable cycling under a high sulfur loading of 9.2 mg cm −2 and, when integrated as a functional interlayer, allows the sulfur cathode to deliver a high specific capacity of 1569 mAh g −1 together with durability over 1000 cycles, with a capacity decay rate of 0.054% per cycle. This work highlights chemically integrated oxide heterointerfaces as an effective platform for regulating local electronic structures and accelerating sulfur redox chemistry.
papers.summary_ko: MnO2/TiO2 이종구조에서 계면 전자구조 재구성을 통해 TiO2를 활성화시켜 리튬-황전지의 황 레독스 반응을 가속화하는 전략을 제시했다. Ti-O-Mn 결합 형성과 잔류 탄소에 의한 계면 전자결합으로 다황화물에 대한 Ti 활성점의 전자적 반응성이 향상된다. 이 촉매를 적용한 전지는 9.2 mg/cm²의 높은 황 로딩에서 안정적으로 작동했고, 1569 mAh/g의 비용량과 1000회 사이클에서 0.054%/cycle의 낮은 용량 감소율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Calendering simulation and structural property analysis of dry coated sulfide solid-state battery cathodes
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates the numerical modelling of the calendering process and its effect on the microstructure, transport properties and electrochemical performance of dry coated Li 6 PS 5 Cl (LPSCl)-based solid state battery (SSB) cathodes. Calendering was simulated using the discrete element method (DEM) with three different LPSCl particle sizes (small (S), medium (M), and large (L)), by combining the elasto-plastic Thornton-Ning model with the adhesive Johnson-Kendall-Roberts model. Model parameters were calibrated using experimental microindentation, and calendering simulations were validated by comparing them with porosities of experimentally produced SSB cathodes. The DEM structures were further evaluated in terms of their contact numbers and effective transport properties, both of which show an increase with higher calendering degrees. Electronic conductivity is lowest for small LPSCl, which stems from the shielding of NCM particles and non-percolating electronic paths through carbon black, due to the large number of LPSCl particles. The ionic conductivity is highest for the small LPSCl particles, which results from more LPSCl-interparticle contacts, leading to a larger number of ionic pathways and thus, lower tortuosity. Electrochemical cycling simulations over a range of C-rates reveal that higher degrees of compaction and medium LPSCl particle sizes lead to the best electrochemical performance, which is attributed to the structure’s optimal combination of electronic and ionic conduction properties at the given weight ratio of materials. In summary, this study presents a simulation-based workflow that investigates the microstructural changes during calendering of sulfide SSB cathodes, correlating processing conditions with microstructure, transport properties, and electrochemical performance.
papers.summary_ko: 건식 코팅된 황화물(Li6PS5Cl) 기반 전고체전지 양극의 캘린더링 공정을 이산요소법(DEM)으로 수치 모사해 미세구조, 수송 특성, 전기화학 성능에 미치는 영향을 분석했다. 서로 다른 LPSCl 입자 크기(소/중/대)에 대해 탄소성 Thornton-Ning 모델과 접착성 JKR 모델을 결합해 캘린더링을 시뮬레이션하고 실험적 미세압입과 다공성 측정으로 모델을 검증했다. 작은 LPSCl 입자는 NCM 입자를 가려 전자전도 경로를 방해해 전자전도도가 낮은 반면 이온전도도는 가장 높았으며, 중간 입자 크기와 높은 압축도의 조합이 최적의 전기화학 성능을 보였다.

papers.title: Beyond anode damage: lithium accessibility redirects cross-electrode electrolyte degradation in Li-O2 batteries
papers.abstract_en: Electrolyte degradation in lithium-oxygen batteries is usually considered to arise from cathode-side oxygen chemistry and parasitic reactions at the lithium-metal anode. However, whether the lithium anode also governs the downstream fate of electrolyte-derived species generated elsewhere in the cell remains unclear. Here, operando cold-trap pre-concentrator gas chromatography/mass spectrometry was used to track trace volatile and semi-volatile products in capacity-limited Li-O 2 cells with high-capacity porous cathodes and either exposed lithium-metal anode or Li + -conducting ceramic-protected lithium-metal anode. Anode protection markedly improved cycling stability and broadly lowered the cumulative responses of TEGDME-derived decomposition products. Importantly, this suppression was not uniform; methanol and 2-methoxyethanol showed higher cumulative responses in the protected cell, indicating that blocking access to the lithium-metal environment can preserve selected products by suppressing their subsequent consumption or conversion. Cycle-resolved profiles support a model in which both cell architectures generate a shared cathode-activated intermediate pool, whereas lithium accessibility promotes additional fragmentation, oxygenation, rearrangement, and product consumption. The lithium anode therefore acts not only as a target of chemical crossover but also as a reactive environment that redirects electrolyte-degradation pathways. Anode protection improves Li-O 2 reversibility by interrupting this cross-electrode electrolyte reaction network.
papers.summary_ko: Li-O2 전지에서 리튬 금속 음극 보호가 전해질 분해 경로에 미치는 영향을 operando GC/MS로 분석하였다. 세라믹으로 보호된 리튬 음극은 노출된 리튬 음극 대비 TEGDME 유래 분해 생성물을 전반적으로 감소시켰으나, 메탄올과 2-메톡시에탄올 등 일부 생성물은 오히려 증가하여 리튬 접근성이 추가적인 분해·소비를 촉진함을 시사하였다. 리튬 음극이 단순한 크로스오버 대상이 아니라 전극 간 전해질 반응 네트워크를 조절하는 반응성 환경으로 작용함을 제시하였다.

papers.title: Tailored Functional Group Design in In‐Situ Polymerized Gel Electrolytes for High‐Voltage, Wide‐Temperature, and Safe Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The demand for ultrahigh‐energy‐density storage has reinvigorated lithium metal batteries (LMBs), yet their practical deployment is hampered by flammable liquid electrolytes and detrimental interfacial reactivity. In situ polymerized gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) present a compelling transitional solution by combining the mechanical robustness of solids with the ionic conductivity of liquids. Despite these advantages, current in situ GPEs grapple with a fundamental trilemma of ionic conductivity, electrochemical stability, and interfacial compatibility, which collectively limit their high‐voltage tolerance, wide‐temperature operability, and intrinsic safety. To overcome these bottlenecks, molecular‐level functional‐group design is crucial. This review systematically analyzes recent advances in functional‐group engineering for in situ GPEs. First, it establishes theoretical frameworks from five dimensions: Lewis acid‐base, frontier molecular orbital, hard‐soft acid‐base, dipole interactions, and steric effects. Subsequently, it thoroughly analyzes key functional group mechanisms across three performance dimensions: high‐voltage stability, wide‐temperature performance, and intrinsic safety. Finally, it outlines prevailing challenges and future directions, aiming to consolidate a theoretical foundation and provide practical guidelines for developing high‐energy‐density, intrinsically safe LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 고전압, 광온도 범위, 안전성을 갖춘 리튬 금속 전지(LMB)를 위한 in-situ 중합형 젤 고분자 전해질(GPE)의 작용기 설계 전략을 체계적으로 분석한 리뷰이다. 루이스 산-염기, 프런티어 분자궤도, HSAB, 쌍극자 상호작용, 입체 효과 등 다섯 가지 이론적 틀을 바탕으로 작용기가 고전압 안정성, 광온도 성능, 계면 반응성(내재적 안전성)에 미치는 메커니즘을 정리하고 향후 방향을 제시한다.

papers.title: Secondary Solvation Shell Regulation for Fast-Charging Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Most electrolyte strategies in lithium metal batteries (LMBs) target the first solvation shell or solvation diversity. However, such approaches have shown limited success in enabling fast-charging, as Li+ depletion inevitably develops at polarized interfaces. Here, we identify the secondary solvation shell as a critical regulator of fast-charging stability and show that a gradient solvation structure (GSS) overcomes ion depletion-induced failure. Guided by intrinsic solvation strengths, we design a tri-solvent electrolyte comprising 1,2-dimethoxyethane (DME), 1,1,1-trifluoro-2,3-dimethoxypropane (TFDMP), and N,N-dimethyltrifluoromethane-sulfonamide (DMTMSA). DME and TFDMP define a stable primary solvation shell and balanced ion-pair distribution, whereas DMTMSA localizes in the secondary shell, suppressing long-range ionic clustering and maintaining interfacial ion availability. Despite similar primary-shell structures and equilibrium impedances, only the tri-solvent system preserves interfacial kinetics under depletion conditions. This architecture enables a Coulombic efficiency of 98.4% at 16 mA cm–2, a specific capacity of 162.0 mAh g–1 at 10C, and 90.4% capacity retention for 200 cycles. These findings establish a gradient solvation structure as a governing principle for fast-charging LMB electrolytes.
papers.summary_ko: 대부분의 전해질 전략이 1차 솔베이션 셸 조절에 집중하는 것과 달리, 이 연구는 2차 솔베이션 셸이 고속 충전 안정성을 좌우하는 핵심 요인임을 규명한다. DME, TFDMP, DMTMSA 삼원 용매로 구성된 구배 솔베이션 구조(GSS)를 설계해 2차 셸에서 장거리 이온 클러스터링을 억제하고 계면 이온 가용성을 유지함으로써, 고속 충전 리튬 금속 전지에서 98.4%의 쿨롱 효율과 10C에서 162.0 mAh/g의 용량, 200사이클 후 90.4%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Reconfiguring Interfacial Electrochemical Potential for Boosting Sodium‐Ion Transport in Composite Solid Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sluggish ion transport kinetics between the ceramic and polymer phases remain a key challenge in composite solid electrolytes (CSEs), primarily due to a severe interfacial barrier arising from their intrinsic physicochemical incompatibility. Herein, molecular design‐enabled electronic structure engineering is proposed to reconfigure the interfacial electrochemical environment at the Na 3 Zr 2 Si 2 PO 12 –poly(ethylene oxide) interface, based on a dual‐axis screening guided by the electron‐donating capability and molecular electronic asymmetry. By grafting different functional trimethoxysilanes from a targeted library onto the ceramic surface, the effect of the interfacial electrochemical potential on Na‐ion transport is investigated, revealing a strong negative correlation with the ionic conductivity of CSEs. The CSE with the optimal grafting molecule (phenyltrimethoxysilane) reduces the potential mismatch by 87% and lowers the Na‐ion migration barrier, thereby boosting Na‐ion conductivity by two orders of magnitude. All‐solid‐state sodium‐metal batteries using this CSE show boosted electrochemical performance with a high capacity of 91.8 mAh g −1 delivered at 5 C and retain ∼99% of their initial capacity after 500 cycles at 2 C. This work establishes a screening framework for reducing interfacial potential mismatch and addressing the long‐standing ion‐transport bottleneck across ceramic–polymer interfaces in CSEs.
papers.summary_ko: 세라믹-고분자 복합 고체전해질(CSE)에서 계면 전기화학적 포텐셜을 분자 설계로 재구성하여 Na+ 이동을 저해하는 계면 장벽을 완화하는 전략을 제시한다. 작용기별 실란 그래프팅을 통해 포텐셜 불일치와 이온전도도 간 강한 음의 상관관계를 규명했고, 최적 조성에서 포텐셜 불일치를 87% 줄이고 이온전도도를 두 자릿수 향상시켰다.

papers.title: Highly conductive halide Na-ion conductor enabled by cost-effective aliovalent carbonate polyanion substitution for all-solid-state sodium batteries
papers.abstract_en: Halide-based Na-ion conductors have attracted intense attention due to their favorable (electro)chemical compatibility with oxide positive electrodes. Among these, zirconium (Zr)-based halide solid electrolytes (SEs) offer a cost advantage over halide SEs based on rare metals, but the relatively low ionic conductivity has limited their application in all-solid-state batteries (ASSBs). Here, we report employing soda ash (Na2CO3) as a low-cost precursor to introduce an aliovalent carbonate polyanion and produce a family of Na-Zr-Cl-CO3 conductors with nominal compositions of (2-x)NaCl-xNa2CO3-ZrCl4. This substitution increases structural disorder and amorphization, creating structural environments that facilitate Na+ transport. At the optimal composition, its ionic conductivity reaches 1.02 mS cm−1 at 25 °C. The optimized Na-Zr-Cl-CO3 SE also exhibits stable electrochemical behavior and favorable mechanical properties. When paired with NaCrO2 positive electrode, the assembled ASSBs deliver an initial discharge capacity of 117 mAh g−1 at 0.1 C and demonstrate a long-term cycling stability at 0.3 C for 850 cycles. This work highlights carbonate polyanion substitution as a practical strategy for improving low-cost Zr-based halide SEs, offering a promising route toward ASSBs with high performance. Zr-based halide solid electrolytes are promising for their lower cost but suffer from limited ionic conductivity. Here, authors introduce carbonate polyanion using cost-competitive soda ash to enhance structural disorder and Na+ transport, achieving 1.02 mS cm−1 ionic conductivity and stable all-solid-state battery cycling for 850 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: 저가의 소다애시를 전구체로 활용해 할라이드계 Na-Zr-Cl-CO3 고체전해질에 탄산염 폴리아니온을 치환 도입함으로써 구조적 무질서도를 높여 Na+ 전도도를 향상시킨 연구이다. 최적 조성에서 25°C 이온전도도 1.02 mS/cm를 달성했고, NaCrO2 양극과 결합한 전고체전지에서 850회 장기 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Engineering Amino‐Induced p‐π Conjugation for Electronic Regulation of Li + Transport in PVDF‐Based Solid‐State Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sluggish Li + transport in poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF)‐based solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs) arises from restricted polymer segmental motion and persistent Li + ‐FSI − association, while conventional fillers provide limited regulation of the local electronic and coordination environments. Herein, amino‐functionalized UiO66‐NH 2 is introduced into a PVDF/lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (LiFSI) electrolyte to construct electronically active composite SPEs (U6NP). The electron‐donating ─NH 2 groups induce p‐π conjugation, redistribute the linker electron density, and strengthen ligand‐to‐metal charge transfer (LMCT)‐related electronic coupling between the organic linkers and Zr‐O clusters. This electronic reconstruction, together with amino‐associated modulation of local O‐centered coordination environments, reshapes the electrostatic landscape, weakens Li + ‐FSI − interactions, and facilitates Li + migration. U6NP delivers a room‐temperature ionic conductivity of 2.41 × 10 −3 S cm −1 , a Li + transference number of 0.56, and an oxidative stability of 4.42 V. More importantly, Li||U6NP||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) cells with a cathode loading of 21.5 mg cm −2 retain 98.51% after 120 cycles at 0.05 C. The Li||U6NP||NCM811 pouch cell delivers 136.6 mAh g −1 initially and 120.9 mAh g −1 after 100 cycles. This work establishes ─NH 2 ‐induced p‐π conjugation‐enhanced LMCT as an effective strategy for electronically active MOF‐reinforced PVDF electrolytes toward high‐loading solid‐state lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: PVDF 기반 고체 고분자 전해질에 아미노 기능화된 UiO66-NH2를 도입하여 p-π 공액과 리간드-금속 전하이동을 통해 Li+-FSI- 상호작용을 약화시키고 Li+ 이동을 촉진하는 전자적 조절 전략을 제시한다. 이를 통해 실온 이온전도도 2.41×10^-3 S/cm, Li+ 전달율 0.56을 달성했고, 고로딩 NCM811 양극과의 셀에서 120사이클 후 98.51%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Achieving Stable Sodium Storage in Sodium Superionic Conductor Anodes via Iron-Enabled Bulk-Interface Confinement for Aqueous Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sodium titanium phosphate (NaTi2(PO4)3, NTP), a promising sodium superionic conductor (NASICON)-type anode for aqueous sodium-ion batteries, suffers from severe capacity fade in alkaline electrolytes due to dissolution of Ti via soluble titanate formation. Herein, we introduce an iron-doping-enabled dual-scale confinement strategy that delivers high capacity and exceptional stability. Iron incorporation in NTP induces a solubility limited behavior: a fraction of Fe enters the NASICON lattice, while excess Fe migrates toward the surface to form a partially amorphous Fe3O4 shell, creating cooperative bulk-shell architecture. The iron-rich outer layer, populated with redox-active Fe3+/Fe2+ couples, acts as a barrier that intercepts and consumes inward-diffusing OH– ions, while inner Fe3+/Fe2+ redox reactions competitively consume residual OH– within the lattice, thereby effectively suppressing soluble titanate formation. This study confirms a synergistic self-protecting and capacity-enhancing mechanism for NTP-based anode design. Consequently, the as-prepared anode delivers a high specific capacity of 164.9 mAh g–1 among all reported NTP anodes, while retaining 90.9% of its initial capacity after 2000 cycles, significantly outperforming previous benchmarks. Paired with a Ni–Co layered double hydroxide cathode, the full cell delivers a high energy density of 106.4 Wh kg–1. This self-organized core–shell dual-defense architecture provides a broadly applicable strategy for stabilizing electrodes in corrosive environments.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 소듐이온전지용 NASICON형 NaTi2(PO4)3(NTP) 음극이 알칼리 전해질에서 겪는 티타네이트 용해 문제를 해결하기 위해 철 도핑 기반 벌크-계면 이중 보호 전략을 제시한다. 철이 격자 내부와 표면 Fe3O4 쉘 양쪽에 분포해 OH- 유입을 차단함으로써 용해를 억제했고, 164.9 mAh/g의 비용량과 2000사이클 후 90.9%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Trigonal Prismatic Coordination Field‐Induced d‐Orbital Splitting Enables σ Electron Activation for Efficient Polysulfide Conversion in Li–S Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Understanding the electron‐transfer pathways and the mechanism in facilitating polysulfide conversion is crucial for the rational design of catalysts in lithium–sulfur batteries. Herein, we designed an NbSe 2 model catalyst to investigate the electron‐transfer pathways at sublayer transition metal cation sites through coordination field modulation, and revealed the relationship between electron transfer and catalytic efficiency. Moreover, the σ *– σ and π *– σ electron transfer channels at transition metal sites are identified in terms of the coordination field theory and hybrid orbital theory, where the σ *– σ channel exhibits higher electron transfer efficiency and therefore enhances the adsorption and conversion role of transition metal sites in polysulfides. The designed trigonal prismatic NbSe 2 exhibits a reversible capacity up to 799 mAh g −1 at a high rate of 5 C, and the battery maintains stability under ultra‐high sulfur loading, achieving a capacity retention rate as high as 95.85%. From an electronic perspective, this work reveals the role of coordination fields on catalytic activity, providing new insights for the rational design of catalysts in metal–S batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 삼각 프리즘형 배위장을 갖는 NbSe2 모델 촉매를 설계하여 리튬-황 배터리에서 다황화물 전환 시 전이금속 사이트의 전자전달 경로를 분석했다. 배위장 이론과 혼성 오비탈 이론을 통해 σ*-σ 전자전달 채널이 π*-σ 채널보다 전자전달 효율이 높아 다황화물의 흡착 및 전환을 촉진함을 규명했다. 설계된 삼각 프리즘형 NbSe2는 5C의 고율에서 799 mAh g-1의 가용량을 보였고, 초고황 로딩 조건에서도 95.85%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Thermodynamically Controlled Multiphase Evolution in Single‐Crystal Cation‐Disordered Li‐Ion Cathode Materials
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Mn‐based disordered rock‐salt (Mn‐DRX) cathodes are promising materials for Li‐ion batteries, yet their application is limited by sluggish Li transport, voltage instability, and capacity fading. Here, we show that thermodynamic control of multiphase evolution from single‐crystal Mn‐DRX overcomes these limitations. Using grand‐potential phase diagrams with in situ and ex situ X‐ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy, we demonstrate that DRX composition and annealing conditions govern transformation into nanocomposites containing DRX, spinel, and monoclinic layered phases, with anatase formation predicted in specific Li–Mn–Ti–O compositions. Oxidative annealing at 300–500°C induces decomposition pathways: Li‐deficient compositions form DRX–spinel (DS) nanocomposites, whereas Li‐rich compositions form DRX–spinel–monoclinic layered (DSM) architectures. Unlike DS materials, which exhibit lower first‐charge capacities than discharge capacities, the monoclinic phase in DSM nanocomposites enables substantially improved first‐charge Li extraction, critical for practical Li‐ion batteries. The DSM nanocomposites deliver reversible capacities approaching 300 mAh g −1 and discharge specific energies exceeding 800 Wh kg −1 , while their cycling stability can be substantially improved by using a highly concentrated electrolyte and restricting the voltage window. This work establishes thermodynamically guided multiphase engineering as a strategy for addressing transport and stability limitations in DRX cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: Mn 기반 양이온 무질서 암염형(DRX) 리튬이온 양극 소재의 다상 전이를 열역학적으로 제어하여 전하용량과 전압 안정성 한계를 극복하는 연구이다. 산화 어닐링 조건과 Li 함량에 따라 DRX-스피넬 또는 DRX-스피넬-단사정 층상구조로 분해되는 경로를 규명했으며, 단사정 층상상을 포함한 나노복합체(DSM)가 첫 충전 시 Li 추출 특성을 크게 개선하여 300 mAh/g에 근접하는 가역 용량을 보였다.
