papers.title: Multiscale Characterizations Toward Energy Storage Carbon Materials From Precursors to Electrodes
papers.abstract_en: -hybridized carbon materials such as graphite, soft carbon, and hard carbon, are broadly used as anodes for alkali-metal-ion batteries owing to their stable and controllable microstructures. However, the inherent structural complexity and multi-stage synthesis processes of carbon materials pose challenges to their comprehensive characterization, limiting a deeper structural understanding and performance improvement of carbon electrodes. This review establishes a comprehensive characterization framework for the multiscale understanding of carbon materials from their precursors to carbon electrodes. Because the structural features of carbon materials are largely inherited from their precursors, we first summarize the recent advances in the characterization of their molecular structures and pyrolysis behaviors. We then discuss advanced characterization techniques and corresponding analysis methods used to understand the multiscale structures of carbon materials, including particles, microcrystals, and pore structures. We further provide a comprehensive overview of static and real time characterization techniques for studying interfacial ion transport and bulk ion diffusion kinetics in carbon electrodes. On this basis, we draw a decision-making framework for multiscale characterization to help readers quickly navigate from problem definition to characterization strategy. Finally, we provide future perspectives to facilitate the efficient scientific investigation and rational design of high-performance carbon materials for alkali-metal-ion batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 알칼리금속이온전지 음극으로 널리 쓰이는 흑연, 소프트카본, 하드카본 등 탄소 소재를 전구체부터 전극까지 다중 스케일로 특성 분석하는 프레임워크를 제시하는 리뷰 논문이다. 분자 구조, 열분해 거동, 미세결정·기공 구조, 이온 전달 거동을 다루는 분석 기법들을 체계적으로 정리하고, 문제 정의부터 분석 전략 선택까지 돕는 의사결정 프레임워크를 제공한다.

papers.title: MEC‐BioSense: Material‐Encoded Capillary Biointerface for Autonomous Whole‐Blood Biomarker Sensing
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Bioelectronic sensing in complex biological fluids is often constrained not by molecular recognition, but by poor coordination of transport, separation, and interfacial interactions at the material level. Here, we present a material‐encoded capillary biointerface that integrates microporous media, microfluidic geometry, and a hydrophilic graphene/poly(3,4‐ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrenesulfonate)/Prussian Blue bioelectronic interface into a unified, self‐regulated architecture. Capillary forces generated within a microfiber network are redistributed through vent‐regulated pathways and stabilized at a hydrophilic mixed ionic–electronic interface, enabling controlled plasma extraction, transport, and analyte delivery without external actuation. System performance is governed by the balance between capillary driving pressure and distributed hydrodynamic resistance, defining an operating regime that simultaneously achieves >99% cellular exclusion, ∼80–93% protein recovery, and stable interfacial wetting. Within this regime, undiluted whole blood is autonomously converted into a reproducible electrochemical signal. Using glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) as a model biomarker, the platform enables direct sample‐to‐answer detection within ∼9 min, spanning 0.02 pg mL −1 to 200 ng mL −1 with an ultralow detection limit (∼0.01 fg mL −1 ) and reduced pre‐analytical loss relative to centrifugation. These results establish that analytical performance is governed primarily by pre‐analytical transport and interfacial regulation and introduce a generalizable nano/micro‐engineered framework for autonomous, scalable point‐of‐care biointerfaces.
papers.summary_ko: 전혈에서 생체표지자를 자율적으로 검출하는 모세관 기반 바이오인터페이스 플랫폼에 관한 연구로, 배터리 소재와는 무관한 생체전자 센싱 기술이다. 그래핀/PEDOT:PSS/프러시안 블루 계면을 이용해 혈장 분리와 전달을 외부 구동 없이 수행하며, GFAP 바이오마커를 약 9분 내 검출할 수 있음을 보였다.

papers.title: Layered Centrosymmetric Copper(II) Coordination Polymer Enabling Four‐Electron Redox Reaction for High‐Performance Sodium‐Ion Battery Cathode
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Conductive copper‐based metal‐organic polymers are attractive cathodes for sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs), yet their application is limited by slow Na + diffusion, active material dissolution, and poor cycling stability. Herein, a layered centrosymmetric Cu‐DDAQ material (DDAQ = 1,5‐diamino‐4,8‐dihydroxyanthraquinone) with an extended π‐d conjugated coordination network is reported as a high‐capacity and structurally stable SIB cathode. The interlayered π‐d conjugated Cu–O 3 N units serve as dual redox centers (Cu 2+ /Cu + and C═O/C–O redox couples), lifting sodium storage capacity, strengthening structure, and suppressing electrolyte‐induced dissolution. The well‐defined π‐d conjugated Cu–O 3 N moieties accelerate charge transfer and fast Na + diffusion, affording high electronic conductivity and favorable reaction kinetics. Cu‐DDAQ delivers a high reversible specific capacity of 270 mAh g − 1 at 0.02 A g − 1 , and maintains a high capacity retention of 77% after 850 cycles at 1.0 A g − 1 , outperforming most reported mainstream organic electrode materials for SIBs. The assembled full cell paired with NaBiIn‐Na metal anode also achieves stable long‐cycle performance, demonstrating its great application potential in low‐cost and high‐performance SIBs. This work presents a rational and universal structural modulation strategy for designing and fabricating high‐stability, high‐capacity conjugated metal‐organic polymer electrode materials, paving a new avenue for the development of advanced, low‐cost SIB energy storage.
papers.summary_ko: Cu-DDAQ라는 층상 중심대칭 구리(II) 배위고분자를 소듐이온전지(SIB) 양극 소재로 제시한다. π-d 공액 Cu-O3N 유닛이 Cu2+/Cu+와 C=O/C-O의 이중 레독스 중심으로 작용해 용량과 구조 안정성을 높였으며, 270 mAh/g의 가역 용량과 850회 사이클 후 77%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Halide-mediated chemistry for enhancing wide-temperature performance of zinc-ion batteries
papers.abstract_en: Aqueous zinc-ion batteries (ZIBs) are attractive for large-scale energy storage owing to their safety, low cost, and environmental friendliness. However, their wide-temperature operation is restricted by the temperature-sensitive nature of water, leading to electrolyte freezing/evaporation and severe parasitic reactions. Current ZIBs electrolyte strategies can suppress water activity and improve thermal stability by introducing oxygen-donor components, but the resulting strong Zn 2+ -O coordination often increases the desolvation energy and limits Zn 2+ mobility, especially under low-temperature conditions. Here, we overcome this trade-off by developing an iodide-mediated hybrid aqueous electrolyte in which I⁻ acts as a non-oxygen-donor ligand to regulate the local electronic environment of Zn²⁺, rather than relying on conventional oxygen-donor components. In this electrolyte, TEP suppresses water activity by disrupting the H 2 O-H 2 O hydrogen-bond network, while I − redistributes the localized charge around Zn 2+ owing to its high polarizability and electron-donating capability. This weakens Zn 2+ -solvent interactions, lowers the desolvation energy, and accelerates Zn 2+ transport, especially at low temperatures. As a result, Zn//Zn symmetric cells using IM-HAE achieve long-term cycling over 7500 hours at −40°C and stable operation at 60°C. Zn//NaV 3 O 8 ·1.5H 2 O full cells deliver 222 mAh g −1 at −40°C and retain 82.8% capacity after 1000 cycles at 60°C. This work unveils the overlooked potential of halide coordination and presents a new design paradigm for wide-temperature aqueous ZIBs.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 아연이온 배터리의 광범위 온도 작동 성능을 향상시키기 위해 요오드화물을 매개로 한 하이브리드 전해질을 개발한 연구로, 리튬/소듐 배터리 소재와는 무관하다.

papers.title: Facet-dependent anion adsorption for electrolyte-Cu interfacial stability in initially anode-free Li-metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: Initially anode-free Li-metal batteries, in which Li-metal is constructed in-situ during charging, enable increased energy density. However, interfacial degradation reactions between the electrolyte and lithiophobic Cu prevent stable solid electrolyte interphase formation on the negative electrode. Here, we elucidate a time-evolving interfacial mechanism in which adsorption of electrolyte components contributes to initial interfacial layer formation and solid electrolyte interphase stability. Most organic solvents adsorb more strongly than Li-salt compounds on Cu through van der Waals dispersion interactions. This preferential adsorption produces a solvent-dominated interfacial layer that undergoes rapid compositional reconstruction during Cu oxide reduction upon initial charging. In contrast, lithium tetrafluoroborate possesses a tetrahedral anion with isotropic charge distribution that binds strongly to the Cu (111)/(100) surfaces and native Cu oxides, producing a tetrafluoroborate-driven interfacial layer that electronically passivates the Cu interface and promotes homogeneous Li nucleation. Consequently, lithium tetrafluoroborate-containing cells achieve 62% capacity retention after 300 cycles at an areal capacity of 4.1 mAh cm−2 and electrolyte conditions of 1.5 g Ah−1 and 4 μL cm−2, establishing a mechanistic basis for adsorption-driven interfacial design in initially anode-free Li-metal batteries. Initially anode-free lithium-metal batteries are limited by unstable interfacial reactions at Cu current collectors. Here, authors show that preferential anion adsorption can stabilize the copper interface and improve long-term cycling.
papers.summary_ko: 초기 무음극(anode-free) 리튬금속전지에서 전해질-Cu 집전체 계면의 시간에 따른 변화 메커니즘을 규명했다. 대부분의 유기 용매는 반데르발스 상호작용으로 Li염보다 Cu에 더 강하게 흡착되어 충전 초기 Cu 산화물 환원 시 급격히 재구성되는 용매 주도형 계면층을 형성하지만, 사면체형 등방성 전하분포를 갖는 테트라플루오로보레이트 음이온은 Cu(111)/(100) 표면 및 자연 산화막에 강하게 결합해 Cu를 전자적으로 패시베이션하고 균일한 Li 핵생성을 유도한다. 테트라플루오로보레이트 함유 전해질 셀은 4.1 mAh cm-2의 면적용량, 1.5 g Ah-1 및 4 μL cm-2 조건에서 300사이클 후 62%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Cytotoxic drugs and bispecific T cell engagers synergize to rewire host immunity and elicit polyclonal antitumor T cell responses
papers.abstract_en: Cytotoxic therapies such as chemotherapy and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) kill tumor cells directly but are limited by resistance, dose-limiting toxicity, and failure to induce durable antitumor immunity. Here we show that tumor-associated antigen (TAA)-targeted CD28 bispecific antibodies (TAAxCD28) convert cytotoxic agents into drivers of durable antitumor immunity. In humanized mouse models, combining the HER2-directed ADC trastuzumab deruxtecan (Tras-DXd) with TAAxCD28 antibodies enhances tumor rejection and promotes durable immune memory in Tras-DXd-resistant cancers, and comparable synergy is observed with 5-fluorouracil (5-FU). This therapeutic strategy allows lower or less frequent cytotoxic drug dosing, potentially limiting systemic toxicity. Mechanistically, TAAxCD28 antibodies promote the activation and expansion of clonally-restricted tumor CD8+ T cells, and adding ADCs or chemotherapy sustains this activation while preserving a naïve/stem-like pool of tumor-specific CD8+ T cells with a diversified T cell receptor repertoire. Each cytotoxic agent supports this T cell activity through a separate innate mechanism: Tras-DXd expands and activates conventional dendritic cells, whereas 5-FU reprograms suppressive myeloid cells toward an immunostimulatory phenotype. Together, these findings support pairing cytotoxic agents with TAAxCD28 bispecifics to overcome resistance and improve long-term tumor control in refractory cancers. TAA×CD28 costimulatory bispecific antibodies are a class of immunotherapeutics that provide tumor-targeted CD28 costimulation to T cells by crosslinking CD28 on T cells to a tumor-associated antigen (TAA) expressed on tumor cells. Here, the authors show that cytotoxic therapies reprogram the tumor microenvironment and augment the antitumor immunity induced by TAA×CD28 bispecifics.
papers.summary_ko: 세포독성 항암제와 이중특이 T세포 인게이저를 병용하여 숙주 면역을 재편하고 다클론성 항종양 T세포 반응을 유도하는 연구로, 배터리 소재와 무관한 암 면역치료 분야 논문이다. (제목 기반 추정)

papers.summary_ko: 리튬이온 배터리의 P2D 전기화학 시뮬레이션을 위한 고정밀 데이터 기반 서로게이트 모델링 기법을 다루는 연구로 추정된다. (제목 기반 추정)

papers.title: Unveiling the Intrinsic Disparity of Ethylene Carbonate and Fluoroethylene Carbonate in Lithium Metal Battery Exceeding 600 Wh kg −1
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium metal batteries (LMBs) are widely considered as the “holy grail” of battery technology, with the potential to achieve energy density exceeding 600 Wh kg −1 . Nevertheless, the inherently high reactivity of Li anode drives persistent electrolyte consumption and thereby rapid capacity degradation of LMBs. Here, it is disclosed that simply replacing ethylene carbonate (EC) with fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) significantly extends the lifetime of LMBs. Compared to LiPF 6 ‐EC based electrolyte, LiPF 6 ‐FEC based electrolyte enhances the cycling stability of LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 ||Li LMBs and enables the 11.13 Ah LiNi 0.95 Co 0.02 Mn 0.03 O 2 ||Li pouch cell to deliver 601.2 Wh kg −1 with stable cycling over 100 cycles. Yet, the intrinsic mechanism disparity of EC and FEC in LMBs remains unclear. Through correlated characterizations, we reveal that EC tends to generate highly soluble low‐molecular‐weight carbonate species, whereas FEC tends to form a LiF‐rich solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) layer containing high‐molecular‐weight lithiated polymers with carbon backbones, possessing dissolution resistance to protect Li anode. Inspired by these polymers, we further construct artificial SEI layers by integrating rubber polymers with LiF to stabilize Li anode. This work elucidates the intrinsic disparity of EC and FEC in LMBs and highlights solvent engineering and artificial SEI layer construction as effective strategies toward high‐energy‐density LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: EC와 FEC 전해질이 리튬 금속 음극 계면에 미치는 근본적 차이를 규명한 연구이다. EC는 가용성이 높은 저분자량 카보네이트 부산물을 생성하는 반면, FEC는 LiF가 풍부하고 탄소 골격의 고분자량 리튬화 중합체를 포함해 용해에 강한 SEI를 형성함으로써 Li 음극을 보호한다. 이 원리를 바탕으로 러버 고분자와 LiF를 결합한 인공 SEI층을 설계했으며, LiNi0.95Co0.02Mn0.03O2||Li 파우치셀에서 601.2 Wh/kg의 에너지 밀도와 100사이클 안정 구동을 구현했다.

papers.title: Unraveling the Intrinsic Interfacial Chemistry of Fluoroethylene Carbonate on Lithium Metal Anodes via a Solvent-Free Model System
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) is a widely used film-forming additive for stabilizing lithium metal anodes (LMAs), yet its intrinsic interfacial chemistry remains elusive because its reactions are coupled with those of solvents and Li salts in conventional electrolytes. Herein, a solvent-free, dry-processed poly(ethylene oxide)-based solid polymer electrolyte (PEO@Dry) is developed as a platform to isolate the interfacial reactions of FEC without interference from traditional liquid organic solvents. PEO@Dry retains the intrinsic interfacial reactivity of PEO and LiTFSI while eliminating solvent-derived interference. FEC is found to undergo a spontaneous chemical reaction with Li metal before electrochemical reduction, producing a dense LiF-rich solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) that is subsequently reinforced by organic species derived from the electrochemical reactions. The resulting SEI exhibits a well-defined composition and robust structure, leading to an enhanced interfacial stability and electrochemical performance. Comparative research with a DME-based liquid electrolyte reveals that FEC (DME@FEC) follows distinct reaction pathways depending on its solvation state. In the solvent-free PEO@Dry system, free FEC undergoes sequential chemical and electrochemical reduction to form an inorganic-rich SEI, whereas in the liquid electrolyte, FEC participates in Li+ solvation and competes with other electrolyte components, yielding a more complex SEI. This work clarifies the interfacial mechanism of FEC and establishes a general solvent-free platform for mechanistic studies of electrolyte additives on LMAs.
papers.summary_ko: 용매가 없는 PEO 기반 고체 고분자 전해질(PEO@Dry)을 플랫폼으로 사용해 FEC가 리튬 금속 음극과 반응하는 고유한 계면화학을 용매 간섭 없이 분리 분석했다. FEC는 전기화학적 환원 전 Li 금속과 자발적으로 반응해 LiF가 풍부한 SEI를 먼저 형성하며, 이후 전기화학 반응으로 생성된 유기 성분이 이를 추가로 보강한다. DME 기반 액체 전해질과 비교하면 FEC는 용매화 상태에 따라 서로 다른 반응 경로를 거쳐, 액체계에서는 더 복잡한 SEI가 형성됨을 밝혔다.

papers.title: Spin‐State Regulation Engineering of Pyrophosphate‐Based Polyanionic Cathodes for Ultra‐Long‐Life Sodium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Developing sodium‐ion cathodes that combine high energy density with ultralong cycling stability requires structural regulation beyond conventional surface modification or single‐site doping. Here, a spin‐state regulation strategy is introduced for iron‐based pyrophosphate cathodes by synergistically substituting Mn and F into Na 3.12 Fe 2.44 (P 2 O 7 ) 2 . The resulting Na 2.92 Fe 2.24 Mn 0.2 (P 2 O 6.9 F 0.1 ) 2 (NFMnPF) modulates an intermediate‐spin Fe 2+ configuration that redistributes charge within the Fe─O─P framework and promotes cooperative Fe─O/Mn─O bond evolution during Na + insertion/extraction. Magnetic susceptibility, Mössbauer spectroscopy, electron paramagnetic resonance, UV‐vis diffuse reflectance spectroscopy, conductivity measurements, in situ x‐ray diffraction, and density functional theory collectively support this electronic structural coupling, revealing narrowed electronic band gap, reduced Na + migration barrier, suppressed volume variation, and highly reversible lattice evolution. As a result, the co‐doped cathode delivers 115.75 mAh g −1 at 0.1 C, an energy density of 336 Wh kg −1 , and exceptional high‐rate durability, retaining 70% capacity after 24 000 cycles at 10 C and 80.93% after 10 000 cycles at 20 C. A hard‐carbon//NFMnPF full cell further achieves energy density of 319.54 Wh kg −1 (based on the cathode active mass) with stable cycling. These findings establish spin‐state mediated cooperative strain accommodation as a powerful design principle for intrinsically durable polyanionic sodium‐ion cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: 철 기반 피로인산염(Na3.12Fe2.44(P2O7)2) 소듐이온 양극재에 Mn과 F를 공동 도핑하여 Fe 스핀 상태를 중간 스핀으로 조절하는 전략을 제시했다. 이를 통해 Fe-O-P 골격 내 전하 재분배와 Fe-O/Mn-O 결합의 협조적 변화를 유도해 밴드갭을 좁히고 Na+ 이동 장벽과 부피 변화를 줄였다. 결과물인 Na2.92Fe2.24Mn0.2(P2O6.9F0.1)2 양극은 0.1C에서 115.75 mAh/g, 336 Wh/kg의 에너지 밀도를 보였고 10C에서 24,000사이클 후 70%의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Regulating Sulfur Redox Microenvironment Through Phase Separation for High‐Energy‐Density Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium‐sulfur (Li‐S) batteries are promising next‐generation high‐energy‐density storage systems as sulfur is abundant and inexpensive and offers high theoretical capacity. However, practical Li‐S batteries require high‐mass‐loading sulfur cathodes and lean‐electrolyte operation, where inefficient sulfur conversion is severely amplified by mechanical instability and high electrode tortuosity. Herein, a phase separation electrode is introduced as an electrode‐level strategy to regulate sulfur redox microenvironment. Controlled solvent‐nonsolvent exchange during phase separation chemically manages polymer demixing, producing an optimized isopropanol‐derived phase separation electrode (PSE‐IPA) with electrolyte‐accessible pores with low tortuosity. Such an architecture facilitates lithium‐ion flux and regulates polysulfide distribution within the cathode, enabling efficient and reversible sulfur conversion. Overpotential deconvolution reveals reduced activation and concentration polarizations during lithium sulfide (Li 2 S) nucleation and growth, while operando impedance and X‐ray diffraction analyses confirm suppressed resistance evolution and reversible sulfur‐Li 2 S phase conversion. Consequently, PSE‐IPA enables an ultrahigh sulfur loading of 13.5 mg cm −2 with an areal capacity of 14.6 mAh cm −2 under a lean electrolyte‐to‐sulfur (E/S) ratio of 5 µL mg −1 . Importantly, a double‐stacked pouch‐type Li‐S battery delivers 298 Wh kg −1 , including package materials under practical conditions with a sulfur loading of 9.6 mg cm −2 and E/S ratio of 3.5 µL mg −1 .
papers.summary_ko: 고하중·린전해질 조건에서 리튬-황 전지의 황 전환 효율을 높이기 위해 전극 수준에서 상분리 전략을 적용한 연구이다. 이소프로판올 기반 용매-비용매 교환으로 굴곡도가 낮고 전해질 접근성이 높은 상분리 전극(PSE-IPA)을 제작해 Li2S 핵생성·성장 시 활성화 및 농도 분극을 줄였다. 13.5 mg/cm²의 높은 황 로딩과 5 µL/mg의 린전해질 조건에서 14.6 mAh/cm²의 면적 용량을 달성했으며, 이중적층 파우치셀에서는 298 Wh/kg을 구현했다.

papers.title: Lithiothermic-Twinning Built-In LiF Ionic Mediators within Li2S@Graphene Cathodes for Anode-Less/Free Li–S Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Li2S is a promising cathode candidate for Li–S batteries; however, its use is hindered by sluggish redox kinetics and severe polysulfide dissolution. Herein, we propose a collaborative multifunctional regulatory strategy via in situ construction of an integrated Li2S-LiF@graphene capsule by one-step lithiothermic symbiosis (8Li + CS2 + CF4 = 2Li2S + 4LiF + 2C). In this cathode architecture, highly dispersed built-in LiF nanocrystals twinned with active Li2S nanocrystals create abundant and fast ionic-conductive interfaces to accelerate Li-ion transport; meanwhile, symbiotic few-layer graphene shells act as electron highways and physicochemical barriers to inhibit polysulfide loss, thus promoting redox kinetics and structural stability. Multiscale structural characterization combined with in situ analysis confirms enhanced structural stability and electrochemical reversibility. Benefiting from the improved electrical and kinetic properties, as well as high volumetric efficiency for accommodating sulfur species, the Li2S-LiF@graphene cathode exhibits a high areal capacity of 6.3 mAh cm–2 under a high Li2S areal loading (8.9 mg cm–2), a thin Li anode thickness (50 μm), and a lean electrolyte-to-Li2S ratio (4.9 μL mg–1). In a completely anode-free Li2S-LiF@graphene//Ni cell, it delivers 882 mAh g–1 and retains 650 mAh g–1 after 100 cycles. This lithiothermic symbiosis approach combined with multicomponent collaborative regulation offers rational Li2S-based cathode engineering for high-performance anode-less/free Li–S batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬열 공생 반응(8Li+CS2+CF4=2Li2S+4LiF+2C)을 이용해 Li2S와 LiF 나노결정이 쌍정 구조로 결합되고 그래핀 쉘로 감싸인 Li2S-LiF@그래핀 캡슐 양극을 제시했다. LiF 계면은 빠른 이온 전도 경로를 제공하고 그래핀 쉘은 전자 전달과 폴리설파이드 유출 억제를 동시에 수행한다. 8.9 mg/cm²의 Li2S 로딩, 50 μm 박형 Li 음극, 4.9 µL/mg의 린전해질 조건에서 6.3 mAh/cm²의 면적 용량을 보였고, 완전 무음극 셀에서는 882 mAh/g을 나타내며 100사이클 후 650 mAh/g을 유지했다.

papers.title: High Atomic Utilization of V 2 AlC MAX Unlocking the Integrated Cathode‐Anode Stabilization Toward Anode‐Less Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Practical lithium‐sulfur batteries (LSBs) require a limited Li inventory to achieve high energy density, however, lithium‐polysulfide (LiPSs) shuttling and irreversible Li plating/stripping continuously consume active Li, making anode‐less LSBs (ALSBs) particularly vulnerable to rapid failure. Herein, a dual‐interface regulation strategy based on bifunctional AlF 3 /V 2 C MXene is proposed to simultaneously preserve the finite Li inventory and regulate S conversion. AlF 3 /V 2 C is obtained directly from V 2 AlC MAX through a gas‐solid reaction that converts the conventionally sacrificed Al layers in situ into functional AlF 3 nanoparticles, achieving synchronous MAX‐to‐MXene conversion and interfacial functionalization. As a three‐dimensional Li host, AlF 3 /V 2 C significantly lowers the Li + desolvation energy barrier, homogenizes Li + flux, and promotes the formation of stable LiF/Li 2 O‐rich interphase, enabling reversible Li plating/stripping for over 4000 h. As a cathode‐side separator modifier, its conductive V 2 C framework and polar AlF 3 sites cooperatively restrict LiPSs crossover and catalyze bi‐directional LiPSs/Li 2 S conversion, thereby reducing S loss and shuttle‐induced Li consumption. With a limited pre‐deposited Li capacity of 3 mAh cm −2 , the ALSBs deliver 1182.3 mAh g −1 at 1 C and retain 778.6 mAh g −1 after 300 cycles. More essentially, our developed high‐atomic‐utilization strategy maximizes both the merits of electroactive Al and V species, achieving the durable ALSBs.
papers.summary_ko: V2AlC MAX상에서 희생되는 Al층을 기체-고체 반응으로 AlF3 나노입자로 직접 전환해 MAX-MXene 변환과 계면 기능화를 동시에 달성한 AlF3/V2C를 제시했다. 3차원 Li 호스트로 사용 시 Li+ 탈용매화 장벽을 낮추고 Li+ 플럭스를 균일화해 LiF/Li2O가 풍부한 계면을 형성, 4000시간 이상의 가역적 Li 플레이팅/스트리핑을 구현했다. 동시에 분리막 개질제로 사용하면 전도성 V2C 골격과 극성 AlF3 자리가 폴리설파이드 셔틀을 억제해, 3 mAh/cm²의 제한된 예치 Li 용량에서도 1182.3 mAh/g(1C)과 300사이클 후 778.6 mAh/g을 달성했다.

papers.title: Glutamine binding and sodium coordination reveal the transport mechanism of y⁺LAT1/CD98hc
papers.abstract_en: The heteromeric amino acid transporter y⁺LAT1/CD98hc (SLC7A7/SLC3A2) mediates electroneutral exchange of cationic and neutral amino acids, with Na⁺ required for efficient transport of neutral substrates. Loss-of-function mutations cause Lysinuric Protein Intolerance (LPI), and emerging evidence highlights the physiological relevance of L-glutamine uptake in immune and bone cells. Here, we present the cryo-EM structure of human y⁺LAT1/CD98hc at 3.4 Å resolution in an outward-open conformation bound to L-glutamine, revealing a non-canonical substrate-binding pose involving Cys320 in TM8. Combining docking and molecular dynamics simulations, and functional assays, we identify a Na+-binding tetrad (Asn49–Ser131–Gly323–Ser327) that underlies Na⁺-dependent transport of neutral amino acids. By contrast, cationic substrates such as L-arginine occupy the same locus with their positively charged side chain, effectively replacing the role of Na⁺ and enabling Na⁺-independent exchange. Mutagenesis and kinetic analyses support this mechanism and reveal a key role for Glu128 during transitions toward inward-facing conformations, providing structural insight into the transport cycle. Collectively, these findings establish how y⁺LAT1 integrates Na⁺ and substrate recognition to mediate the selective exchange of neutral and cationic amino acids. Here, cryo-EM, functional and computational studies reveal how the lysinuric protein intolerance transporter y⁺LAT1/CD98hc integrates Na⁺ and substrate recognition to mediate selective exchange of neutral and cationic amino acids.
papers.summary_ko: y+LAT1/CD98hc 아미노산 수송체의 글루타민 결합 및 소듐 조정 메커니즘을 저온전자현미경으로 규명한 연구이다. 외향개방형 구조에서 TM8의 Cys320이 매개하는 비정형 기질 결합 양상과 Na+ 결합에 관여하는 사중체(Asn49-Ser131-Gly323-Ser327)를 확인했으며, 아르기닌과 같은 양이온성 기질은 동일 부위에서 Na+ 역할을 대체해 Na+ 비의존적 교환을 가능케 함을 보였다. 돌연변이 및 동역학 분석을 통해 Glu128이 내향형 전이에 핵심적임을 추가로 확인했다.

papers.title: Dual‐Anion‐Regulated Localized Weakly Solvating Electrolyte Via Trace Additive for Wide‐Temperature 4.5 V Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Practical high‐voltage lithium metal batteries are limited by the difficulty of simultaneously stabilizing highly reactive Li metal anodes and oxidative cathode surfaces under lean‐cell conditions. Herein, an anion‐rich localized weakly solvating electrolyte is strategically developed by incorporating trace lithium bisoxalatodifluorophosphate (LiDFBOP) into a LiDFOB/FEC‐DMC/TTE electrolyte, in which excessive DFOB − ‐rich aggregates are selectively suppressed to enable a dual‐anion‐involved contact‐ion‐pair (CIP)‐dominated configuration with moderate solvent‐assisted Li + coordination. The regulated solvation environment directs interphase formation at the molecular level, generating robust and ion‐conductive B/F/P‐containing interphases on both electrodes that are responsible for simultaneously stabilizing Li plating/stripping and cathode‐side oxidative interfaces. Consequently, the resulting electrolyte enables high‐voltage operation at 4.5 V over a wide temperature range from −10°C to 75°C. Under stringent lean‐Li (N/P ≈ 1.70) and lean‐electrolyte conditions (20 µL), Li||LMFP, Li||NCM811, and Li||LCO cells deliver stable cycling with 94.1% capacity retention after 270 cycles, 85.9% retention after 200 cycles, and 81.0% retention after 153 cycles, respectively. Furthermore, Ah‐level pouch cells using the optimized electrolyte achieve 90.0% capacity retention after 300 cycles for Li||LMFP and 91.3% retention after 150 cycles for Li||NCM811, outperforming many recently reported electrolyte strategies in terms of practical high‐voltage lithium metal battery performance.
papers.summary_ko: LiDFOB/FEC-DMC/TTE 전해질에 미량의 LiDFBOP을 첨가해 DFOB- 풍부 집합체를 선택적으로 억제하고 이중 음이온 접촉이온쌍(CIP) 중심의 국소 약용매화 구조를 구현한 전해질을 제시했다. 이 용매화 구조는 Li 금속과 산화성 양극 표면 모두에 B/F/P를 포함한 견고하고 이온전도성이 높은 계면을 형성해 -10~75°C의 넓은 온도범위에서 4.5V 고전압 작동을 가능케 한다. 린리튬(N/P≈1.70) 및 린전해질(20 µL) 조건에서 Li||LMFP, Li||NCM811, Li||LCO 셀이 각각 270, 200, 153사이클 후 94.1%, 85.9%, 81.0%의 용량 유지율을 보였고, Ah급 파우치셀도 300사이클(LMFP) 및 150사이클(NCM811) 후 각각 90.0%, 91.3%의 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Boosting Oxygen Transport with Nanoporous Graphdiyne for High‐Capacity Li−O 2 Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Li−O 2 batteries have attracted extensive attention due to their potential to achieve several times higher energy density than Li‐ion batteries. However, the actual discharge capacity and rate performance still fall short of practical requirements, as cathodes made of dense carbon black particles hinder the fast diffusion of O 2 deep into the cathode during discharge, thus severely limiting cathode utilization. In this work, we introduce graphdiyne (GDY) into the cathode to accelerate O 2 transport. GDY is a two‐dimensional material with intrinsic nanopores that allow O 2 molecules to pass through. When incorporated into carbon‐black cathodes, GDY particles forms pathways of low diffusion resistance that facilitate O 2 diffusion deep into the cathode. The accelerated O 2 transport, which is supported by gas permeability measurement, enhances the discharge capacity of the battery by over 4 times to 10.36 mAh cm −2 , equivalent to 950 mAh g −1 (Li2O2+carbon) . Characterization of the discharged cathode reveals that GDY introduction substantially changes the growth of the discharge product, lithium peroxide, promoting its formation both in the form of larger particles and deeper throughout the cathode, thereby contributing to higher discharge capacity. Our findings demonstrate a new strategy for accelerating mass transport to improve cathodes utilization, and ultimately realizing high‐energy‐density Li−O 2 batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-산소 전지의 방전 용량을 제한하는 O2 확산 저항 문제를 해결하기 위해 나노다공성 그래파이다인(GDY)을 카본블랙 양극에 도입했다. GDY 고유의 나노기공이 저저항 O2 확산 경로를 형성해 양극 내부 깊숙한 곳까지 산소 전달을 가속함을 기체 투과도 측정으로 확인했다. 이로 인해 방전 생성물인 리튬퍼옥사이드 입자가 더 크고 깊게 성장해 방전 용량이 4배 이상 증가한 10.36 mAh/cm²(950 mAh/g, Li2O2+카본 기준)에 도달했다.

papers.title: Beyond Lithiophilicity: Multistage Rate Matching in Lithium‐Metal Electrodeposition
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium (Li)‐metal deposition is commonly interpreted using static descriptors, including lithiophilicity, nucleation overpotential, ionic conductivity, or solid‐electrolyte interphase composition. Although these parameters provide valuable insights, none alone determines how an initially nucleated Li deposit evolves under sustained current. Here, we conceptualize Li electrodeposition as a dynamically coupled sequence involving Li + transport, interfacial entry, charge transfer, Li 0 surface redistribution, nucleation, and growth; desolvation is an interfacial‐entry process in liquid electrolytes. Li 0 surface redistribution denotes the lateral motion of newly reduced Li species before incorporation into a growing deposit, with surface diffusion as one possible mechanism. Uniform deposition requires multidimensional kinetic compatibility across these stages, rather than maximization of any individual step. In particular, Li 0 surface redistribution can bridge initial nucleation and subsequent lateral growth, while the decay of morphological perturbations provides a conceptual criterion for deposition stability. From this perspective, solvent chemistry, anions, additives, concentrated electrolytes, polymers, and solid electrolytes can be understood as upstream regulators that reshape the coupled rate chain. This framework shifts lithium‐metal design from optimizing isolated material properties toward engineering a dynamically self‐leveling deposition field through multistage rate matching.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전착 거동을 리튬친화성, 핵생성 과전압 등 정적 지표가 아니라 Li+ 수송, 계면 진입, 전하 전달, Li0 표면 재분배, 핵생성·성장으로 이어지는 동적으로 결합된 다단계 과정으로 재해석한 개념적 프레임워크를 제시했다. 특히 Li0 표면 재분배(표면 확산 등)가 초기 핵생성과 이후 측방향 성장을 연결하는 핵심 단계이며, 형태학적 변동의 감쇠가 전착 안정성의 판단 기준이 될 수 있음을 제안한다. 이 관점에서 용매 화학, 음이온, 첨가제, 농축 전해질, 고분자, 고체 전해질 등은 이 결합된 속도 사슬을 조절하는 상위 변수로 재해석된다.

papers.abstract_en: Over the past three decades, lithium has revolutionized electrochemical energy storage via the widespread deployment of rechargeable lithium-ion batteries, profoundly reshaping global energy consumption patterns. In this Perspective, we reclaim...

papers.title: Unlocking High‐Voltage Li‐Metal Batteries via Additive‐Driven In Situ Semi‐IPN Gel Electrolytes With Coupled Solvation and Interphase Modulation
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Engineering functional additive‐tailored Li + solvation shells is viable for optimizing the conduction and interfacial behavior of gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs). However, prevailing strategies of simplistic concentration elevation may incur compromises while overlooking the polymer host's synergistic role. Here, we propose a facile additive‐coupled polymer topological confinement strategy for Li + solvation reconstruction and interfacial chemo‐mechanics optimization. An in situ semi‐interpenetrating polymer network (semi‐IPN) is constructed by integrating a rigid framework derived from tris[3‐(2‐methylaziridinyl)propionate] (TTMAP) polymerization with flexible linear PFEC chains. These chains, generated via Al(EtO) 3 ‐triggered FEC polymerization and coordinated to Al‐based clusters, are physically entangled and trapped within the rigid TTMAP skeleton. This hierarchical framework topologically confines interstitial spaces, enriching the primary Li + solvation sheath with functional FEC to expedite desolvation kinetics and extend oxidative stability. The N‐containing TTMAP species and dual additives synergistically generate a uniform SEI/CEI rich in inorganic LiF, Li 3 N, and Al 2 O 3 . Consequently, the optimized GPE delivers outstanding high‐voltage stability, retaining 84.2% capacity in Li||NCM811 after 200 cycles (1 C, 4.5 V) and 71.2% in graphite||NCM811 after 1000 cycles (1 C, 4.3 V). This work demonstrates that maximizing Li + ‐solvating additive efficacy relies on coordination regulation rather than simple concentration increase, offering a new perspective for electrolyte optimization.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전지의 젤 고분자 전해질(GPE)에서 첨가제 기반 반(semi) 상호침투 네트워크(IPN)를 형성하는 전략을 제안했다. 첨가제와 고분자 host의 상호작용을 통해 Li+ 솔베이션 쉘을 재구성하고 계면 화학-역학적 특성을 동시에 개선하여, 단순 농도 증가 방식의 한계를 극복하고 고전압 Li 금속 전지 성능을 향상시켰다.

papers.title: Prussian Blue Analogue Cathode Materials for Sodium‐Ion Batteries: A Comprehensive Review
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Prussian blue analogues (PBAs) are promising cathode materials for sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs) because of their open frameworks, tunable redox sites, and low‐cost synthesis. However, they face the critical challenge of balancing specific capacity and cycling stability. This Review examines how their crystal structures, phase transition behaviors, and sodium‐ion migration pathways affect Na + storage in single‐ and double‐electron‐transfer configurations within a specified voltage window. Complementary in situ and operando techniques connect these processes with the structural and chemical changes accompanying capacity loss. The discussion links these changes to cyanide coordination electronic structure, vacancy–water interactions, and multiscale optimization strategies for activating redox sites and retaining their activity during cycling. Challenges and future prospects center on reproducible synthesis, mechanistic validation, and sustained capacity. This review provides guidance for developing high‐performance PBA cathode materials for SIBs.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐이온전지용 프러시안블루 유사체(PBA) 양극재에 대한 종합 리뷰이다. PBA의 개방형 골격 구조, 조절 가능한 레독스 자리, 저비용 합성 장점을 다루며, 결정 구조·상전이 거동·Na+ 이동 경로가 단일/이중 전자전달 구성에서 용량과 사이클 안정성의 균형에 미치는 영향을 분석했다.

papers.title: Percolation and site energy distribution jointly control Li+ transport in disordered rocksalt positive electrodes
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Disordered rocksalt positive electrodes are promising candidates for high-energy batteries, yet their ion transport kinetics is constrained by an incomplete understanding of Li transport in disordered environments. Conventional percolation theory focuses on topological connectivity but often overlooks the critical role of the energy landscape. Here, leveraging actively fine-tuned machine learning interatomic potentials combined with experimental validation, we quantitatively resolve the interplay between Li percolation connectivity and the Li-site energy distribution. We reveal a trade-off whereby increasing cation disorder enhances topological connectivity but concurrently broadens the site energy distribution, inducing a rugged energy landscape that suppresses overall diffusion. To reconcile these conflicting factors, we construct a design map spanning the full Li–Mn–Ti–O composition space, establishing a Li-site energy rectified percolation metric that transforms their interaction into a quantifiable descriptor. This framework enables the identification of Li 1.3 Mn 0.4 Ti 0.3 O 2 , which delivers a specific capacity of 294 mAh g −1 . Furthermore, we demonstrate that inducing a phase transition toward a partially disordered spinel-like state simultaneously enhances percolation connectivity and narrows the energy landscape, achieving a specific capacity of 316 mAh g −1 . This work provides insights into the ion transport mechanisms in disordered electrode materials and offers practical design principles for battery systems.
papers.summary_ko: 무질서 암염형(disordered rocksalt) 리튬 양극재에서 Li+ 전달 메커니즘을 퍼콜레이션 이론과 에너지 지형 관점에서 규명한 연구이다. 기존 퍼콜레이션 이론이 간과한 사이트 에너지 분포의 역할을 머신러닝 원자간 포텐셜과 실험 검증을 결합해 정량적으로 분석하여, 무질서 환경에서의 이온 수송 속도론을 새롭게 설명했다.

papers.title: Overturning the Thermal Instability Paradigm of Ether-Based Electrolytes via Multi-Anion-Driven Solvation Reconstruction
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Ether-based electrolytes have attracted considerable attention due to their excellent ion-transport kinetics and favorable interfacial compatibility with hard carbon anodes. However, their poor thermal stability severely limits the long-term stable operation of sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) under high-temperature operating conditions. Herein, a multi-anion ether-based electrolyte is proposed to concurrently boost the high-temperature tolerance and fast-charging performance of SIBs by regulating solvation structures and enriching electrolyte molecular diversity. The introduction of FSI– and TFSI– anions not only favors the formation of an anion-reinforced solvation microenvironment but also substantially diminishes the size of ionic clusters. The anion-reinforced solvation structure lowers the desolvation energy barrier and promotes the formation of robust, inorganic-rich electrode–electrolyte interphases, which significantly improves high-temperature stability. Meanwhile, the smaller ionic clusters facilitate higher ionic conductivity and homogeneous Na+ flux distribution, thereby effectively suppressing sodium plating under fast-charging conditions. As a result, the Prussian blue||hard carbon full cell delivers superior rate performance and cycling stability at a wide temperature range of 10–100 °C. In addition, Ah-level pouch cells exhibit stable cycling at 55 °C with a reversible capacity of 1023.58 mAh after 800 cycles (80.8% retention) and deliver a high discharge capacity of 1008.99 mAh at 2.0 C.
papers.summary_ko: 하드카본 음극과 호환성이 좋은 에테르계 전해질의 열안정성 문제를 해결하기 위해 다중 음이온 기반 에테르 전해질을 제안했다. 솔베이션 구조 재구성을 통해 소듐이온전지의 고온 내성과 고속 충전 성능을 동시에 향상시켜, 기존 에테르계 전해질의 열적 불안정성 패러다임을 뒤집었다.

papers.title: Molecular‐Cluster‐Driven Interfacial Reconstruction for Stable Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Intrinsic reduction reactions, electron leakage, and solid–solid contact inhomogeneity between Li metal and NASICON‐type Li 1.3 Al 0.3 Ti 1.7 (PO 4 ) 3 (LATP) are central bottlenecks for LATP‐based all‐solid‐state lithium metal batteries (ASSLMBs). Here, aluminum oxo clusters (AlOC) are introduced onto Li metal as organic–inorganic cluster precursors, shifting interfacial protection from static blocking to cycling‐driven electrochemical reconstruction. The precursor interphase evolves into a bilayer reconstructed interphase composed of an organic‐rich outer layer and a Li x AlO y ‐rich inorganic inner layer. The former buffers solid–solid contact fluctuations, while the latter creates an ion‐permissive and electron‐restrictive transport region. As a result, AlOC‐Li||LATP||AlOC‐Li symmetric cells deliver a critical current density (CCD) of 17.3 mA cm − 2 and operate stably for 2500 h at 12 mA cm − 2 and 12 mAh cm − 2 . Moreover, AlOC‐Li||LATP||LiFePO 4 (LFP) full cells retain 83.8 mAh g − 1 after 600 cycles at 2 C, corresponding to 82.5% capacity retention. This work reveals the functional potential of molecular‐cluster‐precursor‐driven electrochemical reconstruction for dynamically stabilizing ASSLMBs.
papers.summary_ko: NASICON형 LATP 고체전해질과 리튬 금속 계면에서 발생하는 환원 반응, 전자 누설, 접촉 불균일 문제를 해결하기 위해 알루미늄 옥소 클러스터(AlOC) 전구체를 리튬 금속 표면에 도입했다. 이 전구체 계면층은 정적 차단 방식이 아닌 사이클링에 의해 유도되는 전기화학적 재구성을 통해 안정적인 전고체 리튬 금속 전지를 구현했다.

papers.title: Modulating Electronic Structure of Li 10.2 SnP 1.9 In 0.1 S 12 Electrolyte via Partial In 3+ Substitution Enables Long Cycling All‐Solid‐State Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Li 10 SnP 2 S 12 (LSPS) has attracted increasing interest as a low‐cost, Ge‐free sulfide solid electrolyte for all‐solid‐state batteries (ASSBs). However, its application remains limited due to poor compatibility with Li metal and interfacial degradation. Structural characterization and theoretical calculations confirm that partial substitution of P 5+ by In 3+ in LSPS regulates local electronic structure. The substitution increases local electron density around sulfur anions in the framework of Li 10.2 SnP 1.9 In 0.1 S 12 (LSPS‐In), reduces electron transfer from Li metal to the electrolyte, and contributes to mitigating interfacial decomposition. The Li + conduction activation energy decreases from 0.242 to 0.227 eV, and the ionic conductivity reaches 4.06 × 10 −3 S cm −1 . Li/LSPS‐In/Li symmetric cells cycle stably for over 1100 h, with reduced formation of interfacial reduction products. B 2 O 3 ‐coated LiNi 0.83 Co 0.11 Mn 0.06 O 2 (NCM83@B 2 O 3 )/LSPS‐In/Li‐In ASSBs deliver an initial discharge capacity of 200.4 mAh g −1 at 0.1 C and achieve 95.2% capacity retention (129.6 mAh g −1 ) after 2000 cycles at 5 C. Moreover, all‐solid‐state lithium metal batteries employing NCM83@B 2 O 3 as cathode and LSPS‐In as electrolyte sustain 500 cycles at 0.5 C with 75.4% capacity retention (133.32 mAh g −1 ). This study demonstrates that local electronic structure regulation via partial In 3+ substitution improves reductive stability of LSPS, providing an effective strategy for LSPS‐based ASSBs with long‐cycling performance.
papers.summary_ko: Ge를 사용하지 않는 저비용 황화물 고체전해질 Li10SnP2S12(LSPS)의 리튬 금속 호환성과 계면 안정성을 개선하기 위해 In3+로 P5+ 자리를 부분 치환했다. 구조 분석과 이론 계산을 통해 치환이 황 음이온 주변 전자 밀도를 높여 전자 구조를 조절함을 확인했으며, 이를 통해 전고체전지의 장수명 사이클링을 구현했다.

papers.title: Local Symmetry Engineering Unlocks Stable Multi‐Electron Chemistry in NASICON Cathodes for High‐Energy‐Density Sodium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs) hold great promise for large‐scale energy storage, but their advancement is constrained by the instability of multi‐electron redox reactions in cathode materials. In NASICON‐type phosphates, the high‐voltage V 4+ /V 5+ redox couple often suffers from poor reversibility, fundamentally rooted in the trade‐off between redox activity and structural stability. Here, we demonstrate that this limitation can be overcome by a local symmetry engineering strategy that precisely regulates the [VO 6 ] octahedra. Leveraging the complementary ionic radii and electronic configurations of Fe 2+ and Al 3+ , the co‐substitution achieves a controlled symmetry reduction of the [VO 6 ] units while maintaining the structural integrity of the NASICON framework. This symmetry reduction triggers a reconfiguration of the V 3d orbitals and promotes electron delocalization. Experimental and theoretical analyses confirm the electrochemical performance strongly depends on the symmetry of [VO 6 ] octahedra: moderate symmetry reduction enhances cycling stability, whereas excessive reduction leads to performance degradation. The optimized Na 3.6 V 1.2 Fe 0.6 Al 0.2 (PO 4 ) 3 cathode exhibits a high reversible capacity of 151.4 mAh g −1 corresponding to a 2.6‐electron transfer and exceptional cycling stability (84.6% capacity retention after 10,000 cycles at 20C). This work establishes octahedral symmetry engineering as an effective strategy to unlock stable multi‐electron redox chemistry in polyanionic cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: NASICON형 소듐이온 양극의 V4+/V5+ 다전자 레독스 가역성을 높이기 위해 [VO6] 정팔면체의 국소 대칭성을 조절하는 전략을 제시했다. Fe2+와 Al3+를 공동 치환해 [VO6]의 대칭성을 적절히 낮추면 V 3d 오비탈 재배열과 전자 비편재화가 촉진되나, 과도한 대칭성 저하는 성능을 저하시킴을 실험과 이론으로 확인했다. 최적화된 Na3.6V1.2Fe0.6Al0.2(PO4)3 양극은 2.6전자 전달에 해당하는 151.4 mAh/g의 가용용량을 보였고 20C에서 10,000사이클 후 84.6%의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Li–B–Mg Composite Foils With a LiB 0.88 Microrod Array Enable Ultrathin Self‐Supporting Lithium Metal Anodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Ultrathin self‐supporting lithium foils (USSLFs, ≤50 µm) are highly desirable for high‐energy‐density batteries, as eliminating current collectors enhances energy density and reduces material costs. However, the intrinsic mechanical vulnerability of metallic Li remains a critical barrier to both the fabrication and long‐term cycling of USSLFs. Herein, we develop a Li‐rich Li–B–Mg composite foil (LBM) through sequential melt alloying followed by post‐solidification thermomechanical processing, yielding a dense and interconnected LiB 0.88 microrod array with LiMg and MgB 2 lithiophilic phases within the Li‐rich matrix. This architecture enables large‐area (>170 cm 2 ) self‐supporting foils down to 15 µm while preserving a high Li content. During cycling, the microrod array redistributes local stress and restrains deformation, preserving the internal architecture and accessibility of lithiophilic sites. These sites, in turn, favor Li accommodation within the electrode interior, suppressing surface Li accumulation and alleviating local stress concentration. This self‐sustained coupling between stress regulation and lithiophilic guidance supports stable cycling for over 5000 h in symmetric cells using 50 µm LBM foils with about 10% thickness expansion, while 15 µm foils cycle for over 500 h at a depth of discharge of about 37.4%. This work advances the design of practical USSLFs for high‐energy lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 집전체 없이 자기지지(self-supporting) 가능한 초박형 리튬 금속박(50 µm 이하)을 구현하기 위해 LiB0.88 마이크로로드 배열을 포함한 Li-B-Mg 복합 합금 포일을 개발했다. 순차적 용융 합금화와 고상 열기계 공정을 통해 리튬 금속의 기계적 취약성 문제를 해결하여 고에너지밀도 전지에 적용 가능한 초박형 리튬 음극을 제작했다.

papers.title: Interphase-Adaptive Chloride Solid Electrolyte Enables High-Performance All-Solid-State Lithium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Halide solid electrolytes offer a compelling combination of wide electrochemical stability and high safety for all-solid-state lithium batteries (ASSLBs), yet their practical application is severely hindered by interfacial degradation, mechanical contact loss, and low active-material utilization when paired with Ni-rich layered oxide cathodes. Here we synthesize a monoclinic Li2.4Yb0.4Zr0.6Cl6 (LYZC) with a high ionic conductivity of 2.1 × 10–3 S·cm–1 at 30 °C, and then coat it with an ultrathin amorphous organic interphase (LYZC@CH) through an organic-solvent-assisted low-temperature strategy. The adaptive organic interphase transforms the intrinsically rigid chloride electrolyte into a chemo-mechanically compliant ion conductor that accommodates cathode volume variation while preserving rapid lithium–ion transport. Consequently, the engineered electrolyte stabilizes the cathode/electrolyte interface, suppresses parasitic interfacial reactions and structural degradation, and enables composite cathodes with a high active-material content of 90%. The resulting LiNi0.83Co0.12Mn0.05O2 composite cathode delivers an electrode-level energy density of 402.22 Wh kg–1 and retains nearly 100% of its capacity after 2000 cycles at 5 C in 30 MPa. This work establishes an electrolyte-centered interfacial engineering strategy for practical high-energy all-solid-state lithium batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬전지에서 할라이드 고체전해질이 Ni-rich 층상 양극재와 결합할 때 발생하는 계면 열화, 기계적 접촉 손실, 활물질 저활용 문제를 해결하기 위해 단일클리닉 Li2.4Yb0.4Zr0.6Cl6(LYZC, 이온전도도 2.1×10⁻³ S/cm)를 합성하고 계면 적응형 코팅을 적용했다. 이를 통해 고성능 전고체 리튬전지를 구현했다.

papers.title: Fabrication of Tri‐Phase Lithium Alloy in Seconds via an Implosion‐Popcorn Reaction Toward Stable Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Introducing non‐lithium components to fabricate lithium‐based alloy anodes has emerged as a paramount strategy to enhance the processability and stability of lithium metal batteries. However, conventional fabrication suffers from the sluggish wetting kinetics of lithium with non‐lithium components, inducing severe phase heterogeneity and component agglomeration. Herein, we report an ultrafast, spontaneous implosion‐popcorn reaction that explosively disintegrates centimeter‐scale precursor ingots into ultra‐fine particles within seconds, yielding a uniformly dispersed tri‐phase alloy with an interpenetrating network of Fe, Li 3 P, and Li. The as‐obtained lithium alloy exhibits a significantly enhanced Young's modulus and can be processed into different forms, including coatable slurries, self‐standing foils, and active powders. This fabrication method shifts from traditional passive alloying to an active, highly efficient, and homogenous approach. When used as an anode, the homogeneous Li/Fe/Li 3 P architecture facilitates interfacial Li‐ion transfer and regulates initial Li nucleation, thereby promoting dense and uniform Li growth and enabling a cycling lifespan of over 3000 h, together with improved full‐cell stability.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전지의 처리성과 안정성을 높이기 위한 비리튬 성분 합금 음극 제작에서, 기존 공정의 느린 젖음 속도 문제를 해결하고자 '임플로전-팝콘 반응'이라는 초고속 자발 반응을 이용해 수초 내에 3상 리튬 합금을 제조하는 방법을 제안했다. 이 방법은 센티미터 스케일 전구체를 폭발적으로 분해해 상 불균일과 성분 응집을 억제했다.

papers.title: Ether‐Oxygen‐Functionalized Ionic Liquid Electrolytes Enabling Intrinsically Safe 535 Wh Kg −1 Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT High‐energy‐density lithium metal batteries (LMBs) suffer from the flammability of carbonate electrolytes and the high reactivity of lithium metal anodes. Ionic liquids (ILs) offer a nonflammable alternative, but their high viscosity and sluggish Li + transport hinder practical use. Herein, we introduce an ether oxygen (C‐O‐C) group into the alkyl side chain of a pyrrolidinium‐based IL cation. This molecular‐level modification weakens cation–anion interactions, lowers viscosity, and enhances ionic conductivity. Concurrently, the solvation structure shifts from large anion aggregates (AGGs) to uniform contact ion pairs (CIPs), accelerating Li + transport and promoting a robust, inorganic‐rich solid electrolyte interphase (SEI). The resulting electrolyte enables a Li||LiNi 0.9 Co 0.05 Mn 0.05 O 2 (NCM90) coin cell to retain 82.1% of its capacity after 240 cycles at 1 C, and a 3.8 Ah pouch cell to achieve an energy density of 535.3 Wh kg −1 while passing nail penetration and overcharge tests without thermal runaway. Accelerating rate calorimetry (ARC) measurements show that both the self‐heating onset temperature (T 1 ) and the thermal runaway threshold temperature (T 2 ) exceed those of carbonate electrolytes by more than 1.5 times. This work establishes a clear structure–property–performance relationship and provides molecular‐level guidance for designing low‐viscosity, nonflammable IL electrolytes toward high‐energy‐density and intrinsically safe LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 탄산염 전해질의 가연성과 리튬 금속 음극의 높은 반응성 문제를 해결하기 위해 에테르 산소(C-O-C) 기능기를 피롤리디늄계 이온성 액체(IL) 양이온의 알킬 측쇄에 도입했다. 이 분자 수준 개질로 양이온-음이온 상호작용을 약화시켜 점도를 낮추고 Li+ 수송을 개선함으로써, 535 Wh/kg급 본질적으로 안전한 리튬 금속 전지를 구현했다.

papers.title: Electrostatically Engineered Soft Interphases Enable Fast Ion Transport in High‐Loading Solid‐State Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT High‐energy density solid‐state batteries are constrained by sluggish ion transport in thick composite cathodes, where increasing active material loading amplifies ionic transport limitations. Incorporating fast ion conductors into cathode architectures offers a promising approach to accelerate lithium‐ion diffusion. However, severe interparticle ionic resistance between conductor particles remains a major obstacle to achieving practical high mass loadings. Here, we propose a soft interface strategy based on the electrostatic self‐assembly of carboxymethyl chitosan onto Li 0.33 La 0.56 TiO 3 nanoparticles to construct a compliant ion‐conducting interfacial layer. This interfacial architecture simultaneously strengthens interparticle contact, and establishes continuous ion transport pathways, thereby effectively overcoming the ion transport bottlenecks that limit high‐loading cathodes. The LiNi 0.6 Co 0.2 Mn 0.2 O 2 composite cathodes (20 mg cm −2 ) deliver an areal capacity of 2.2 mAh cm −2 at 2 C (7.2 Ma cm −2 ) at room temperature, and the strategy is successfully extended to lean lithium and anode‐free solid‐state batteries. This work establishes a soft interface design strategy for overcoming interfacial ion transport limitations and provides an effective route toward practical high‐energy density and fast‐charging solid‐state batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 고하중 전고체 양극에서 이온 전도체 입자 간 저항이 이온 수송을 제한하는 문제를 해결하기 위해 Li0.33La0.56TiO3 나노입자 표면에 카르복시메틸 키토산을 정전기적으로 자기조립시킨 부드러운 계면층을 제안했다. 이 계면은 입자 간 접촉을 강화하고 연속적인 이온 수송 경로를 형성해 고로딩 양극의 이온 수송 병목을 완화한다. 20 mg/cm² 로딩의 LiNi0.6Co0.2Mn0.2O2 복합 양극은 상온 2C(7.2 mA/cm²)에서 2.2 mAh/cm²의 면적 용량을 보였으며, 이 전략은 린리튬 및 무음극 전고체 전지로도 확장되었다.

papers.title: Dynamic Interfacial S–O Bonding Stabilizes Oxygen Redox Through Reversible Electron Confinement
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The reversible activation of lattice oxygen represents a transformative opportunity for high‐energy battery electrodes but remains fundamentally limited by the instability of oxidized oxygen states. In layered oxide cathodes, oxygen oxidation generates oxygen‐centered hole states that become electronically unstable at particle surfaces, triggering oxygen loss, interfacial reconstruction, and irreversible electrochemical degradation. Here, we develop an interfacial electronic regulation strategy that stabilizes oxygen redox through reversible sulfur–oxygen (S–O) bonding. During charging, dynamic S–O bond formation at the cathode surface confines oxygen hole states and suppresses their delocalization and irreversible evolutions, whereas bond dissociation upon discharge restores the lattice oxygen electronic configuration and enables reversible oxygen redox. Applied to the Na 0.72 Li 0.24 Mn 0.76 O 2 layered oxide cathode, this strategy enables stable oxygen redox activity, mitigates voltage decay, and improves long‐term cycling stability. These findings establish reversible interfacial electron confinement as a general design principle for regulating unstable oxygen electronic states and advancing durable high‐energy‐storage materials.
papers.summary_ko: 층상 산화물 양극에서 격자 산소 산화로 생성되는 산소 중심 홀 상태의 표면 불안정성이 산소 손실과 계면 재구성을 유발하는 문제를 다뤘다. 계면에서 동적인 S-O 결합을 형성해 전자를 가역적으로 가두는(electron confinement) 전자 구조 조절 전략을 개발하여 산소 레독스를 안정화시켰다.

papers.title: Decoupling lattice stabilization and interfacial kinetics through asymmetric heterointerfaces for high-voltage LiCoO2 cathode
papers.summary_ko: 고전압 LiCoO2 양극에서 비대칭 헤테로계면을 설계하여 격자 안정화와 계면 반응속도론을 분리(decoupling)하여 제어하는 전략을 제안한 연구이다. (제목 기반 추정)

papers.title: Covalently Integrated MXene–Fluorinated Polymer Electrolytes for 714 Wh Kg −1 Lithium–Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Polymer electrolytes are promising for high‐energy and safe lithium–metal batteries yet limited by inadequate mechanical integrity, sluggish Li + transport, and unstable electrode–electrolyte interfaces. Here, we report a covalently integrated MXene–fluorinated gel polymer electrolyte (MF‐GPE) through in situ polymerization. Acrylate‐grafted MXene nanosheets act as chemically anchored crosslinkers within a fluorinated polymer network, distinguishing from conventional physically blended composites. The covalent framework not only mechanically reinforces the polymer matrix but also regulates Li + solvation structure and lowers the activation energy for Li + transport. Consequently, the MF‐GPE enables uniform lithium deposition and constructs robust, inorganic‐rich interphases on both lithium–metal anodes and high‐voltage cathodes. It delivers an ionic conductivity of 3.3 mS cm −1 at 25°C and supports stable cycling of LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 , LiCoO 2 and LiNi 0.5 Mn 1.5 O 4 cathodes at cut‐off voltages up to 4.9 V. Notably, a MF‐GPE based Li||LiCoO 2 pouch cell achieves cell‐level energy densities of 713.9 Wh kg −1 at 4.8 V and 605.2 Wh kg −1 at 4.6 V, maintaining stable operation over 60 cycles, while 18650 cylindrical cells operate stably for 500 cycles. Ah‐class pouch cells demonstrate outstanding safety under nail‐penetration and overcharge tests. These findings establish covalent MXene‐polymer integration to couple ion solvation structure and interphase stabilization for high‐energy, abuse‐tolerant lithium–metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 아크릴레이트로 그래프트된 MXene 나노시트를 가교제로 사용해 불소화 고분자 네트워크에 공유결합으로 통합한 겔 고분자 전해질(MF-GPE)을 현장중합으로 제작했다. 공유결합 골격은 고분자 매트릭스를 기계적으로 보강하면서 Li+ 용매화 구조를 조절하고 Li+ 수송 활성화 에너지를 낮춰, 균일한 리튬 전착과 Li 금속 음극 및 고전압 양극 양쪽에 무기물이 풍부한 견고한 계면을 형성한다. 25°C에서 3.3 mS/cm의 이온전도도를 보였고, LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2·LiCoO2·LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4 양극에서 최대 4.9V 컷오프까지 안정 구동했으며, Li||LiCoO2 파우치셀은 4.8V에서 713.9 Wh/kg, 4.6V에서 605.2 Wh/kg의 셀 수준 에너지 밀도를 60사이클 동안 유지했다.

papers.title: Anion manipulation for breaking through 3.0 V of aluminium–graphite batteries
papers.summary_ko: 알루미늄-흑연전지에서 3.0V 전압 장벽을 극복하기 위한 음이온 제어 전략을 다룬 연구이다. (제목 기반 추정)

papers.title: A Scalable Protrusion‐Targeted Electrolyte Enables 500 Wh Kg −1 Lithium Metal Batteries With 500‐Cycle Stability
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The development of lithium metal batteries (LMBs) is severely impeded by limited cycle life arising from irreversible lithium dendrite growth. Herein, we design a scalable, protrusion‐targeted electrolytes to achieve industrial‐scale LMBs through retarding the formation of dendritic lithium embryos. The site‐selective‐blocking molecules preferentially adsorbs onto protrusive sites of lithium deposition, which inhibits the local lithium deposition rate to block dendrite initiation. More importantly, the abundant polar functional groups of adsorbed molecules induce directional enrichment of anions, achieving passivation repair of fresh dendritic lithium. This synergy of selective adsorption and interfacial repair effectively inhibits the self‐amplifying growth of lithium dendrites, thereby mitigating continuous electrolyte consumption. An 8 Ah‐level pouch cell with 500 Wh kg −1 delivers an impressive capacity retention of over 80% after 525 cycles. Furthermore, we show large‐scale production of electrolytes for preparing industrial‐scale LMBs. This design offers a viable approach for long‐life LMBs at an industry compatible scale.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전지의 비가역적 덴드라이트 성장으로 인한 수명 저하 문제를 해결하기 위해, 리튬 돌기(protrusion) 부위를 표적하는 확장 가능한 전해질을 설계했다. 자리 선택적 차단 분자가 돌출된 리튬 증착 부위에 우선적으로 흡착해 국소 증착 속도를 억제함으로써 덴드라이트 형성을 초기에 차단하며, 500 Wh/kg급에서 500회 사이클 안정성을 달성했다.

papers.title: Thin-film lithium niobate waveguide-integrated p-i-n Tungsten selenide photodiodes with 10Gbit/s data reception
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) is a promising photonic platform in next-generation integrated optoelectronics and on-chip/chip-chip interconnection due to its attractive optical property and versatility. However, integration of conventional-material-based photodetectors on TFLN platforms still faces multiple challenges. Herein, a high-bandwidth TFLN-based waveguide-integrated lateral WSe 2 p-i-n photodetector is presented. The localized self-aligned doping process eliminates slow carrier diffusion and defect trapping in doped regions which further boosts modulation bandwidth. Secondly, n-type and p-type Ohmic contacts, along with a high-quality p-n junction, are achieved through Se vacancy defect engineering and high-work function molybdenum oxide buffer layer, respectively. Furthermore, combined with the high dielectric constant of lithium niobate suppressing ionized impurity scattering, carrier mobilities exceeding 350 cm 2 /V·s are achieved for both electrons and holes, significantly accelerating carrier drift. The device features a measured bandwidth of 1.12 GHz and a data rate up to 10 Gbit/s in visible light. Separately, the device achieves a responsivity of ~492 mA·W −1 and a near-unity external quantum efficiency of 95.6% at 638 nm. This combination of two-dimensional homostructure and TFLN nano-waveguides provides a basis for high-speed photodetectors and visible-light interconnections in future TFLN integrated optoelectronics and optical input/output applications.
papers.summary_ko: 박막 리튬나이오베이트(TFLN) 플랫폼에 텅스텐셀레나이드(WSe2) p-i-n 광검출기를 집적하여 10Gbit/s급 데이터 수신이 가능한 광소자를 구현한 연구이다. 자기정렬 도핑과 Se 공공 결함 제어를 통해 고품질 p-n 접합과 우수한 캐리어 이동도를 달성하였으며, 638nm에서 95.6%의 양자효율을 보였다. 배터리 소재와는 무관한 광전자 소자 분야의 연구이다.

papers.title: Regulation of Anionic Redox Reaction Voltage by Energy Band Modulation for Li-Rich Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Anionic redox reaction (ARR) promises high energy density for Li-rich cathodes yet suffers from severe voltage decay. Here, we investigate ARR voltage modulation in a Li2S-modified quasi-solid Li-rich cathode (Li2S-LRM), which exhibits a distinct low-voltage ARR plateau (2.0–2.8 V). Combining in situ XRD, S K-edge XANES, EELS, Ar-etched XPS and DFT calculations, we validate in situ electrochemical sulfur doping. Upon cycling, the material forms bulk LixS/Li–S–O species alongside a dominant Li2SO3/Li2SO4 polyanion interphase that realizes oxygen trapping. Vacancy-cluster formation facilitates reversible S-involved charge compensation, where sulfur redox activity progressively intensifies during long cycling. Enabled by the band-modulation and oxygen-trapping effects, Li2S-LRM achieves a high average Coulombic efficiency of 99.6% and suppressed voltage decay (0.28 vs. 0.83 mV cycle–1 for pristine LRM). This work deepens mechanistic insights into ARR and provides rational design guidance for high-performance anionic-redox cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: Li2S를 도입한 준고체 Li-rich 양극(Li2S-LRM)에서 음이온 레독스 반응(ARR) 전압을 조절한 연구이다. 사이클 중 Li2SO3/Li2SO4 계면이 형성되어 산소 트래핑을 유도하였으며, 이를 통해 평균 쿨롱 효율 99.6%와 전압 감쇄 억제(0.28 대 0.83 mV/cycle)를 달성하였다. 밴드 조절과 산소 트래핑 효과를 통해 고성능 음이온 레독스 양극 설계를 위한 메커니즘적 통찰을 제공한다.

papers.title: Hybrid Weakly Coordinated Solvents for Fast-Charging and Wide-Temperature Sodium-Ion Full Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract The application of sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) in wide-temperature and fast-charging scenarios is severely constrained by the performance limitations of electrolytes. Conventional ester-based electrolytes struggle to simultaneously achieve high ionic conductivity, low desolvation energy, and excellent interfacial stability. Herein, we propose a hybrid solvent system comprising ethyl propionate and ethoxy(pentafluoro)cyclotriphosphazene (PFPN), aiming to synergistically enhance the rate capability and temperature adaptability of SIBs. The relatively weak coordination ability of both solvents effectively promotes anion participation in solvation structure, significantly lowering the Na+ desolvation energy barrier and inducing the formation of stable, inorganic-rich electrode/electrolyte interphases. Meanwhile, the dual-solvent combination increases the diversity of solvation configurations and reduces ion clustering, thereby enhancing ionic conductivity. The intrinsic nonflammability and excellent film-forming ability of PFPN further enhance safety and synergistically strengthen interfacial stability. Therefore, Prussian blue||hard carbon full cells operate stably over a wide temperature range from −50 to 100 °C. Notably, ampere-hour-level pouch cells deliver a capacity retention of 86.3% after 300 cycles at 25 °C and maintain stable operation for over 100 cycles even at −20 and 80 °C. This solvent synergy strategy offers a practical new pathway for the development of electrolytes for SIBs in extreme environments.
papers.summary_ko: 에틸프로피오네이트와 PFPN을 결합한 약배위 하이브리드 용매 시스템을 제안하여 나트륨이온전지의 고속 충전 및 광범위 온도 성능을 향상시킨 연구이다. 약한 용매 배위력으로 음이온이 솔베이션에 참여하도록 유도해 탈솔베이션 에너지를 낮추고 무기물 위주의 안정적 계면을 형성시켰다. 프러시안블루||하드카본 파우치셀은 -50~100°C의 넓은 온도범위에서 작동하며 25°C 300사이클 후 86.3%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Engineering Ultrathin, Tough Polymer Networks for Stable Lithium Metal Anode Interphases
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Interfacial degradation and dendritic lithium (Li) growth remain critical bottlenecks for practical Li metal batteries (LMBs). Herein, we introduce a tough, ion-conductive poly(2-(dimethylamino)ethyl methacrylate) (pDMAEMA) nanolayer on Li metal via photo-initiated chemical vapor deposition (piCVD). The photo-mediated, solvent-free piCVD enables nanometer-scale coatings with systematic control over photo-crosslinking and chain entanglement without compromising Li surface integrity. This systematic control yields an optimized polymer network balancing toughness (36.3 MJ m–3) and viscoelasticity (10.3% linear viscoelastic strain limit) to accommodate repeated Li volume changes. Furthermore, interactions between pDMAEMA and PF6– anions promote a mechanically durable LiF-rich solid electrolyte interphase, thereby supporting uniform Li deposition. Pouch-type bi-cells employing the optimized 100 nm polymer-coated Li anode achieve an energy density of 338 Wh kg–1 and 80% capacity retention after 90 cycles under practical conditions (N/P = 2, E/C = 3 g Ah–1). This ultrathin, tough polymer network offers a promising design principle for high-energy LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 광개시 화학기상증착(piCVD)을 이용해 리튬 금속 표면에 초박막의 질기고 이온전도성이 있는 pDMAEMA 고분자 나노층을 형성하여 리튬금속전지의 계면 안정성을 개선한 연구이다. 이 고분자망은 높은 인성(36.3 MJ/m³)과 점탄성을 가지며 PF6- 음이온과 상호작용해 LiF가 풍부한 기계적으로 견고한 SEI 형성을 유도한다. 100nm 코팅된 리튬 음극을 적용한 파우치형 바이셀은 338 Wh/kg의 에너지밀도와 90사이클 후 80%의 용량 유지율을 달성하였다.

papers.title: Cobalt based anode for highly stable alkaline water electrolysis under operation conditions beyond industrial requirements
papers.abstract_en: Alkaline water electrolysis is the most established route to electrochemical hydrogen production, but the limited lifetime of anode catalysts makes long-term equipment investment costly and hinders miniaturization. Here we show that, unlike the extensively investigated nickel- and nickel–iron-based hydroxides, the long-neglected cobalt–nickel hydroxides are promising anode catalysts whose stability exceeds current industrial requirements. A cobalt–nickel layered double hydroxide anode enables stable alkaline water electrolysis for more than 8,000 hours at 1 A cm–2 in 6 M sodium hydroxide at 80 °C. This stability arises from the strengthened metal–oxygen bonding of the in-situ-formed cobalt–nickel oxyhydroxide, which raises the energy barrier for lattice-oxygen loss during the oxygen evolution reaction. In a practical electrolyzer, the anode achieves an energy consumption of ~4.2 kWh per normal cubic metre of hydrogen at 1 A cm–2 and operates stably for thousands of hours. The design of high-current-density alkaline electrolyzers should therefore prioritize robust anode stability under industrial conditions in addition to activity optimization. Hydrogen production by alkaline water electrolysis is limited by anode durability under industrial conditions. Here, the authors demonstrate a cobalt–nickel layered double hydroxide anode that sustains operation for over 8,000 h at 1 A cm⁻² in 6 M NaOH at 80 °C, enabling durable hydrogen production.
papers.summary_ko: 알칼라인 수전해에서 기존 니켈·니켈-철 수산화물 대신 코발트-니켈 층상 이중수산화물(LDH) 양극 촉매가 산업 요구 조건을 넘어서는 안정성을 가짐을 보인 연구로, 전지 소재가 아닌 수전해 촉매 연구이다.

papers.abstract_en: Interfacial instability arising from Mn dissolution and acid generation from anion hydrolysis remains a primary failure mechanism for high-voltage, high-temperature lithium-rich manganese oxide (LRMO) cathodes. Herein, we report a molecularly...
papers.summary_ko: 고전압·고온 조건에서 리튬-리치 망간산화물(LRMO) 양극의 Mn 용출과 음이온 가수분해에 따른 산 생성이 계면 불안정성을 유발하는 주된 실패 원인임을 지적한다. 이를 해결하기 위해 분자 수준의 음이온-다이폴 설계와 방향성 다이폴 배위 전략을 제시한다.

papers.title: Anion Sublattice Engineering Induced Niobium-Tungsten Oxide with Near-Zero Residual Strain for Stable 100 C Cycling Capability
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Wadsley-Roth W3Nb14O44 is a fast-charging anode material but suffers from low electronic conductivity and electrochemical polarization. Here, anion-sublattice engineering is employed to regulate its electronic structure and Li+ storage kinetics. Density functional theory and kinetic analyses reveal that an appropriate concentration of oxygen vacancies enhances electronic conductivity, moderates Li+ adsorption, and facilitates Li+ diffusion, thereby reducing charge-transfer and diffusion impedances at low temperatures. In situ XRD and synchrotron radiation X-ray 3D nanocomputed tomography reveal reversible structural evolution with near-zero residual strain after cycling. Consequently, WNO-x delivers 77.4 mAh g–1 at 200 C and retains 72.6% capacity after 6000 cycles at 100 C while exhibiting low-temperature electrochemical activity. Moreover, the WNO-x||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 full cell delivers 85.8 mAh g–1 at 20 C and retains 77.1% capacity after 3000 cycles, with cycling capability at –30 °C. Such structure-property insight provides a strategy for designing niobium-based oxide anodes toward fast-charging and low-temperature batteries.
papers.summary_ko: Wadsley-Roth 구조의 W3Nb14O44 음극 소재에 음이온(산소 공공) 서브격자 엔지니어링을 적용하여 전자전도성과 Li+ 확산 속도를 개선한 연구이다. 이를 통해 거의 0에 가까운 잔류 변형으로 100C에서 6000사이클 후 72.6%의 용량을 유지하였으며, 200C에서 77.4 mAh/g의 용량을 보였다. NCM 양극과의 풀셀에서도 20C에서 85.8 mAh/g 용량과 -30°C 저온 구동성을 확인하였다.

papers.title: Visions for hydrogen-based materials for energy applications
papers.abstract_en: The world’s dependence on fossil fuels necessitates rapid advancement of clean storage and renewable energy technologies. There is abundance of renewable energy in the form of solar irradiance and wind, and the most commonly used energy carrier for these sources is electricity using batteries. Hydrogen is a viable energy carrier because of its diverse chemistry and capacity to form a wide range of bonds and interactions with most other elements. Hydrogen-based materials encompass a great variety of compositions, structures and properties, which modern synthesis methods can further tailor towards targeted applications. Of these, sodium tetrahydridoborate (NaBH 4 ) is a candidate for long-distance transport and seasonal hydrogen storage, releasing up to 137 kg H 2 /m 3 upon reaction with water. Metallic hydrides can be used for hydrogen storage (limited to gravimetric densities of approximately 2 wt% H 2 ), used in nickel-metal hydride batteries and are also applicable to piston-free hydrogen compression to 100 MPa and higher. Reactive hydride composites may provide enhanced storage capacities suitable for mobile applications, while physisorption in inexpensive porous materials enables hydrogen storage at cryogenic temperatures. Beyond hydrogen storage, boron-based hydrides have attracted recent interest owing to very high cationic conductivity at moderate temperatures. Divalent cationic conductors, such as Mg 2+ and Ca 2+ , show particular promise as electrolytes in novel solid-state batteries. In addition, new types of hydrides with unexpectedly high hydrogen content, denoted ‘super-hydrides’, have been identified as high-temperature superconductors. Collectively, hydrogen-containing materials offer the potential of new applications across areas of energy storage and transport, conversion, and superconductivity, underscoring the role of hydrogen not merely as an energy carrier but as a foundation for the next generation of viable, decarbonised energy infrastructure. Continued research may accelerate the global transition towards clean and renewable energy systems.
papers.summary_ko: 수소화물, 보로하이드라이드 등 수소 기반 소재의 에너지 저장·변환 응용을 폭넓게 조망하는 리뷰다. 수소 저장·운송과 일부 다가 양이온(Mg2+, Ca2+) 고체전해질로서의 가능성을 다루나, 본 사이트가 다루는 리튬/소듐 전지 전극 소재와는 직접적 관련이 적다.

papers.title: Switchable nucleophile-electrophile chemistry enables functional four-electron Li-I2 batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Four-electron iodine redox chemistry offers a high theoretical specific energy of ~1324 Wh kgI −1 , yet its practical realization is fundamentally limited by the conflicting demands of rapid I 0 /I + oxidation, effective suppression of iodine shuttling, and stabilization of highly reactive I + species. Here we report a redox-active, Lewis acid/base-tunable phthalimide that resolves these constraints through a single-molecule polarity-switching mechanism. Upon electrochemical oxidation, electrophilic phthalimide δ+ strongly interacts with nucleophilic iodine and polyiodide species, concurrently suppressing polyiodide shuttling and promoting their conversion to I + . The consecutively generated phthalimide δ− acts as a nucleophilic stabilizer for the resulting I + species. This electrochemically driven polarity switching of phthalimide enables flexible four-electron Li-I 2 pouch cells that deliver ~400 mAh gI −1 capacity, a specific energy exceeding 1200 Wh kgI −1 , a high cathode-level specific energy ( ~ 883.4 Wh kg(cathode) −1 ), and stable cycling over 1000 cycles. The successful integration of these cells into wearable wireless charging and motion-sensing systems demonstrates the potential of polarity-switchable iodine chemistry for next-generation flexible energy-storage devices.
papers.summary_ko: 4전자 요오드 redox 화학을 이용한 Li-I2 전지에서, 산화 시 친전자성으로 환원 시 친핵성으로 전환되는 극성 스위칭 프탈이미드 분자를 도입해 폴리아이오다이드 셔틀링을 억제하고 반응성이 높은 I+ 종을 안정화한다. 이를 통해 높은 비에너지와 1000회 이상의 안정적 사이클 수명을 갖는 플렉시블 파우치셀을 구현했다.

papers.title: Non-halogen aqueous electrolytes for four-electron iodine conversion
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Accessing reversible four-electron iodine redox chemistry in aqueous metal–iodine batteries offers a promising route towards high-energy aqueous energy storage, but has conventionally relied on highly concentrated, corrosive halogen-containing electrolytes to stabilize reactive hypervalent iodine cations through interhalogen complexation 1–9 . Here we show a kosmotropic anion–polar anion–nucleophilic species (Nuc) electrolyte framework that harnesses anionic chemistry to coordinate the interfacial microenvironment and molecular interactions, enabling reversible four-electron iodine conversion in halogen-free aqueous electrolytes. Polar anions establish a water-deficient, anion-enriched interfacial microenvironment, whereas kosmotropic anions regulate water–Nuc interactions to increase the availability of Nuc for stabilizing hypervalent iodine cations through Nuc–I + –Nuc halogen bonds. This electrolyte framework is validated across diverse Nuc and in both aqueous Zn–I 2 and Al–I 2 batteries. Moving beyond conventional interhalogen stabilization, these findings establish a distinct electrolyte chemistry framework and represent a mechanistic shift for reversible multi-electron iodine chemistry in aqueous environments.
papers.summary_ko: 할로겐 함유 전해질 없이도 수계 Zn-I2, Al-I2 전지에서 가역적인 4전자 요오드 전환을 구현하는 코스모트로픽 음이온-극성 음이온-친핵종 기반 전해질 프레임워크를 제시한다. 리튬이나 소듐이 아닌 아연/알루미늄 기반 수계 할로겐 전지에 관한 연구다.

papers.title: Nitrogen Harmonized Fluoride Solid‐State Electrolytes With Modulus‐Mismatch‐Induced Interfacial Defects for Fast Li + Transport
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Fluoride‐based solid electrolytes possess excellent air stability, strong oxidation stability and wide electrochemical windows, however their application potential is hindered by intrinsic poor ionic conductivity. Herein, a fused‐salt‐etched nitrogen‐modulated fluoride electrolyte (LAFN) is designed to improve conductivity performance via synergistic interfacial construction and lattice coordination regulation. The chloride softened grain boundaries and constructed K(Na)Cl/LAFN heterostructures optimize solid‐solid contact, while the Young modulus mismatch between K(Na)Cl and LAFN domains generates massive lattice distortion and defect regions, which can percolate to form continuous pathways for rapid Li + diffusion. Nitrogen doping mediates the generation of self‐limiting stable Li 3 N‐LiF composite layer on Li metal, effectively inhibiting the anode side reactions. It also enables the weakening of rigid Li‐F ionic bonding with the enrichment of lithium vacancies, and the moderate Li‐N coordination balances the activation of Li + migration and structural stability. As a result, the room‐temperature ionic conductivity of LAFN is elevated to 2.04 × 10 −4 S cm −1 , delivering outstanding rate capability and long‐cycle stability in both symmetric and full cells. The LiFePO 4 ‐based solid‐state full cells retain the 81.9% capacity retention after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. When paired with conversion‐type FeF 3 , the cells deliver a high reversible capacity of 233.24 mAh g −1 after 100 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: 질소 도핑과 염 융융 에칭으로 불화물 고체전해질(LAFN)의 이온전도도와 계면 특성을 개선한 연구다. K(Na)Cl/LAFN 이종계면과 격자 변형을 통해 Li+ 전도 경로를 형성하고, Li3N-LiF 보호층으로 리튬 음극 부반응을 억제해 LiFePO4 및 FeF3 전고체 셀에서 향상된 가역용량과 사이클 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Layer Stacking Structure Governed Transition‐Metal Interlayer Migration for Reversible High‐Voltage Oxygen Redox Plateau
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Utilization of lattice oxygen redox electrochemistry is the holy grail for achieving high‐capacity layered cathodes. However, prior to this, the large voltage hysteresis must be overcome. In this work, we uncover a novel scientific nature of layered stacking structure‐governed interlayer transition‑metal migration that substantially modulates the reversibility of the high‐voltage oxygen plateau. It is discovered that a kind of ribbon superlattice can facilitate the reversible high‐voltage oxygen redox plateau in the P3‐Na 0.6 Li 0.2 Mn 0.6 Ti 0.2 O 2 with the oxygen stacking series of “ABBCCA…”, but plays no role in the P2‐Na 0.6 Li 0.2 Mn 0.6 Ti 0.2 O 2 counterpart with the oxygen stacking series of “ABBA…”. Combined with the experiments and theoretical calculations, it is unraveled that the P3 stacking framework can suppress O‐type stacking faults and in turn elevates steric hindrance to the transition metal migration and the formation of molecular oxygen, thus enabling reversible high‐voltage oxygen redox. In contrast, the P2 phase can transform into O2 phase at de‐sodiated state, which accelerates severe interlayer transition metal migration, and triggers in‐plane structural reconstruction and molecular oxygen, leading to loss of high‐voltage plateau. This finding reveals how the layer stacking structure modulates the reversible oxygen redox plateau.
papers.summary_ko: P2형과 P3형 Na0.6Li0.2Mn0.6Ti0.2O2 소듐 층상 산화물에서 산소 적층 구조가 고전압 산소 redox 플래토의 가역성을 좌우함을 규명했다. P3 구조는 산소형 적층 결함을 억제해 전이금속의 층간 이동을 막아 가역적 산소 redox를 가능케 하지만, P2 구조는 탈소듐화 시 O2상으로 전환되며 전이금속 이동과 구조 재배열이 심화되어 고전압 플래토를 상실한다.

papers.title: Interfacial engineering accelerates desolvation kinetics for high-performance alkaline zinc–iron flow batteries
