papers.title: Building‐Block Design of Nonflammable Quasi‐Solid Electrolytes for Ampere‐Hour‐Scale Sodium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs) are emerging as a competitive technology for large‐scale energy storage; however, their commercial viability remains severely hindered by the inherent flammability and high volatility of liquid electrolytes (LEs). Herein, we propose a modular assembly strategy inspired by the building‐block principle to architect a quasi‐solid electrolyte (QSE). By synergistically integrating vinylene carbonate (VC) and 2,2,3,4,4,4‐hexafluorobutyl acrylate (HFBA) monomers, we modulate the electron density distribution within the polymer matrix. The resulting PVH QSE lowers the Na + desolvation barrier and provides continuous ion migration pathways, thereby achieving exceptional ionic conductivity of 5.60 mS cm −1 and a sodium‐ion transference number of 0.58. Furthermore, the spatially locked polymer architecture drives the formation of ion‐solvent aggregates and a robust NaF‐rich solid electrolyte interphase, synergistically suppressing solvent decomposition and eradicating sodium dendrite growth. Consequently, the Na||Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 cells exhibit an outstanding capacity retention of 94.9% after 3000 cycles alongside superior temperature adaptability. To demonstrate practical feasibility, the hard carbon||NaNi 0.33 Fe 0.33 Mn 0.33 O 2 pouch cells maintain stable cycling over 200 cycles. Crucially, nail penetration and accelerating rate calorimetry (ARC) tests verify the exceptional safety of the pouch cells. By linking molecular microenvironment regulation to macroscopic battery safety, this work illuminates a viable pathway toward the commercialization of intrinsically safe SIBs.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐이온전지용 난연성 준고체 전해질(QSE)을 비닐렌카보네이트와 불소화 아크릴레이트 단량체의 빌딩블록 조립 전략으로 설계했다. 이 QSE는 Na+ 탈솔베이션 장벽을 낮추고 NaF 풍부 SEI를 형성해 소듐 덴드라이트 성장을 억제하며, 5.60 mS/cm의 이온전도도와 0.58의 Na+ 이동수를 나타냈다. Na||Na3V2(PO4)3 셀은 3000회 사이클 후 94.9%의 용량 유지율을 보였고, 못뚫기 및 ARC 시험으로 파우치셀의 안전성이 입증되었다.

papers.title: Breaking Quasi‐Chelation in Thioether Electrolytes for Synergistic Interfacial Stabilization in Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium‐sulfur batteries (LSBs) have attracted extensive attention owing to their high energy density. However, their development remains severely hindered by sluggish interfacial reaction kinetics, unstable electrode–electrolyte interphases, lithium dendrite growth, and polysulfide shuttling. In this work, we identify a hidden quasi‐chelation effect in ether‐based nitrile solvents, which undermines the effectiveness of weakly solvating electrolyte design, and demonstrate that this limitation can be effectively overcome through a thioether‐substitution strategy. Specifically, replacing the ether oxygen in methoxyacetonitrile with sulfur to form (methylthio)acetonitrile disrupts the quasi‐chelating coordination motif and weakens solvent‐Li + interactions, and induces anion‐rich solvation structures. Spectroscopic characterizations combined with molecular dynamics simulations reveal that breaking this quasi‐chelation effect lowers the Li + desolvation barrier and accelerates ion‐transport kinetics. Meanwhile, the preferential decomposition of the thioether solvent promotes the formation of sulfur‐rich, inorganic‐dominated interphases, thereby enabling simultaneous stabilization of both the lithium metal anode and the SPAN cathode. As a result, lithium dendrite growth and polysulfide shuttling are effectively suppressed, and Li||SPAN full cells retain 86% of their initial capacity after 600 cycles under high‐loading conditions. This work demonstrates that quasi‐chelation breaking can serve as an effective molecular design principle for constructing weakly solvating electrolytes toward practical lithium‐sulfur batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황전지 전해질에서 에테르계 나이트릴 용매가 보이는 숨겨진 유사 킬레이션 효과를 규명하고, 황으로 치환한 티오에테르 용매((메틸티오)아세토니트릴)로 이를 해소하는 전략을 제시했다. 이 치환은 Li+ 탈솔베이션 장벽을 낮추고 황 풍부 무기질 계면을 형성해 리튬 금속 음극과 SPAN 양극을 동시에 안정화했다. 그 결과 Li||SPAN 완전셀은 고로딩 조건에서 600회 사이클 후 86%의 용량을 유지하며 덴드라이트 성장과 폴리설파이드 셔틀을 효과적으로 억제했다.

papers.title: A Sustainable Fully Fluorine‐Free Interfacial Chemistry for Reversible Anode‐Free Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anode‐free lithium metal batteries promise high energy density. However, fluorinated electrolytes raise sustainability concerns. Herein, we develop a fully fluorine‐free interfacial strategy by coupling a cross‐linked vinylene carbonate‐N,N′‐methylenebisacrylamide artificial solid electrolyte interphase (ASEI) on Cu current collectors with a fluorine‐free electrolyte to regulate both lithium deposition and subsequent SEI formation. This combination offers an alternative to interfacial stabilization using fluorinated SEI‐forming components or alloy‐forming interlayers. The ASEI possesses strong Li‐ASEI interactions and enhanced lithiophilicity, thereby enabling homogeneous and compact Li deposition with reduced growth overpotential. Furthermore, the ASEI induces the formation of a conformal, mechanically robust, inorganic‐rich SEI containing Li 2 O and Li 3 N, leading to improved interfacial stability and the reversibility of Li plating/stripping. Consequently, the ASEI‐modified current collector delivers markedly improved full‐cell performance. The prelithiated LFP||ASEI‐Cu full cell achieves stable cycling over 350 cycles with a capacity retention of 84.5% at 25°C, while the prelithiated NCM811||ASEI‐Cu full cell delivers a reversible capacity of 146.8 mAh g −1 after 100 cycles with a capacity retention of 86.6% at 25°C. This work demonstrates the potential of fluorine‐free interfacial engineering for anode‐free lithium metal batteries, while further improvements in lithium‐inventory retention and high‐current‐density operation remain necessary for practical implementation.
papers.summary_ko: 무불소 전해질과 가교형 비닐렌카보네이트-메틸렌비스아크릴아마이드 기반 인공 SEI(ASEI)를 구리 집전체에 결합하여 완전 무불소 계면화학으로 음극-프리 리튬 금속 전지를 구현했다. ASEI는 리튬친화성이 높아 균일하고 조밀한 리튬 증착을 유도하며 Li2O와 Li3N이 풍부한 무기질 SEI를 형성해 가역성을 향상시켰다. 프리리튬화 LFP||ASEI-Cu 셀은 350회 사이클에서 84.5%, NCM811||ASEI-Cu 셀은 100회 사이클에서 86.6%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: A Multi‐Topologically Superposed Mechanically Interlocked Polymer
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Mechanically interlocked structures (MIS) provide a powerful platform for creating advanced materials with unprecedented topological architectures. Nevertheless, current related studies have predominantly focused on the construction of MIS with single topological motifs, and the integration of multiple topologies into a single MIS remains a grand challenge. Herein, we harness ligand conformational constraints to regulate the flexible coordination behavior of alkali metal ions, enabling the construction of a multi‐topologically superposed mechanically interlocked polymer ( MIP ) featuring the unprecedented incorporation of four distinct topological motifs. This incorporation imparts MIP with exceptional mechanical strength and efficient Na + transport capability. As an artificial solid electrolyte interphase (ASEI) for sodium metal batteries, MIP delivers remarkable ultralong cycling stability, maintaining 87.8% capacity retention after 10 000 cycles at 20 C. This work breaks the boundaries of conventional MIS by enabling the creation of multi‐topologically superposed MIS, thereby unveiling new topological landscapes and opening unexplored opportunities for advanced functions.
papers.summary_ko: 기계적으로 맞물린 구조(MIS)는 독특한 위상구조를 갖는 소재 플랫폼이지만 기존 연구는 단일 위상 모티프에 국한되어 있었다. 본 연구는 리간드의 형태적 제약을 이용해 알칼리 금속 이온의 유연한 배위 거동을 조절함으로써 네 가지 서로 다른 위상 모티프를 하나의 사슬에 결합한 다중위상 중첩형 기계적 맞물림 고분자(MIP)를 구현했다. 이 고분자는 우수한 기계적 강도와 효율적인 Na+ 전달 능력을 가져, 소듐 금속 배터리용 인공 고체전해질계면(ASEI)으로 적용 시 20C에서 10,000회 순환 후에도 87.8%의 용량 유지율을 보이는 초장수명 안정성을 달성했다.

papers.title: Weak‑Solvation‑Mediated Localized High‑Concentration Electrolyte for Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sodium metal batteries offer high energy density and material sustainability, yet their practical viability is severely compromised by the intrinsic instability of sodium metal anodes. Herein, we report a localized high‑concentration structure formed in a moderate‑solvating electrolyte by introducing methyl tert‑butyl ether (MTBE) as a fluorine‑free, weakly coordinating diluent in tetrahydrofuran (THF)/NaFSI electrolyte. MTBE displaces free THF molecules, promotes FSI − incorporation into the inner solvation sheath, and transforms the solvation structure from solvent‑separated ion pairs to contact ion pairs and aggregates. This diluent‑participated solvation, with its weak interaction with Na + , accelerates desolvation kinetics and forms a robust, anion‑derived inorganic‑rich interphase that suppresses parasitic reactions, dendrites, and corrosion. The optimal electrolyte enables Na||Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 cells to deliver 74.3 mAh g −1 at 5.0 A g −1 and remarkable cycling stability with a high‐loading cathode (12 mg cm −2 ) over 600 cycles. A pouch cell sustains 300 cycles with a capacity of 92.4 mAh g −1 at 0.1 A g −1 . This work demonstrates a sustainable, polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)‑free electrolyte design based on weak solvation engineering, offering a practical route toward stable and fast‑charging sodium metal batteries with enhanced cathode compatibility.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐 금속전지의 THF/NaFSI 전해질에 불소가 없는 약배위성 희석제인 MTBE를 첨가해 국소 고농도 구조를 형성하는 전략을 제시했다. MTBE는 자유 THF를 밀어내고 FSI−를 내부 솔베이션에 더 많이 참여시켜 탈솔베이션을 가속화하고 음이온 유래의 무기질 계면을 형성해 부반응, 덴드라이트, 부식을 억제했다. 이 전해질은 Na||Na4Fe3(PO4)2P2O7 셀에서 5.0 A/g에서 74.3 mAh/g을 전달하고 고로딩 양극으로 600회 사이클 안정성을 보였으며, 파우치셀은 300회 사이클에서 92.4 mAh/g을 유지했다.

papers.title: Tailoring Covalent Organic Frameworks as Functionalized Molecular Traps to Enable Sulfur Conversion and Li + Desolvation for Durable Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Suppressing polysulfid shuttling and enhancing Li + desolvation kinetics are crucial for high‐performance lithium–sulfur (Li─S) batteries. Herein, we propose an elaborate molecular trap design strategy based on functional‐group decoupling and synergistic enhancement in covalent organic frameworks (COFs) to resolve the aforementioned issues. A cyano‐containing COF (CN‐COF) and its amidoxime derivative (COF‐AO) serve as cooperative dual‐sided separator coatings. CN‐COF contributes a well‐ordered porous structure for confining sulfur species; its C≡N sites interact with polysulfides to reduce the reaction energy barrier of sulfur conversion. On the anode side, ─NH 2 /─OH groups in COF‐AO promote Li + desolvation and modulate Li + transport by capturing solvent molecules via hydrogen bonding, which suppresses parasitic reactions and ensures rapid Li + migration. Besides, the regular topological structure and size‐exclusion effect of COF restrict migration of large‐sized solvent molecules and polysulfides, enabling homogeneous Li + flux and smooth Li deposition. Benefiting from these advantages, Li||Li symmetrical cells achieve stable cycling for 7000 h at 5 mA cm −2 /5 mAh cm −2 . The Li─S battery delivers an initial capacity of 820 mAh g −1 with an ultralow decay rate of 0.024% per cycle over 900 cycles at 5 C.The pouch cell exhibits a high initial capacity of 1020 mAh g −1 at 0.2 C and stable operation for 150 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황 전지에서 폴리설파이드 셔틀 억제와 Li+ 탈솔베이션을 동시에 달성하기 위해 작용기를 분리 설계한 공유결합유기골격체(COF) 분자 트랩을 제안했다. 시아노기를 가진 CN-COF는 양극 측에서 황종을 가두고 전환 반응의 에너지 장벽을 낮추며, 아미독심 유도체 COF-AO는 음극 측에서 수소결합으로 용매 분자를 포획해 Li+ 탈솔베이션과 균일한 Li 증착을 돕는다. Li||Li 대칭셀은 5 mA cm-2/5 mAh cm-2에서 7000시간 안정 사이클을, 전지는 5C/900사이클에서 0.024%/사이클의 낮은 감쇠율을 보였다.

papers.title: Molecule-to-System Design Rules for Neutral TEMPO/Viologen Aqueous Organic Redox Flow Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Neutral-pH aqueous organic redox flow batteries (AORFBs) based on TEMPO catholytes and viologen anolytes have emerged as one of the most intensively developed molecular pairings for safe, scalable, long-duration energy...
papers.summary_ko: 중성 pH 수계 유기 레독스-플로우 전지에서 TEMPO 캐솔라이트와 비올로겐 아놀라이트 쌍에 대한 분자 단위에서 시스템 단위까지의 설계 규칙을 제시한 연구로 추정된다. (제목 기반 추정)

papers.title: In Situ Constructed Fluorosulfided Interface With Metallic Mo Sites for Robust Anode‐Free Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anode‑free sodium metal batteries (AFSMBs) are acclaimed for their low‑cost, sustainability, and high energy density. However, achieving highly reversible Na plating/stripping on bare current collectors (CCs) and robust solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) is challenging. Herein, we present a robust fluorosulfided SEI (FS‐SEI) layer with metallic Mo active sites through in situ electrochemical transformation of 2D MoS 2 coating on the Cu CCs. Specifically, the ingenious 2D MoS 2 holds short ion transport pathways and large contact active areas during battery operation. Furthermore, MoS 2 can in situ convert into metallic Mo and Na 2 S, while catalyzing the dissolution of NaPF 6 to generate NaF. The in situ formed FS‐SEI film possesses excellent sodiophilicity, high Na + diffusion, and good electron‐blocking capability, which effectively guides a homogeneous distribution of Na + flux, accelerates the electrochemical reaction kinetics, and blocks side reactions between electrolyte and electrodes. Benefiting from these advantages, the MoS 2 @Cu half cells achieve average Coulombic efficiency of 99.85% over 350 cycles at 10 mA cm −2 and 10 mAh cm −2 . When paired with Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 cathodes, the AFSMBs exhibit excellent rate capability and cycling stability (>97.0% retention). This work offers insights into engineering a stable in situ SEI via 2D sodiophilic architectures, paving the way for developing energy‐dense and durable AFSMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극 소듐 금속 전지(AFSMB)의 집전체 위에 2D MoS2 코팅을 전기화학적으로 변환시켜 금속 Mo 활성점을 가진 플루오로설파이드계(FS-SEI) 인공 SEI를 구현했다. 이 계면은 소듐친화성과 Na+ 확산성이 높고 전자 차단 특성을 가져 균일한 Na 플럭스 분포와 부반응 억제를 유도한다. MoS2@Cu 반전지는 350회 사이클에서 평균 쿨롱효율 99.85%를 달성했고, Na3V2(PO4)3 양극과 조합한 완전지는 97% 이상의 용량 유지율과 우수한 율속 특성을 보였다.

papers.title: Direct Evidence of Intermediate Oxygen Species Evolution in Cathode Oxides With Nominally Stable Superstructure
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anionic redox has fundamentally transformed the traditional approach to developing advanced cathode materials for secondary batteries. Nevertheless, how oxygen anions participate in the redox reaction and evolve during the dynamic intercalation process remains a topic of intense controversy, particularly in prototypical materials featuring a stable superstructure. Herein, we showcase that the oxidized oxygen species at the top of charge of ribbon‐ordered P2‐Na 0.6 Li 0.2 Mn 0.8 O 2 continuously evolve during electrochemical cycling—shifting from a mixture of electron holes on O 2− and dimerized (O 2 ) n− to a mixture of (O 2 ) n− and molecular O 2 . The intermediate oxygen species increasingly stabilize as molecular O 2 instead of (O 2 ) n− , a process coupled with the expansion of Li‐vacancy clusters and the growth of Mn‐enriched domains. We further demonstrate the same trend in the P3 analogue, which features a more stable ribbon superstructure with a topological “− α − γ −” stacking pattern (“− α − β −” for P2‐Na 0.6 Li 0.2 Mn 0.8 O 2 ), further corroborating that molecular O 2 formation is inescapable even when Mn migration is restricted in the pristine structure. Collectively, our results provide direct evidence that electron holes on O 2− are unstable upon cycling and identify molecular O 2 as the ultimate oxygen‐redox product for cathode oxides with nominally stable superstructure.
papers.summary_ko: P2형 Na0.6Li0.2Mn0.8O2 층상 산화물에서 충전 말기에 생성되는 산화 산소종이 사이클이 진행됨에 따라 O2−의 전자 홀과 이량체화된 (O2)n−의 혼합물에서 (O2)n−와 분자 O2의 혼합물로 연속적으로 변화함을 직접 규명했다. 이 과정은 Li-공공 클러스터의 확장과 Mn 풍부 영역의 성장과 동반되며, 더 안정한 리본 초구조를 갖는 P3 유사체에서도 동일한 경향이 관찰되어 안정적 초구조를 가진 양극 산화물에서도 분자 O2 형성이 음이온 레독스의 궁극적 산물임을 보였다.

papers.title: Autoantibodies associate with clinical outcome in patients with melanoma treated with a dendritic cell-based vaccine
papers.abstract_en: Increased B cell receptor signaling pathways in patients with melanoma correlates with a favorable clinical response to a cancer vaccine expressing multiple tumor-associated antigens. Here, we utilize phage immunoprecipitation sequencing (PhIP-seq) and Rapid Extracellular Antigen Profiling (REAP) assays to analyze the autoantibody profiles of patients with melanoma from a dendritic cell vaccine trial (NCT01622933), before and after vaccination. Patients have significantly elevated breadth and titer of autoantibodies compared to healthy donors. Vaccination results in the induction of de novo autoantibodies, particularly those with a favorable clinical outcome. Reduced serum SDF1-alpha, MIP-1ß, MCP1 and increased circulating monocytes are associated with development of autoantibodies. We identify plasma autoantibody signatures separating melanoma from healthy subjects as well as clinical responders vs non-responders to vaccination treatment. These findings demonstrate the potential for autoantibodies as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers that predict clinical outcomes in cancer. NCT01622933 was a clinical trial of an autologous dendritic cell-based vaccine in patients with melanoma. Here the authors show that the vaccine results in the induction of de novo autoantibodies associated with a favourable clinical outcome.
papers.summary_ko: 흑색종 환자 대상 수지상세포 기반 백신 임상시험(NCT01622933)에서 PhIP-seq와 REAP 분석을 통해 자가항체 프로파일을 분석했다. 백신 접종 후 새로운 자가항체가 유도되었으며, 특히 임상 반응이 양호한 환자에서 그 폭과 수치가 더 높았다. 혈청 SDF1-alpha, MIP-1β, MCP1 감소와 순환 단핵구 증가가 자가항체 발생과 연관되었고, 이 자가항체 시그니처는 임상 반응을 예측하는 바이오마커로 활용될 수 있음을 제시했다.

papers.title: Universally adaptable design of quasi-solid mineral electrolytes for aqueous and non-aqueous batteries
papers.abstract_en: The rigid-flexible Zn-Spd-PHFP quasi-solid electrolyte regulates plating via Lewis acid–base coordination. Its lean-water microenvironment inhibits polyiodide shuttle and side reactions, delivering stable cycling for Zn-based batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 아연 기반 수계 및 비수계 전지에 범용적으로 적용 가능한 준고체 미네랄 전해질을 설계한 연구이다. 루이스 산-염기 배위를 통해 도금을 조절하고 저수분 미세환경으로 폴리아이오다이드 셔틀과 부반응을 억제해 안정적인 아연 전지 사이클링을 구현했다.

papers.title: Ultra‐Long Helical CNFs 3D‐Networks as High‐Conductivity Current Collectors for Efficient Sodium Deposition
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Aluminum (Al) current collectors are crucial for sodium metal batteries (SMBs), yet sodium (Na) dendrite suppression and uniform Na deposition remain challenges. Surface modification could significantly optimize Na deposition behavior. Herein, a 20 nm copper (Cu) layer is designed to confine NiY diatomic catalyst (DAC) for Al surface modification via magnetron sputtering and heat treatment. The adjacent NiY atoms, with low single‐point energy (–228.05 eV), minimum segregation energy (−0.67 eV), and maximum aggregation energy (5.84 eV), synergistically stabilize diatomic dispersion in the Cu nanolayer. Benefiting from the tailored acetylene adsorption energy (−1.16 eV) and favorable formation energies of C 2 H (−13.58 eV) and C 2 (−11.44 eV), NiY–DAC exhibits excellent catalytic activity, in‐situ growth ultra‐long helical CNFs 3D‐networks with a thickness of 46.3 µm on Al current collectors, enabling efficient Na storage and remarkable inhibition Na dendrite formation. The modified current collector delivers outstanding electrochemical performance. The coulombic efficiency is up to 99.49% over 3000 h of half‐cells at 1.0 mA cm −2 /1.0 mAh cm −2 with a low overpotential (3.1 mV), and the CNFs‐Na||Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 full‐cells achieve stable cycling over 1500 cycles at 10.0 C. This diatomic catalyst confinement strategy provides new insight into designing high‐performance carbon‐modified current collectors.
papers.summary_ko: 구리층에 고정된 NiY 이원자 촉매를 이용해 알루미늄 집전체 표면에 초장축 나선형 탄소나노섬유 3D 네트워크를 성장시켜 나트륨 금속전지의 집전체를 개선했다. 이 구조는 균일한 나트륨 증착을 유도하고 덴드라이트 형성을 억제하여, 1.0 mA cm⁻²/1.0 mAh cm⁻²에서 3000시간 동안 99.49%의 쿨롱 효율을 달성했다. Na3V2(PO4)3 완전셀에서도 10C로 1500회 이상 안정적으로 구동되었다.

papers.title: Stabilizing Oxygen Redox via Li Dopants Into P2‐Type Cathodes for High‐Voltage Sodium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anionic redox offers a pathway to increase the energy density of layered cathodes for sodium‐ion batteries, yet it is often accompanied by structure and interface degradation. Here, we demonstrate that Li dopants as regulators for oxygen redox in P2‐Na 0.67 Ni 0.33 Mn 0.67 O 2 through tuning local coordination environments and charge compensation pathways. Li dopants enhance Ni redox activity while moderating transition metal‐oxygen (TM‐O) coupling at high voltages. The online electrochemical mass spectrometry with 18 O isotope labeling reveals that it suppresses the lattice oxygen participation in electrolyte decomposition and mitigates irreversible oxygen loss. As a result, the Li‐doped Na 0.67 Li 0.2 Ni 0.23 Mn 0.67 O 2 exhibits improved rate capability cycling stability, delivering an initial capacity of 116.6 mAh/g with 80% retention after 400 cycles at 1 C, compared to 27% for the undoped counterpart. This work highlights the importance of controlling reactive oxygen species and establishes a strategy to stabilize high‐voltage operation by decoupling oxygen redox from degradation pathways in sodium‐ion cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: P2형 Na0.67Ni0.33Mn0.67O2 소듐이온전지 양극에서 Li 도핑을 통해 국부 배위 환경과 전하 보상 경로를 조절하여 산소 레독스를 안정화했다. 18O 동위원소 표지 operando 전기화학 질량분석으로 Li 도핑이 격자 산소의 전해질 분해 참여를 억제하고 비가역적 산소 손실을 완화함을 확인했으며, Ni 레독스 활성을 높이고 고전압에서 전이금속-산소 결합을 완화시킨다. Li 도핑 양극(Na0.67Li0.2Ni0.23Mn0.67O2)은 초기 용량 116.6 mAh/g에 1C/400사이클 후 80%의 용량 유지율을 보여, 무도핑 대비(27%) 크게 향상되었다.

papers.title: Post‐Synthetic Cerium Modification of Commercial NCM811 for Concurrent Cycling and Safety Upgrading
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The widespread use of Ni‐rich LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) cathodes in high‐energy batteries remains limited by structural degradation, side reactions, and oxygen release, yet most modification strategies prove incompatible with commercial materials. This work presents a facile solid‐state method that achieves synergistic cerium ion (Ce 3+ ) doping and CeO 2 coating on commercial NCM811 by mixing with CeO 2 nanoparticles followed by calcination. Structural and morphological analyses confirm Ce incorporation into the near‐surface lattice and the formation of a nanoscale CeO 2 layer without disturbing the layered framework. Electrochemical tests demonstrate that the optimal 1 wt.% Ce‐modified sample exhibits superior rate capability and long‐term stability, retaining 82.04% of its initial capacity after 500 cycles at 1 C, compared to 74.10% for pristine, owing to suppressed cation mixing, enhanced structural stability, and improved Li + diffusion kinetics. Crucially, differential electrochemical mass spectrometry shows Ce modification curtails O 2 release and reduces H 2 and CO 2 generation across various rates, effectively mitigating gas evolution associated with safety degradation. Accelerating rate calorimetry further confirms delayed thermal runaway and improved adiabatic stability. Overall, this work establishes a scalable post‐treatment route to simultaneously boost the electrochemical performance and safety of commercial nickel‐rich cathodes, offering a practical solution for next‐generation lithium‐ion batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 상용 NCM811 양극재에 세륨(Ce3+) 도핑과 CeO2 코팅을 동시에 적용하는 고상 합성법을 제시했다. Ce 개질을 통해 양이온 혼합을 억제하고 구조 안정성과 Li+ 확산 속도를 개선하여 500회 사이클 후 용량 유지율을 74.10%에서 82.04%로 향상시켰다. 또한 산소 및 가스 발생을 줄이고 열폭주를 지연시켜 안전성도 함께 개선했다.

papers.title: A degradation-state-oriented device–material–element framework for high-value recycling of retired lithium-ion battery layered oxide cathodes
papers.abstract_en: A degradation-state-oriented framework matches retired cathodes with device restoration, material regeneration or element extraction, using life-cycle and techno-economic assessments to guide high-value, low-carbon recycling.
papers.summary_ko: 폐리튬이온전지 층상 산화물 양극을 퇴화 상태에 따라 소자 복원, 소재 재생, 원소 추출로 매칭하는 프레임워크를 제안한 재활용 연구이다. 수명주기 및 기술경제성 평가를 통해 고부가가치 저탄소 재활용 경로를 제시한다.

papers.title: Zwitterionic Thermoplastic Polyurethane‐Based Quasi‐Solid Polymer Electrolytes for Lithium Metal Batteries With Machine‐Learning‐Assisted Mechanistic Insights
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This study presents a quasi‐solid‐state electrolyte based on zwitterionic thermoplastic polyurethane (QS‐Z‐TPU) for lithium metal batteries. Unlike conventional quasi‐solid polymer electrolytes that mainly serve as passive liquid‐electrolyte reservoirs, QS‐Z‐TPU is designed as an active ion‐regulating matrix via phosphorylcholine‐derived zwitterionic groups in the TPU framework. The resulting electrolyte combines the elasticity and film‐forming capability of TPU with dual‐site ion regulation, where phosphate sites coordinate Li + while quaternary ammonium and urethane N‐H groups immobilize TFSI − anions. This design enhances electrolyte affinity while suppressing destructive swelling due to ionic crosslinking. QS‐Z‐TPU exhibits high ionic conductivity, a wide electrochemical stability window, and an enhanced Li + transference number. Machine‐learning‐assisted molecular modeling further reveals that the zwitterionic oligomer stabilizes separated LiTFSI configurations through cooperative Li + coordination and TFSI − association, substantially reducing the energetic penalty for ion‐pair separation. This regulated ion environment promotes uniform Li + flux at the lithium metal interface and facilitates the formation of a stable inorganic‐rich solid electrolyte interphase. Consequently, QS‐Z‐TPU enables stable Li plating/stripping and improves the cycling stability and rate capability of LFP|Li full cells, further validated in flexible pouch‐cell demonstrations. These findings highlight zwitterionic molecular engineering as an effective strategy for interface‐stabilizing quasi‐solid electrolytes.
papers.summary_ko: 쯧위터이온성 열가소성 폴리우레탄(QS-Z-TPU) 기반의 준고체 전해질을 리튬 금속전지용으로 개발했다. 포스포릴콜린 유래의 쯧위터이온 그룹이 Li+와 TFSI-를 동시에 조절하는 이중 사이트 역할을 하여 높은 이온전도도와 Li+ 이동수를 제공하고, 머신러닝 기반 분자모델링으로 이온쌍 분리 메커니즘을 규명했다. 이를 통해 균일한 Li 증착과 무기물이 풍부한 SEI 형성을 유도하여 LFP|Li 완전셀 및 flexible pouch cell에서 안정적인 사이클 성능을 확인했다.

papers.title: Techno-economic and environmental assessment of next-generation battery-powered farming robots
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Decarbonizing agriculture without compromising productivity is a major challenge under rising input costs and labor scarcity. Autonomous battery-powered agricultural robots (ABARs) could help by reducing dependence on conventional machinery and enabling more precise application of inputs, but their system-level economic and environmental performance remains unclear. Here, we integrate total cost of ownership and life cycle assessment to evaluate a small ABAR for cradle-to-farm-gate crop production of strawberries, onions, lettuce, and peanuts under organic and non-organic management. Across modeled scenarios, benchmarked costs range from 76% below to 17% above literature-based reference ranges, while greenhouse-gas emissions fall within or below reported ranges. Variable inputs dominate both outcomes, contributing 72–90% of costs and 72–95% of global-warming impacts, with seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation water as main drivers. These results suggest that ABAR value depends less on the platform than on the ability of autonomous operation to reduce input use and labor demand.
papers.summary_ko: 배터리 구동 농업 로봇(ABAR)의 전과정평가(LCA)와 총소유비용(TCO)을 통합 분석하여 딸기, 양파, 양상추, 땅콩 재배에서의 경제성과 환경성을 평가했다. 비용과 온실가스 배출 모두 비료, 종자, 관개수 등 가변 투입재가 72~95%를 차지하는 주요 요인으로 나타났다. 자율주행 로봇의 가치는 플랫폼 자체보다 투입재와 노동력 절감 능력에 더 좌우된다는 결론을 제시했다.

papers.title: Stable anode-free sodium batteries enabled by controlled oligomerization
papers.summary_ko: 제어된 올리고머화를 통해 안정적인 무음극(anode-free) 소듐 배터리를 구현하는 연구로 추정된다. (제목 기반 추정)

papers.title: Solvent Toughened Glass Gel Electrolyte for High‐Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT In situ polymerization electrolytes hold great promise for high‐energy‐density lithium‐metal batteries but often require additional separators due to their limited mechanical strength. Here, inspired by “glassy gels”, we developed a free‐standing glass gel electrolyte by introducing tributylmethylphosphonium dimethyl phosphate ([P 4441 ] [DMP]) into a poly(acrylic acid) (PAA) matrix. Strong non‐covalent interactions between [P 4441 ] [DMP] and PAA chains generate a tough and homogeneous network while enabling efficient ion transport. The resulting glass gel electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 2.2 mS cm −1 , a Li + transference number of 0.59, a tensile strength of 30 MPa, and an elongation of up to 700%. The solvent‐toughened scaffold effectively confines the liquid electrolyte and mitigates parasitic reactions with Li metal. Consequently, Li||Li symmetric cells achieve stable cycling for 1900 h at 3 mA cm −2 with an areal capacity of 3 mAh cm −2 . Li//NCM811 cells retain 90% of their capacity after 420 cycles, while Li//LiCoO 2 cells exhibit stable cycling for over 290 cycles at 1 C with a cutoff voltage of 4.6 V. This work provides a robust strategy for designing free‐standing electrolytes for high‐energy‐density lithium‐metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 폴리아크릴산(PAA)에 포스포늄계 이온성 액체([P4441][DMP])를 도입해 자립형 글래스겔 전해질을 개발했다. 2.2 mS/cm의 이온전도도와 30 MPa의 인장강도를 가지며, Li 금속과의 부반응을 억제해 Li||Li 대칭셀에서 1900시간 안정적 사이클링을 구현했다. Li//NCM811 및 Li//LiCoO2 완전셀에서도 각각 420회, 290회 이상의 장기 사이클 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: N‐Heterocyclic Molecular Additives Enable Solvation and Interfacial Chemistry Regulation for High‐Stability, High‐Rate, and High‐Capacity Lithium Metal Anodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Most electrolyte additives enable long‐term Li plating/stripping at <3 mA cm − 2 , non‐applicable to practical Li‐metal batteries (LMBs) operating at ≥5 mA cm − 2 and ≥ 5 mAh cm − 2 . Here, we report an interaction chemistry that enables simultaneous solvation and interfacial regulation by exploring a novel N‐heterocyclic molecule (i.e., TPTC)—comprising an N‐heterocyclic core and four pyridine units–as an efficient additive for achieving ultra‐stable Li‐metal anodes under practical conditions. Electron‐rich N atoms in TPTC serve as ion‐dipole interaction sites, inducing competitive coordination that weakens Li + solvation and enhances Li + migration in the bulk electrolyte, which homogenizes Li + concentration near the interface, favoring high‐rate Li deposition. TPTC also adsorbs on Li surface to construct a protective layer with a low interfacial de‐solvation barrier, which–together with low‐barrier Li + transport through heterocyclic cavities–facilitates uniform Li deposition. Meanwhile, electron‐deficient C–H sites in pyridine weakly interact with TFSI − , forming an anion‐rich interfacial region that in situ decomposes into an inorganic‐rich interphase, affording high‐flux Li + transport. This synergy allows stable Li plating/stripping at 10 mA cm −2 /10 mAh cm −2 for 3000 h. Paired with a high‐loading LiFePO 4 cathode (∼15 mg cm −2 ) and thin Li (∼100 µm), the cell maintains 87.8% capacity after 400 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: N-헤테로사이클릭 분자 첨가제 TPTC를 이용하여 전해질의 솔베이션 구조와 리튬 금속 표면의 계면 화학을 동시에 조절하는 전략을 제시했다. 전자가 풍부한 N 원자가 Li+와 경쟁적으로 결합해 솔베이션을 약화시키고, 전자가 부족한 피리딘 C-H가 TFSI-와 상호작용해 무기물이 풍부한 계면을 형성함으로써 10 mA cm-2/10 mAh cm-2의 고율 조건에서도 3000시간 동안 안정적인 Li 도금/탈리를 구현했다. 고로딩 LFP 캐소드와 결합한 셀은 400회 사이클 후 87.8%의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Liquid Metal Spheres Achieving Stable Residual SEI for Dendrite‐Free Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium dendrite growth represents the primary factor hindering the commercialization of high‐energy‐density lithium metal batteries, as it gives rise to safety hazards and low Coulombic efficiency. Surface morphology of deposited lithium is particularly affected by solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) and current collectors. Herein, we propose a current collector coated by spherical GaIn liquid metal nanoparticles encapsulated in a carbon layer (GaIn@C), which are spontaneously formed by the physical properties of liquid metal. This three‐dimensional spherical GaIn@C layer shows remarkable structure stability and avoids the tip effect during deposition of lithium, thus maintaining a stable residual SEI (rSEI) and dendrite‐free morphology over the repeated plating/stripping processes. The dendrite‐free lithium deposition behavior on GaIn@C layer was revealed via multiphysics simulation, ex‐situ deposition observation, in situ optical experiments, and in situ impedance analysis. Uniform deposition process of lithium half‐cell achieves a cycle life of up to 3500 h at an areal deposition capacity of 5 mAh cm −2 . Anode‐free full cell maintains specific capacity of 172.9 mAh g −1 after 100 cycles at 1C, with capacity retention of 99.9% and energy density of pouch battery exceed 410 Wh kg −1 . This study presents a general synthetic strategy for the construction of a current collector with stable residual SEI in dendrite‐free lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: GaIn 액체금속 나노입자를 탄소층으로 감싼 구형 집전체(GaIn@C)를 제안해 리튬 증착 시 팁 효과를 억제하고 덴드라이트 없는 균일한 리튬 증착을 구현했다. 잔류 SEI(rSEI)를 안정적으로 유지하여 Li 반셀에서 최대 3500시간의 사이클 수명을 달성했다. 무음극 완전셀에서는 410 Wh/kg 이상의 에너지밀도와 99.9%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: High‐Conductivity Active Interface Layer for Active Lithium Reservoir in Micro‐Silicon‐Based All‐Solid‐State Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sulfide‐based all‐solid‐state lithium‐ion batteries (ASSLIBs) employing fully active, carbon‐free micro‐silicon (µSi) anodes present significant potential for high energy density, enhanced safety, and reduced cost. However, their practical application is challenged by inherent issues such as sluggish reaction kinetics, substantial volume expansion, and low Coulombic efficiency, which collectively degrade overall electrochemical performance. Herein, an interfacial engineering strategy is developed to construct an active interface layer on µSi particles via a mechanochemical cold‐pressing method. The resulting Li─Si alloy layer acts as an active lithium reservoir, which enables active lithium reservoir. Furthermore, this spontaneously formed active layer exhibits high ionic/electronic conductivities and accommodates volume changes due to its favorable mechanical properties, thereby improving electrode reaction kinetics and structural stability. ASSLIBs fabricated with LiNi 0.83 Co 0.12 Mn 0.05 O 2 cathode and modified µSi anode deliver a high initial specific capacity of 182.55 mAh g −1 and retain a capacity retention of 89.2% after 200 cycles at 0.1 C. This work offers a facile interfacial engineering technique for constructing self‐compensating lithium reservoirs and promotes the development of high‐energy‐density silicon‐based solid‐state batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 황화물계 전고체전지에서 탄소를 포함하지 않는 활성 마이크로실리콘(µSi) 음극의 반응 속도론 저하와 체적 변화 문제를 해결하기 위해 기계화학적 냉압착으로 활성 계면층을 형성하는 전략을 제안했다. 자발적으로 형성된 Li-Si 합금층이 활성 리튬 저장소 역할을 하며 높은 이온/전자 전도성과 체적 변화 수용 능력을 제공한다. 해당 전지는 182.55 mAh g-1의 초기 용량과 0.1C/200사이클 후 89.2%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Formulating the Dual‐Function Separator‐Enabled Homogenizing Ion Flux in Nonflammable Phosphate toward High Stable Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The high‐energy lithium metal battery employing a nonflammable phosphate electrolyte is an attractive strategy to resolve the notorious safety trouble. Unfortunately, the sluggish ion dissociation and transport kinetics, strong interaction of Li + ‐phosphates, and uncontrollable secondary reaction between the electrode and electrolyte interfaces severely impedes the cycling stability of lithium metal batteries. Herein, the dual‐function separators with fast ion dissociation and transport capability are designed to enable the homogeneous and efficient ion flux in nonflammable phosphate electrolyte. By virtue of the regulating effect of the designed dual‐function separator, the homogeneous distribution of the ion field and electric field are constructed, thus reducing the concentration polarization among nonflammable phosphate electrolyte and weakening the parasitic reaction of the metallic lithium anode and nickel‐rich cathode with the electrolyte. The Li||Li symmetrical cells exhibit remarkable cycling stability of above 1000 h at 2 mA cm −2 . Moreover, the Li||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) battery exhibits above 90% capacity retention after 300 cycles at 1C. Furthermore, stable bidirectional electrode‐electrolyte interfaces are also realized after cycling. This approach holds great promise for regulating the ion flux in nonflammable electrolyte, and would encourage more separator engineering design to optimize ionic transport behavior.
papers.summary_ko: 불연성 인산계 전해질에서 이온 흐름을 균일화하는 이중기능 분리막을 설계해 리튬 금속 전극과 니켈리치 양극의 부반응을 억제했다. Li||Li 대칭셀은 1000시간 이상 안정적으로 작동했으며, Li||NCM811 완전셀은 300회 사이클 후 90% 이상의 용량 유지율을 보였다. 이를 통해 불연성 전해질 기반 리튬 금속 배터리의 안전성과 사이클 안정성을 동시에 향상시켰다.

papers.title: Fluorine‐Rich Lewis Acidic MOF as Ion Modulator to Enable Dendrite‐Free Li Plating for Ah‐Level Li‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium metal stands as the most promising anode material to drive the development of next‐generation energy storage systems owing to its unparalleled theoretical gravimetric capacity. However, the naturally formed solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) is inadequate to suppress the uncontrolled growth of lithium dendrites, posing the safety concerns for lithium metal batteries (LMBs). Herein, we propose a F‐rich Lewis acid metal‐organic framework (F‐mof) as an anion captor and a cation accelerator to mitigate the concentration polarization and expedite the lithium ion transport at anode‐electrolyte interface. The lithiophilic nature of F‐mof with a 3D open framework facilitates the uniform lithium deposition and mitigates the electrode volume change during extended cycling. This strong Lewis acid‐modified Li anode enables Li||Li symmetric cells to achieve an extended cycle life of 2000 h at a high capacity of 2 mAh cm −2 . The modified LMBs with LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) cathodes demonstrate the prolonged 700 cycles at 1 C. The NCM811‐pouch cells with a thick cathode (30 mg cm −2 ) achieve a high energy density of 300 Wh kg −1 based on entire pouch weight. Moreover, this work uses a conversion‐type FeF 3 cathode to assemble multilayer pouch cell, achieving a high capacity of 600 mAh for fluoride conversion reaction batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 불소가 풍부한 루이스 산성 금속-유기 골격체(F-MOF)를 음이온 포획 및 양이온 가속 물질로 사용하여 리튬 금속전지의 농도 분극을 완화하고 이온 전달을 촉진하는 전략을 제안했다. Li||Li 대칭셀에서 2 mAh cm-2 조건으로 2000시간의 긴 사이클 수명을 달성했으며, NCM811 양극과 결합한 전지는 700회 사이클 동안 안정적으로 구동되었다. 두꺼운 NCM811 양극을 적용한 파우치셀은 300 Wh kg-1의 에너지 밀도를 보였고, FeF3 전환형 양극 다층 파우치셀에서도 600 mAh의 높은 용량을 구현했다.

papers.title: Diagnosis of Mechanisms of Kinetics in Lithium-Rich Manganese-Based Cathode Materials
papers.abstract_en: Abstract The rate-determining step (RDS), which determines rate capability in lithium-rich manganese-based oxide (LRMO) cathode materials, remains unclear. In this work, we establish a quantitative diagnostic method for the RDS in LRMOs using in-situ electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) and linear sweep voltammetry (LSV) at different states of charge (SOC) and C-rates. From our results, the SOC determines the intrinsic bottleneck of the RDS, while the C-rate drives the transition from single-step to mixed control. Upon discharging to 4.4 V, the RDS is dominated by electron transfer at the interface accompanied by layered-to-spinel phase transition, whereas it is strongly influenced by solid-state diffusion in the bulk with depletion of Li vacancies arising from Jahn–Teller distortion when discharging to 3.0 V. Furthermore, Li+ diffusion, instead of charge transfer, plays a major part in the RDS of LRMOs when the C-rates are increased. These findings establish quantitative criteria for designing future cathode materials.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 리치 망간계 산화물(LRMO) 양극재의 속도 결정 단계(RDS)를 정량적으로 진단하는 방법을 제시했다. in-situ 임피던스 분광법과 선형주사전위법을 이용해 분석한 결과, SOC는 RDS의 본질적 한계를 결정하고 C-rate는 단일 단계에서 혼합 제어로의 전환을 유도함을 확인했다. 4.4V 방전에서는 계면 전자전달이, 3.0V에서는 얀-텔러 왜곡에 의한 Li 공공 고갈에 따른 고체 확산이 RDS를 지배하며, 고율에서는 전하전달보다 Li+ 확산이 주된 요인임을 밝혔다.

papers.title: Carbonyl‐Rich Polyimide Covalent Organic Frameworks as Anode Coating for Uniform Sodium Deposition
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Two‐dimensional covalent organic frameworks (2D COFs), by virtue of their structural diversity, high specific surface area, and facile functionalization, have emerged as a promising anode coating for sodium metal batteries (SMBs). Herein, we report two polyimide COFs (TATT‐NTCDA‑COF and TATT‐PMDA‑COF) constructed from isocyanurate‐based amine building blocks, which feature profuse ion‐binding active sites and a robust, ordered framework, thereby significantly enhancing ion transport, fostering uniform sodium deposition, and suppressing dendrite growth. Benefiting from this unique design and its reliable stability, the symmetric cell based on TATT‐NTCDA‑COF operates stably for over 1200 h at 0.1 mA cm −2 . When assembled into a full cell with a commercial Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 (NVP) cathode, it delivers an initial discharge capacity of 107.4 mAh g −1 , retains 9.3% capacity after 800 cycles at 1 C, and maintains over 90% capacity retention even after 1390 cycles at 5 C and 750 cycles at 10 C. Thus, the rational design of carbonyl‐rich 2D COFs is of great significance for the construction of artificial anode coatings for SMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 폴리이미드 기반 2차원 공유결합 유기골격체(COF) 두 종(TATT-NTCDA-COF, TATT-PMDA-COF)을 나트륨 금속전지의 음극 코팅으로 적용했다. 풍부한 이온 결합 활성 사이트를 지닌 이 COF 구조는 이온 전달을 촉진하고 균일한 나트륨 증착을 유도하여 덴드라이트 형성을 억제한다. 대칭셀은 0.1 mA cm-2에서 1200시간 이상 안정적으로 작동했으며, NVP 완전셀에서는 5C로 1390회, 10C로 750회 사이클 후에도 90% 이상의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Asymmetric Cooperative Solvation Structure Enables Entropy‐Enthalpy Compensation for Ultralow Temperature Sodium‐Metal and Sodium–Ion Pouch Cells
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sodium‐metal batteries are promising for low‐temperature energy storage, yet conventional electrolytes suffer from an intrinsic trade‐off between thermodynamic stability and kinetic transport, causing salt precipitation and solvation collapse. Herein, an asymmetric cooperative solvation structure (ACSS) is introduced to spatially decouple these conflicting requirements via coordination competition between a strong solvating solvent (diethylene glycol dimethyl ether, DME) and a weak solvating (diethylene glycol diethyl ether, DEE). The DME‐rich inner core forms compact ternary coordination clusters with Na + and anions (PF 6 − /BF 4 − ), ensuring enthalpic stability and high salt solubility via geometric ion confinement, while the DEE‐rich outer shell sustains entropic mobility through rapid ligand exchange, facilitating hopping transport and lowering desolvation barriers. This enthalpy–entropy compensation preserves ionic conductivity and structural integrity below −40°C. High anion occupancy within the stable clusters promotes preferential anion reduction, yielding an inorganic‐rich SEI with high mechanical modulus and low Na + migration energy, effectively suppressing dendrite growth and interfacial polarization. Consequently, Na||Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 pouch cell achieves a capacity retention of 94% at −40°C. Scaled‐up 1.2 Ah hard carbon||Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 and 1.2 Ah hard carbon||NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 pouch cells sustain 400 and 550 cycles at −30°C and −20°C, respectively, demonstrating the promising practical applicability of this electrolyte design.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐 금속전지의 저온 구동을 저해하는 열역학적 안정성과 운동학적 수송 사이의 트레이드오프를 비대칭 협동 솔베이션 구조(ACSS)로 해결한 전해질 연구이다. 강한 솔베이팅 솔벤트(DME)가 내부 코어에서 Na+와 음이온의 삼원 배위 클러스터를 형성해 엔탈피적 안정성을 확보하고, 약한 솔베이팅 솔벤트(DEE)가 외부 셸에서 빠른 리간드 교환을 통해 엔트로피적 이동성을 유지한다. 음이온이 많이 포획된 클러스터가 무기물 풍부 SEI를 형성해 덴드라이트와 계면 분극을 억제하며, -40°C에서 94%의 용량 유지율과 -30°C/-20°C에서 1.2 Ah급 하드카본 파우치셀의 장기 사이클을 입증했다.

papers.title: Anchored Fluoro‐Shielded Solvation for Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF)‐based polymer electrolytes are promising candidates for solid‐state lithium metal batteries owing to their favorable overall electrochemical properties. However, conventional PVDF‐based polymer electrolytes suffer from uneven solvation distribution, discontinuous ion‐transport pathways, and unstable electrode/electrolyte interfaces caused by residual solvents and porous PVDF frameworks. Herein, we report an anchored fluoro‐shielded solvation strategy to construct a high‐performance PVDF‐based polymer electrolyte. By integrating polyanionic anchoring sites with fluorinated shielding segments, the optimized electrolyte enables spatially distributed anion‐rich solvation pathways, homogeneous Li + transport, and robust LiF‐rich solid electrolyte interphase (SEI). The polymer electrolyte delivers a high ionic conductivity of 1.26×10 −3 S cm −1 , a Li + transference number of 0.69, an oxidative onset potential of 5.27 V, and a critical current density of 6.4 mA cm −2 . Spectroscopic and interfacial analyses reveal that the anchored fluoro‐shielded solvation structure promotes LiF‐rich SEI formation and suppresses solvent decomposition. Consequently, Li||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 batteries retain 80.2% capacity after 2000 cycles under high‐voltage and high‐rate conditions of 4.5 V and 5 C. This work highlights anchored fluoro‐shielded solvation as an effective molecular design principle for advanced polymer electrolytes toward practical high‐voltage and high‐rate solid‐state Li metal batteries.

papers.title: Submolecular Selenium Enables Low‐Pressure and Recyclable All‐Solid‐State Li–Se Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT All‐solid‐state lithium‐selenium (Li–Se) batteries offer high energy density and intrinsic safety, but their practical deployment is hindered by sluggish solid‐state redox kinetics, large volume fluctuations, and unstable solid‐solid interfaces, particularly under low stack pressure. Here we report a submolecular Se x cathode by converting crystalline cyclo‐Se 8 into amorphous single‐atom and short‐chain Se (Se x , x < 4) species anchored on graphene (Se x @G), which increases the electronic conductivity from 6.3 × 10 −5 to 13 S cm −1 and Li + diffusivity from 1.7 × 10 −14 to 2.0 × 10 −11 cm 2 s −1 . Meanwhile, a Li 2 O‐nanoshell‐modified sulfide solid electrolyte is designed to stabilize the interface against both Li metal and Se cathode. As a result, all‐solid‐state Li–Se batteries deliver the theoretical capacity of 673 mAh g −1 at 0.1 C and retain 86% capacity over 2800 cycles at 3 C under 8 MPa, with stable operation down to −30°C. All‐solid‐state Li–Se pouch cells further achieve an energy density of 420 Wh kg −1 and 94% capacity retention after 300 cycles under 2.5 MPa. Post‐mortem analysis reveals that the submolecular Se x species are not only structurally preserved but also recyclable after electrochemical cycling within the solid‐state reaction environment. This work establishes submolecular chalcogen chemistry as a new design paradigm for low‐pressure, recyclable, and high‐energy all‐solid‐state batteries.

papers.title: Stabilizing hydrogen bonds and engineering multi-component hetero-solvation architecture for dendrite-free zinc metal anodes
papers.abstract_en: Aqueous zinc-ion batteries (AZIBs) are promising candidates for renewable grid energy storage, but their development is limited by non-uniform zinc deposition, hydrogen evolution reactions (HERs), and byproduct growth at the zinc anode interface. Herein, a dual-regulation strategy integrating bulk solvation reorganization with interfacial dynamic electrostatic shielding is developed by introducing a trace amount of 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium iodide (BMIMI, BI) into a Zn(OTf) 2 aqueous electrolyte. Multi-dimensional microscopic spectra and quantitative molecular dynamics simulations confirm that the co-incorporation of BMIM + cations and I − anions establishes a diversified I − -H 2 O-OTf − hetero-primary solvation sheath, disrupting the chemical degradation pathways caused by free water aggregation. Due to its electrostatic adsorption energy advantage on multiple crystal planes, BMIM + preferentially occupies active sites to form a dynamic cation shielding field. This forces Zn 2+ to diffuse away smoothly from local tip protrusions and induces lateral planar epitaxial growth along the dense (002) preferred crystal plane. Consequently, the electrolyte shows stability within the fundamental potential window during cyclic voltammetry tests, and the interfacial desolvation energy barrier decreases from 51.29 to 23.28 kJ mol −1 . This affords the Zn//Cu battery a stable Coulombic efficiency of 99.74%, and the Zn//Zn symmetric battery achieves a lifespan exceeding 7500 h under variable loads and high areal capacities. In full-cell applications, the cell maintains a capacity retention of 84.07% after 5000 cycles at a high current density of 2 A g −1 . Combined with ex-situ distribution of relaxation times and dynamic impedance evolution, this strategy confirms the feasibility of the system for industrial-grade variable-load energy storage scenarios.
papers.summary_ko: BMIMI를 Zn(OTf)2 수계 전해질에 소량 첨가해 I⁻-H2O-OTf⁻로 구성된 다중 1차 솔베이션 셰시를 형성하고, BMIM+ 양이온의 동적 정전차폐 효과로 아연의 (002)면 우선성장을 유도했다. 이를 통해 탈솔베이션 에너지 장벽을 51.29에서 23.28 kJ/mol로 낮추고, Zn//Cu 셀에서 99.74%의 쿨롱효율, Zn//Zn 대칭셀에서 7500시간 이상의 수명을 달성했다.

papers.title: Neutron Depth Profiling: The Core Link Connecting the Microscopic Mechanisms of Lithium‐Ion Batteries With Intelligent Design
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Neutron Depth Profiling (NDP) is a non‐destructive, in situ quantitative depth‐analysis technique underpinned by neutron‐induced nuclear reactions. Offering high 6 Li‐isotope sensitivity and nanometer‐to‐micrometer depth resolution, NDP delivers isotope‐resolved lithium spatial information hardly accessible via conventional probes including secondary‐ion mass spectrometry (SIMS), X‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and operando neutron imaging, yet it suffers from depth‐dependent resolution degradation, limited lateral performance, and requires large‐scale neutron‐beam facilities. This paper systematically reviews NDP fundamentals, global neutron‐source progress, and cutting‐edge battery applications, covering lithium‐ion migration in electrodes, lithium dendrite nucleation and growth, and the “reversible short‐circuit” effect at solid‐electrolyte interfaces. The unique merit of NDP for quantitative 6 Li depth‐profiling is highlighted, while noting that NDP cannot independently resolve full‐element maps or nanoscale interfaces and demands complementary characterizations. A roadmap integrating NDP with multimodal measurements and physics‐informed machine learning for intelligent battery design is outlined, alongside open challenges: inversion non‐uniqueness under low‐signal conditions and translation from model cells to practical batteries. This work provides actionable guidelines to leverage NDP for bridging microscopic lithium mechanisms and rational design of next‑generation batteries with high safety and high energy density.
papers.summary_ko: 이 리뷰는 중성자 유발 핵반응을 이용한 비파괴 정량 깊이분석 기법인 중성자 깊이 프로파일링(NDP)의 원리와 중성자원 기술 발전, 배터리 응용(전극 내 리튬 이동, 리튬 덴드라이트 핵생성·성장, 고체전해질 계면의 가역적 단락 현상)을 종합적으로 다룬다. NDP는 6Li 동위원소에 대한 높은 민감도와 나노~마이크로미터급 깊이 분해능을 제공하지만, 깊이에 따른 분해능 저하, 제한적인 수평 분해능, 대형 중성자 시설 의존성 등의 한계가 있다. 저자들은 NDP를 다중 분석기법 및 물리 정보 기반 머신러닝과 결합해 차세대 고안전·고에너지밀도 배터리 설계에 활용하는 로드맵을 제시한다.

papers.title: Molecular design of sulfonate-graphene oxide frameworks (GOF) separators with crystallographic orientation and ion selectivity for high-rate zinc-ion storage
papers.abstract_en: Aqueous zinc-ion batteries (AZIBs) are highly attractive for grid-scale energy storage owing to their inherent safety and low cost. However, Zn dendrite growth and parasitic side reactions severely limit their fast-charging capability and cycling stability. Graphene oxide (GO) is a promising separator scaffold since its layered, graphitic domains can template Zn deposition along the (002) plane. Concurrently, its abundant oxygen-containing functional groups enable the interlayer regions chemical expansion and functionalization. Herein, we report two strategies to tailor Janus separators, achieved by spray-coating sulfonate-containing GO frameworks (GOFs) onto commercial cellulose fiber (CF) membranes. The reaction of GO with two diamino-substituted disulfonic acid pillars, i.e. 2,5-diaminobenzene-1,4-disulfonic acid (S1) and 2,2′-benzidinedisulfonic acid (S2), yields a GO interlayer spacing expansion from 0.79 to 1.09 nm and 1.41 nm, respectively, opening selective Zn²⁺ transport channels. The pendant sulfonate groups within these channels lock Zn ions into (002) texture, electrostatically repel SO₄²⁻, and release H⁺, collectively suppressing parasitic side reactions and raising the Zn²⁺ transference number from 0.45 (CF) to 0.62 (GOF-S1@CF) and 0.68 (GOF-S2@CF). Zn//Zn symmetric cells assembled with the Janus separators cycle for 2700–3600 h at 2 mA cm⁻², compared with 1200 h for bare CF. Zn//MnO₂ full cells retain 81.2% of their capacity after 2000 cycles at 1 A g⁻¹, and a Zn//NH₄V₄O₁₀ pouch cell retains 82.4% capacity over 400 cycles, whereas the CF-based pouch cell fails within 20 cycles. These results demonstrate that combining ion-selective transport with crystallographic control of Zn deposition is an effective route to long-lived, fast-charging AZIB separators.
papers.summary_ko: 술폰산염을 포함하는 그래핀 산화물 프레임워크(GOF)를 분리막에 도입해 Zn2+ 선택적 이동 경로와 (002) 결정 배향을 유도, 수계 Zn-이온전지의 덴드라이트 억제 및 고속충전 성능을 개선했다. Zn 전달수가 CF 대비 0.45에서 0.62~0.68로 증가했고, Zn//Zn 대칭셀은 최대 3600시간, Zn//NH4V4O10 파우치셀은 400회 사이클에서 82.4%의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Li+-locked domain effect for breaking the temperature stability bottleneck in thermal-detection high-entropy energy storage ceramics
papers.abstract_en: Conventional brain pacemakers rely on electrochemical batteries, which suffer from leakage, performance degradation, and neurotoxicity, posing serious safety risks. Ceramic-based pulse generators with ultra-fast discharge, high-temperature stability, and self-diagnostic capability offer a promising alternative. However, most dielectric ceramics lose their polarization activity at elevated temperatures. To address this challenge, we introduce a high-entropy composition design that induces a Li-locked domain effect in the ceramic system (1-x)[0.9(Bi0.47Na0.47Yb0.03Tm0.01)TiO3−0.1LiTaO3]−0.06(Ba0.3Sr0.7)(Sn0.5Hf0.5)O3. We demonstrate that Li+-enriched regions lock polar nanodomains, preserving them even at 300 °C. This mechanism yields a recoverable energy density of 11.43 J·cm−3, an efficiency of 84.67%, and excellent temperature stability (Δη/η < 0.3% up to 320 °C). Moreover, Yb3+/Tm3+ co-doping enables anomalous thermal enhancement of photoluminescence and precise temperature monitoring. Remarkably, the experimentally measured temperature sensing deviation is only ±0.23 K. The integration of stable energy storage and optical self-diagnosis provides a new paradigm for ceramic-based brain pacemaker pulse generators with early warning capability, pointing toward a possible solution to the intrinsic safety limitations of conventional battery-powered devices. Dielectric energy-storage ceramics lose polarization at high temperatures, limiting harsh-environment use. Here, the authors show a Li+- locked domain effect in high-entropy BNT-based ceramics, achieving Wrec = 11.43 J cm−3, η = 84.67%, Δη/η < 0.3% up to 320 °C, with self-diagnostic thermometry.
papers.summary_ko: 이 연구는 고엔트로피 유전체 세라믹 시스템에 Li+ 농축 영역을 도입해 분극 나노도메인을 300°C까지 유지시키는 'Li+ 잠금 도메인' 효과를 보고한다. 이를 통해 11.43 J·cm−3의 회수 에너지밀도와 84.67%의 효율, 320°C까지 Δη/η<0.3%의 온도 안정성을 달성했다. 또한 Yb3+/Tm3+ 공동 도핑으로 ±0.23 K 정밀도의 온도 감지 기능을 더해 자가진단형 뇌 페이스메이커 펄스 발생기 응용을 제안한다.

papers.title: From Order to Disorder: A Crystalline-Amorphous Core-Shell Structure Enables Superior Ionic Conductivity and Interfacial Stability in Halide Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: Halide solid-state electrolytes are critical for developing high-safety, high-energy-density all-solid-state lithium batteries. However, most existing synthesis methods for halide electrolytes rely on non-equilibrium strategies, which struggle to simultaneously achieve high ionic conductivity and good stability. Here, we propose a facile one-step solid-state route that constructs a highly conductive and structurally robust crystalline-amorphous core-shell heterostructure by aliovalent doping of Hf 4+ /Zr 4+ into Li 3 YCl 6 . In this heterostructure, the ordered crystalline core serves as a robust scaffold, while nanocrystallites that simultaneously promote structural integrity and ion transport are embedded within the continuous, highly conductive amorphous shell. These structural features synergistically establish a three-dimensional ion migration network with low transport barriers and high connectivity, enabling Li 2.6 Y 0.6 Hf 0.4 Cl 6 to achieve a room-temperature ionic conductivity of 1.4 mS·cm −1 , a 37-fold enhancement over the pristine phase, and an activation energy of 0.30 eV. Benefiting from its excellent interfacial stability against Li–In anode, all-solid-state batteries employing the LiNi 0.8 Mn 0.1 Co 0.1 O 2 cathode operate stably without a sulfide interlayer, achieving 80.8% capacity retention after 200 cycles at room temperature and 73.8% retention after 100 high-rate cycles at elevated temperature. With an additional sulfide interlayer to further optimize the interface, the cell delivers a prolonged cycle life with 87.2% capacity retention over 580 cycles. Through a straightforward solid-state doping approach, this work designs a highly conductive and structurally stable halide electrolyte, offering a new design paradigm for halide electrolytes.
papers.summary_ko: Li3YCl6에 Hf4+/Zr4+를 이종 도핑하여 결정질 코어와 비정질 쉘로 구성된 코어-쉘 할라이드 고체전해질을 일단계 고상법으로 합성했다. 이 구조는 3차원 이온 이동 네트워크를 형성해 상온 이온전도도 1.4 mS/cm(37배 향상)와 0.30 eV의 활성화 에너지를 달성했다. Li-In 음극과의 우수한 계면 안정성으로 황화물 중간층 없이도 NCM811 양극 전지에서 상온 200회 사이클 후 80.8%, 고율 100회 사이클 후 73.8%의 용량 유지율을 보였으며, 황화물 중간층 추가 시 580회 사이클에서도 87.2%를 유지했다.

papers.title: Engineering a borate-rich interphase for highly stable all-solid-state sodium batteries
papers.abstract_en: Composite polymer electrolytes (CPEs) are promising for all-solid-state sodium batteries, yet interfacial instability limits their practical applications. The commonly used NaTFSI can electrochemically form an NaF–Na2CO3–Na2O-rich solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) to regulate sodium-ion deposition, but the resulting protective layer still suffers from early failure. Herein, a boron-enriched interphase is introduced by incorporating NaDFOB into a polyethylene-oxide based CPE, enabling stable and dendrite-free Na plating/stripping. Experimental results reveal that DFOB− preferentially decomposes over TFSI−, forming an Na4B2O5–NaF–Na2CO3–Na2O SEI with synergistic ion-conductive and electron-blocking properties. Moreover, theoretical calculations are performed to investigate the synergistic ionic-enhanced and electronic-restricted capability of the SEI layer. Benefiting from the stabilized SEI, the Na||Na symmetric cell exhibits outstanding cyclic stability (5,000 h at 0.5 mA cm−2) and full cell delivers a high initial capacity of 99.4 mAh g−1 with 92.38% retention at 3 C after 9,000 cycles.

DFOB−가 TFSI−보다 우선적으로 분해되어 Na4B2O5-NaF-Na2CO3-Na2O로 구성된 이온전도성·전자차단성 SEI를 형성함을 실험과 이론 계산으로 확인했다. Na||Na 대칭셀은 0.5 mA/cm²에서 5,000시간의 안정적 사이클 특성을 보였고, 완전셀은 99.4 mAh/g의 초기용량과 9,000회 사이클 후 92.38%의 용량 유지율을 나타냈다.

papers.title: Cross-modal topology decodes battery faults from sparse voltage snapshots
papers.abstract_en: Battery safety remains the primary bottleneck for mass electric vehicle (EV) adoption, yet field monitoring is hamstrung by a fundamental asymmetry: complex electrochemical faults must be diagnosed via sparse, low-frequency voltage measurements. Existing methods struggle to resolve the signal ambiguity between overlapping fault modes without hardware upgrades. Here, we demonstrate that these distinct fault fingerprints are not lost, but topologically folded within voltage snapshots. We introduce DeFault, a cross-modal diagnostic framework that mathematically unfolds one-dimensional voltage sequences into multi-dimensional phase-space topologies. DeFault employs a bidirectional cross-attention mechanism that acts as an autonomous, physics-aligned filter, explicitly decoding compounded fault modes that remain fundamentally invisible to sequence-based methods. Validated on a field dataset of 16.4 million data records from 99 in-service EVs, our method achieves an average accuracy of 0.96 and an F1 score of 0.84 for four fault types using only 500-second snapshots (spanning <100 mV). This work proves that high-fidelity, interpretable electrochemical diagnosis is achievable on legacy fleets without new sensors, providing a scalable solution for the battery safety crisis.

papers.title: Chemically Reactivatable Sulfide Interfaces for Low‐Pressure Thick‐Cathode Solid‐State Na–S Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Low‐pressure solid‐state Na–S batteries with thick sulfur cathodes are attractive for high‐energy storage, but their operation is fundamentally constrained by the progressive loss of solid–solid contact during sulfur conversion. Once insulating sulfides become poorly connected to the electronic network, charge recovery becomes incomplete and cathode passivation rapidly accumulates. Here, we construct chemically reactivatable sulfide interfaces by embedding Fe 3 C–MnO heteropoints within nitrogen‐doped hollow carbon nanotubes. The heterointerface integrates carbon‐side electronic coupling, sulfide‐side affinity, and interfacial polarization, thereby suppressing localized sulfide accumulation and sustaining charge‐stage sulfur recovery as mechanical confinement weakens. This effect is strongly pressure dependent. Under high compression, the electrochemical responses of different hosts converge, whereas under contact‐limited conditions the Fe 3 C–MnO architecture preserves markedly higher sulfur utilization, lower polarization, and superior cycling stability. Consequently, the operational pressure required to retain ≥80% of the 10 MPa discharge capacity decreases from approximately 2 MPa for the control cathodes to 0.2 MPa for Fe 3 C–MnO/NC@S. A 200 µm cathode with 8.3 mg cm −2 sulfur sustains reversible cycling at 0.2 MPa, together with a pouch‐cell energy density of 696 Wh kg cathode −1 . These results establish sulfide‐interface reactivation as a route to decouple reversible sulfur chemistry from stringent mechanical confinement.

papers.title: Anion Packing and Li⁺ Coordination Topology in Ether-Functionalized Imidazolium Ionic-Liquid Electrolytes: FSI versus TFSI
papers.abstract_en: We ask how anion identity relates to L i + coordination and the transport penalty of lithium-salt addition in ether-functionalized [MOEmim] ionic liquids. [ MOEmim ] [ FSI ] , [ MOEmim ] [ TFSI ] and their matched Li-salt electrolytes ( x ( LiX ) = 0.167 ) were synthesized and studied by FTIR, rheometry, impedance spectroscopy, 25 ns polarizable molecular dynamics (APPLE&P) with atom-resolved coordination and Onsager transport analysis, and COSMO-RS. LiFSI more than doubles the viscosity of [ MOEmim ] [ FSI ] (21.3 → 52.4 mPa·s at 25°C), whereas LiTFSI raises that of [ MOEmim ] [ TFSI ] by only about 10%, though the FSI electrolyte remains the more conductive. Binding strength does not run in the direction required: COSMO-RS finds L i + coordination more favorable to TFS I − at every cluster size, by 11–29 kJ mol⁻¹. The difference lies in coordination topology. L i + holds a near-invariant oxygen coordination of 4.78–4.96, and the number of partners sharing it tracks anion size: 3.9 distinct anions alongside FS I − against 3.2 alongside TFS I − , so denticity follows arithmetically: 1.24 against 1.56. FSI aggregates are 1.7–1.8 × larger though non-percolating, and ether-oxygen coordination is a minority motif. The Li⁺ coordination topology and the transport penalty of salt addition therefore track anion packing, while ion correlations limit the fraction of the total ion motion that produces net charge transport. Because FSI⁻ and TFSI⁻ differ in more than volume, this identifies an operative packing explanation rather than isolating volume as an independent variable.
papers.summary_ko: 에테르 치환 이미다졸륨 이온성액체([MOEmim][FSI], [MOEmim][TFSI])에서 음이온 종류가 Li+ 배위 구조와 리튬염 첨가에 따른 수송 손실에 미치는 영향을 FTIR, 레올로지, 임피던스 분광법, 분자동역학, COSMO-RS로 분석했다. LiFSI는 점도를 2배 이상 높이지만 FSI계 전해질이 더 높은 이온전도도를 유지했으며, Li+ 배위는 결합강도가 아닌 음이온 크기에 따른 배위 토폴로지(덴티시티) 차이로 설명됨을 규명했다.

papers.title: Ultralow Deposition Potential and Antisite-Boosted Diffusivity of Li3Ga2 Anode for All-Solid-State Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Existing alloy anodes suffer from high redox potentials and sluggish Li atomic kinetics, limiting the energy density and rate capability of all-solid-state lithium batteries (ASSLBs). Herein, we report a well-designed Li3Ga2 alloy anode that simultaneously delivers an ultralow Li deposition potential (0.007 V vs. Li+/Li) and fast Li atomic diffusion kinetics (2.0 × 10–8 cm2 s–1). The high Li atomic diffusivity primarily originates from moderate Li/Ga antisite mixing, stabilizing the anode-solid electrolyte interface and enabling a high critical current density of 24 mA cm–2 in ASSLBs. Coupled with a LiCoO2 cathode, the ASSLB delivers a high initial Coulombic efficiency of 96.5% and an ultralong cycle life of 2000 cycles at room temperature, with a high output voltage of 3.84 V, outperforming state-of-the-art alloy-based counterparts. A practical all-solid-state pouch cell employing the LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 cathode also delivers outstanding cycling stability. This work redefines alloy anode design principles through synergistic optimization of Li deposition potential and Li atomic diffusivity.
papers.summary_ko: 비교적 높은 산화환원 전위와 느린 Li 확산 속도 문제를 겪는 기존 합금 음극과 달리, Li3Ga2 합금 음극은 매우 낮은 Li 증착 전위(0.007 V)와 빠른 Li 확산 속도(2.0×10⁻⁸ cm²/s)를 동시에 달성했다. 이러한 특성은 Li/Ga 안티사이트 혼합에서 기인하며, 음극-고체전해질 계면을 안정화해 24 mA/cm²의 높은 임계 전류밀도를 구현했다. LiCoO2 및 NCM 캐소드와 결합한 전고체 전지는 초기 쿨롱 효율 96.5%, 2000회 사이클의 장수명 특성을 보였다.

papers.title: Scalable crosslinking-regulated membranes with ultra-high Li+/Mg2+ selectivity for lithium recovery from brines
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Membrane-based separation has emerged as a competitive technology for lithium extraction from salt-lake brines. However, its industrial implementation remains limited by the low Li + /Mg 2+ selectivity of conventional membranes. In this work, we demonstrate that regulation of the crosslinking degree during membrane formation enables subnanometer pore size control within the narrow window required for Li + /Mg 2+ separation. Under electrodialysis conditions, the membrane achieved a Li + /Mg 2+ separation factor of up to 6454 at an Mg/Li mass ratio of 140, outperforming previously reported membranes for Li + /Mg 2+ separation. Importantly, the membrane maintained a Li + /Mg 2+ separation factor above 1200 in untreated natural salt-lake brine, despite the high Mg/Li mass ratio (Mg/Li = 87) and the presence of multiple competing ions. Fabrication of a 25 cm × 35 cm membrane and stable performance over 15 days of repeated operation further supported the practical viability of this approach. The practical membrane design strategy reported in this work can inspire the development of ion-selective membranes with precisely regulated subnanometer pores for a wide range of sustainable separation processes.
papers.summary_ko: 가교 정도를 조절하여 서브나노미터 기공 크기를 정밀하게 제어한 분리막을 통해 염수에서 리튬을 추출하는 기술을 제시했다. 전기투석 조건에서 Li+/Mg2+ 분리 지수 최대 6454를 달성했으며, 실제 염호 염수에서도 1200 이상의 분리 성능을 유지했다. 25cm×35cm 크기의 분리막을 제작해 15일간 안정적으로 작동함을 입증하여 실용화 가능성을 보였다.

papers.title: HERC2–UBE3A structure uncovers a domain-motif protein network potentially altered in Angelman and related syndromes
papers.abstract_en: UBE3A and HERC2 are two mutually interacting HECT E3 Ubiquitin ligases whose genes are altered in 15q11.2-13.1 Duplication (Dup15q) Syndrome, Angelman Syndrome (AS) and other phenotypically-related mental retardation syndromes. Using quantitative binding assays, X-ray crystallography and sequence conservation analysis, we characterize the core interface of the HERC2-UBE3A complex, involving the RLD2 domain of HERC2 and a “DxDKDxD” sequence from a disordered region of UBE3A. The sequence determinants of the interface are conserved in numerous animals with a central nervous system. HERC2 also binds similar DxDKDxD motifs within a handful of other proteins relevant to brain development (DOCK10, PCM1, USP35, BAZ2B, ARID4A, ARIP4, RERE and MYT1). We further investigate the interaction of HERC2 with DOCK10, a RAC1- and CDC42-GEF protein that regulates dendritic spine morphogenesis in hippocampal neurons. siRNA-mediated knockdown of HERC2 affects the GEF activity of DOCK10, and mutagenesis of the HERC2-binding motif in DOCK10 disrupts both its GEF activity and its ability to drive dendritic spine formation. In developing brains, an abnormal dosage of either HERC2 or its dominant partner UBE3A may thus alter the proportions of RLD2-mediated complexes, including HERC2-DOCK10, and may thereby perturb dendritic spine morphogenesis and neurodevelopment. UBE3A and HERC2 are two interacting HECT E3 ligases altered in Angelman and related neurodevelopmental syndromes. Here the authors show UBE3A to bind HERC2 via a “DxDKDxD” motif found in nine additional HERC2-binding brain proteins, suggesting a HERC2-centered network relevant for neurodevelopment.
papers.summary_ko: UBE3A와 HERC2 두 E3 유비퀴틴 리가아제 간의 상호작용 구조를 규명한 연구로, Angelman 증후군 등 신경발달 질환과 관련된 도메인-모티프 결합 네트워크를 밝혔다. HERC2의 RLD2 도메인이 UBE3A 및 DOCK10 등 여러 단백질의 "DxDKDxD" 서열과 결합함을 확인했으며, HERC2 결손이 DOCK10의 GEF 활성과 수상돌기 가시 형성에 영향을 미침을 보였다. 이는 HERC2/UBE3A 발현량 이상이 신경발달 과정을 교란할 수 있음을 시사한다.

papers.title: Coprecipitation‐Enabled Scalable Synthesis of High‐Energy Density Polyanion‐Integrated Disordered Rocksalt Cathodes for Lithium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Disordered rocksalt cathodes (DRX) represent a compelling platform for cobalt‐ and nickel‐free high‐energy density lithium‐ion batteries. Yet their scalable synthesis remains challenging, especially for metastable DRX chemistries that have been predominantly developed via mechanochemical routes. A prominent example is polyanion‐integrated DRX (DRXPS) cathodes, which rank among the best DRX cathodes reported to date in terms of reversible energy density, but have thus far been synthesized only mechanochemically via low‐temperature ball milling. Here we demonstrate a coprecipitation–enabled solid‐state synthesis of a DRXPS cathode, Li 1.67 Mn 1.5 P 0.17 O 4 , translating a mechanochemical route into a scalable process that is compatible with established cathode manufacturing infrastructure. The workflow programs precursor chemistry via coprecipitation of Mn 2 + with HPO 4 2 − and OH − , followed by a eutectic lithium‐salt‐assisted solid‐state reaction, enabling low‐thermal‐budget DRXPS formation (450°C, 30 min) in air. The reduced thermal budget suppresses particle coarsening and yields a mixed micro‐/nanoscale particle morphology, thereby eliminating the need for post‐synthesis particle pulverization. The resulting cathodes deliver 324 mAh g −1 (935 Wh kg −1 ), demonstrating that high‐energy density DRXPS can be realized within a manufacturing‐compatible workflow. This work establishes a direct pathway toward scalable production of metastable high‐energy density DRXPS cathodes and identifies precursor engineering as the key enabler.
papers.summary_ko: 공침-고상법을 결합하여 다각형 음이온이 통합된 무질서 암염형(DRX) 캐소드인 Li1.67Mn1.5P0.17O4를 스케일업 가능한 방식으로 합성했다. Mn2+와 HPO4²⁻, OH⁻의 공침으로 전구체 화학을 제어한 뒤 유테틱 리튬염 보조 저온(450°C, 30분) 고상 반응을 적용해 입자 조대화를 억제하고 별도의 분쇄 공정 없이 미크로/나노 혼합 입자 형태를 얻었다. 이 캐소드는 324 mAh/g(935 Wh/kg)의 고에너지밀도를 구현하여 기존 제조 인프라와 호환되는 DRX 양극 생산 경로를 제시했다.

papers.title: Towards the real diamond formation conditions: insights and perspective
papers.abstract_en: Pressure and temperature conditions of diamond formation provide valuable insights for reconstructing paleo-geotherms and the deep carbon cycle. These conditions can be determined by investigating mineral inclusions in diamonds using elastic geobarometry, which can be applied to any mineral inclusion in a diamond. However, it assumes purely elastic host-inclusion behaviour throughout exhumation. In reality, almost all mineral inclusions in diamonds are surrounded by cracks. Here, we combine in situ high-temperature micro-Raman spectroscopy with thermo-elastic modelling to evaluate the pressure-release process in one of the most common diamond inclusions, olivine [(Mg,Fe)2SiO4]. Our results indicate that a diamond can sustain pressures of ~2.5 GPa before undergoing minor fracturing, which induces only partial loss of inclusion pressure rather than a complete reset. The estimated pressure loss can lead to an underestimation of up to 2.5 GPa in the entrapment pressure at 1150 °C, a typical temperature for diamond formation. This study shows that olivine in diamond can undergo partial release of pressure during kimberlite eruptions due to fast adiabatic decompression, leading to cracked olivine inclusions and entrapment pressures underestimated by up to 2.5 GPa at 1150 °C
papers.summary_ko: 다이아몬드 내 감람석 포유물을 이용한 고온 라만분광과 열탄성 모델링으로 압력 해방 과정을 평가한 지구과학 연구다. 다이아몬드는 균열이 생기기 전까지 약 2.5 GPa의 압력을 견딜 수 있으며, 1150°C에서 포획 압력이 최대 2.5 GPa까지 과소평가될 수 있음을 밝혔다. 배터리 소재와는 관련이 없는 연구다.
